hash_39b65e3603e4b486: ^<Johannes: ^7Is...is anyone out there? Can anyone hear me?
hash_6c7607c282776ac7: ^<Johannes: ^7I do not know how long I have been here. There are no days to count. Only an endless twilight...like a dream that keeps shifting whenever I try to focus on it.
hash_78b5b92218970784: ^<Johannes: ^7There are some strangely beautiful sights here...great, glowing gems, luminous creatures that float on the mist...but beauty means little when you are always being hunted.
hash_1d52ec75ca36db8d: ^<Johannes: ^7I should have never gone near that shimmering light. I never should have touched it. I thought it was a sign from God but...there is no God here. There is no God...
hash_59170eae8eff4a11: ^<Mariska: ^7In the name of the Father, and the Son and the Holy Spirit. Lord, it is me, Mariska. I do not know if my words reach you any more. I do not know if you care at all about the damned.
hash_55201f5530398d84: ^<Mariska: ^7For that is surely what I am. Damned. And I just want to know...why, Lord? What did I do to end up here?
hash_486159e315d9174b: ^<Mariska: ^7It is not the Hell I expected. No lake of fire. Only a cold, perpetual half-light that somehow seems even worse.
hash_29eee73e7179285e: ^<Mariska: ^7Dead men wander this land, feasting on the living. If you can call it living. And I fear they may be...
hash_709a2c4c37fbbdc5: ^<Mariska: ^7Lord, they are coming! I beg you, protect me. Deliver me from this place! I should not be here! I should not...
hash_9dab8ca3401ba04: ^<David: ^7Okay...okay, okay, okay...think it through...reason it out...
hash_17b424a5c9c69e11: ^<David: ^7I've met quite a few others who got trapped here like me. And every time -- every single time -- the question comes up: are we in Hell or not?
hash_29620b389f74406: ^<David: ^7I mean, sure, this has to be Hell, right? Dead people, demons...feels as far from God as you can get.
hash_5e936a11cdcb7b8b: ^<David: ^7I even thought I saw ghosts here. But now I'm thinking maybe they're just folks back home, and somehow I'm seeing them through the veil that separates our worlds.
hash_74795d338570a1f8: ^<David: ^7Which brings me to the thought I just can't get out of my mind. What if...there is no Hell? What if this place is just a place?
hash_563dce8e1f6db805: ^<David: ^7What if people came here before...and got out? And that's how we got the whole idea of Hell in the first place?
hash_41b44e234139661a: ^<David: ^7I...I mean...that should give me some hope, right? It means you can escape. Then again, maybe hope is part of the punishment. Maybe hope is the ultimate cruelty!
hash_4a5859aa8dd38bfa: ^<Alice: ^7I hope someone out there can hear this. I'm not quite certain this device even works.
hash_21c3058c9d7598f3: ^<Alice: ^7You see, I'm an historian. I was touring ancient sites in Peru when it all went dark. Suddenly, I'm in this...jigsaw landscape...
hash_5f73412e8c8b3400: ^<Alice: ^7This hodgepodge of creatures and artifacts...like a collision of cultures and eras.
hash_fc8f7cdd02dcb99: ^<Alice: ^7I've seen medieval structures alongside twenty-first century buildings. I've seen ancient, storybook creatures and mechanical monsters straight from a science fiction novel.
hash_25033558f74924e: ^<Alice: ^7And the thought I cannot seem to shake now is that the universe has a dumping ground for things that go bump in the night.
hash_753e9ae3bfb2a6c7: ^<Alice: ^7Others I've encountered assume this is Hell. But it's worse. It's the dustbin of history. It's the rubbish dump of time.
hash_42f5ad544146184: ^<Alice: ^7When the universe is through with you...this is your final stop.
hash_3ee92a793acceebd: ^<Barbara: ^7Confession time...and this one's gonna sound a little nutzoid, but stay with me. Please. Stay with me...
hash_606fcd1ea39c5bf4: ^<Barbara: ^7So I've noticed that ever since I landed in this place, well, I've noticed some changes. In me. Physically. And -- hey, I am not crazy, do not call me crazy, but... mentally, too.
hash_8f4c2d6a583c7d7: ^<Barbara: ^7Bad enough when my skin started to wither. I look part alligator. My nails are growing like crazy, and my teeth...
hash_2a7b2d7c0e52d5e6: ^<Barbara: ^7What worries me more is...how calm I am about it. I mean, at first I panicked, but...the more I change, the less I mind.
hash_53e1325bb0d6f941: ^<Barbara: ^7Plus, I am not as afraid of the things I run into. I even -- don't judge me. Don't you fucking judge me! -- I've...eaten one or two of them. I've gotta eat something--!
hash_747070fbb193b918: ^<Barbara: ^7Anyway, I don't know if it's the fog, or those glowy crystal things, but this place changes you. Not all at once, but...I don't think I could go back now, even if I knew how.
hash_479bf47b0c3d45f3: ^<Fritz: ^7We all thought...we thought this mission would be quick. The plan came straight from the top.
hash_707a3fd9335af9a2: ^<Fritz: ^7How hopeful we were, taking that first step. Victory was ours. But we spent our bullets long ago, and...this place has changed us.
hash_321c24f4f887732d: ^<Fritz: ^7I am not...the man I was. I am not...a man at all. I am just...so very tired...
hash_436a9596c3543677: ^<Pyotr: ^7Field report. Lost contact with unit but continue to gather samples until comrades are reacquired.
hash_2c3f95bae02459ee: ^<Pyotr: ^7Atmospheric readings match crystal radiation signature. So this stuff is everywhere. Personal contamination remains in safety range.
hash_5961a621db4ea8e5: ^<Pyotr: ^7Four hostile contacts today. I killed three with small arms fire. The other I...avoided. May attempt engaging after I find my squad.
hash_3bcfc5951469bd44: ^<Pyotr: ^7There is much to explore here. Stand by for additional reports.
hash_8bc969cac051df6: ^<Pyotr: ^7It was supposed to be over quickly -- in and out. But I was separated from the rest of my unit before our extraction.
hash_7d408f248b48593f: ^<Pyotr: ^7By the time I got to the exfil point, the equipment had been smashed to pieces. This radio is the only thing still functional.
hash_1eb3bf27c3ffb92c: ^<Pyotr: ^7There may be no way back for me now, but I will do my duty till my last breath.
hash_3df6cea4f2670419: ^<Pyotr: ^7Like most souls here, I have stayed away from others since I arrived. But over the last few months I have seen ever larger groups congregating in the valleys. I hear their chants echo through the eternal night.
hash_5c0d990aa6376e60: ^<Pyotr: ^7I have not seen it, but I know it is there. I've seen the destruction left in its wake...swathes of trees...snapped and broken as though they were twigs.
hash_470c3de6ff273891: ^<Pyotr: ^7It moves with purpose, but it is not a purpose I understand. I have not seen it. I hope I never do.
hash_35027bc36f005d7b: ^<Pyotr: ^7I met an old comrade this morning. His unit were among the first of our soldiers to pass through to this world.
hash_63f41ebfa87a75d2: ^<Pyotr: ^7I fear he has lost his mind, as he mostly rambled incoherently, speaking words I could not understand.
hash_4afa8c4e86fc82e9: ^<Pyotr: ^7From the little I could make out, he claims to have been here for many months. This is not possible. He deployed only one week before I did.
hash_49eb029efadbd96a: ^<Pyotr: ^7I have heard its guttural roar echo through the forests like a wounded animal screaming out in pain. I fear they are becoming an army.
hash_6e74822c1f1be0f2: ^8Maxis: ^7It's late here in Berlin -- and it's cold, so I'm going to make this brief. Everything is so much worse than I thought. Sorry, Weaver -- how's your day going?
hash_1b2336db954d4cab: ^8Maxis: ^7I'm going to be frank. I'm not sure who the hell I can trust at the BND. There's an atmosphere. People are leaving. New people are coming in...and I'm not sure how much choice any of them have in it.
hash_cf017226f7125f8: ^8Maxis: ^7Point is, something seems to have everyone spooked and looking over their shoulder. Cold War paranoia -- who'd have thought it?
hash_6468b6bb93f3bdf1: ^8Maxis: ^7All I know for sure is there's a project file called..."Endstation."
hash_d7298bc32a47b89: ^8Maxis: ^7I'm hearing that something has lit a fire under the KGB's metaphorical ass. Something they found out about Endstation.
hash_def0544c2fc9470: ^8Maxis: ^7There are -- shall we say "extremists"? -- within their ranks that are pushing a new agenda. Their department thinks they might have uncovered something that could be a game changer for the Cold War.
hash_44c4c28dde4bd2a3: ^8Maxis: ^7All I know for certain is that they've allocated a huge amount of resources to fund a ground operation in Poland...
hash_73573bd1a0112c2a: ^8Maxis: ^7What worries me more is I have no idea who around me I can really trust. Some here may already be working with them. They may even be listening in...
hash_1546f4659ab7c108: ^8Maxis: ^7So, this is the last you'll hear from me. For a while.
hash_43aff80a4b187c41: ^8Maxis: ^7I'm starting to feel that the walls are closing in, if you get my meaning.
hash_7eb0bd37bb664b02: ^8Maxis: ^7Two of my contacts have already been exposed. Well, I say exposed, but to be more specific one started singing as soon as he was detained. The other fell out of a window.
hash_2610541b1405a27b: ^8Maxis: ^7Before the untimely "accident," he sent me a tape. I think it's what the new department is going after...Endstation.
hash_821d8750a21ea7c: ^8Maxis: ^7An associate at the BND -- maybe the last one I can trust -- will ensure its delivery to you.
hash_21d99f2a0a70de5: ^8Maxis: ^7Right now I have no choice but to move, and burn everything in my wake. Forgive my breaches of protocol, Weaver, but these times are...unprecedented.
hash_2ef78884ed9ffe84: ^8Maxis: ^7Hey. You know me, don't you? Sure you do. Hopefully. You're part of Weaver's strike team, right? My name's Maxis. I'm a friend.
hash_2bf382b364f5ea8d: ^8Maxis: ^7Sorry to start off with some bad news, but friends need to be honest with each other, so... I have reason to believe my communication channels with Weaver are compromised.
hash_536a63e07cd3d32a: ^8Maxis: ^7I would say we do not know who is listening, but...even an idiot could probably work it out. Russians.
hash_24d7ea9cbb0e79a3: ^8Maxis: ^7So, I will continue to make these recordings in the hope that they may find their way to you without interference. P.S. Good luck.
hash_15fe6f984686cb47: ^8Maxis: ^7I'm going to assume you can hear me because the alternative is far too depressing to think about.
hash_47c0f8dc0b01d98e: ^8Maxis: ^7I'm...in the field. Not an actual field -- that would be silly. It's a churchyard in Romania. Don't worry, there are no vampires. Even if there were, I have garlic. And weapons.
hash_23c3201927db2341: ^8Maxis: ^7To be perfectly clear with you, I have reason to believe the BND have been compromised. So I have gone what some would term "a little bit rogue." It pretty much means I am operating without authorization or oversight.
hash_755a1c74777a6808: ^8Maxis: ^7But since I've spent the last seven years working alongside spies from both East and West, you can hardly blame me. Don't worry. I know my scorpions from my frogs.
hash_6237c29f0c8497b: ^8Maxis: ^7This experiment -- Endstation. If I'm right, it may really be the turning point the Russians believe it to be. We have to stop them.
hash_69f2cee50cee4fc6: ^8Maxis: ^7I was the one. I'm the reason you're here. I gave Weaver the Russian intel about the site in Poland...and told him how much the Russians were interested in it.
hash_1588a25db8084f9f: ^8Maxis: ^7Right now, I'm operating on the theory that they knew that there was something big here -- an unnatural power they could perhaps harness, and turn upon their enemies. Something no nation could be prepared for.
hash_2357817909233180: ^8Maxis: ^7Wait. Has Weaver even told you about the extent of the Outbreak Zones?
hash_554383f1fb8f0d1: ^8Maxis: ^7Hate to break it to you, but this event isn't an isolated incident. Russian forces are mobilizing in multiple locations across the world, and right now you're weeks -- if not months -- behind them.
hash_44c65d2760f64d8: ^8Maxis: ^7I wasn't sure at first but now I know who they are -- a little known offshoot of the KGB known as the Omega Group.
hash_4bee85ab23825c17: ^8Maxis: ^7I'd seen mention of their activities a few times over the years, but I'd never given it much credence...up until recently.
hash_539c32ae530c7090: ^8Maxis: ^7So right now, I'm looking at the big, bad Russian boogeyman that we know as Omega, and then, on the other side, there's you: a CIA-backed department known as Requiem.
hash_299093523d8d63a9: ^8Maxis: ^7You know much about them? Or do you just follow orders? I suspect the latter, and I thank you for your service.
hash_229d0f15e3b0b916: ^8Maxis: ^7This isn't me ragging on your operation. God knows me and Weaver got a history and a whole lot in common. But there's always the question...the worry...of divided loyalties.
hash_4b0375fcebf0dc6f: ^8Maxis: ^7Weaver's half Russian. I'm German. Who were you fighting in World War Two? You sure you know who the enemy is now?
hash_4273f04ac37b7124: ^8Maxis: ^7This is a new landscape. None of this is what any of us are used to.
hash_16e17fb7e2868ead: ^8Maxis: ^7I'm going to do my part while you do yours. I think there's a lot more to this than we know.
hash_7b601dedf2ea9f3: ^8Maxis: ^7I want you to know that I've been in your shoes, and you can trust Weaver. He is a good man to have in your corner. A good boss.
hash_97b9f6e89266cba: ^8Maxis: ^7Back in the '70s West Germany was a major investor and supplier to Iran. In exchange for oil and gas, we propped up their steel industry and aided their nuclear power program.
hash_65c7d7dec1a74bdd: ^8Maxis: ^7I was there in '79 when the revolution kicked off. Western intelligence agencies coordinated with the CIA to ensure the Shah's safe extraction to the US, but a lot of diplomats and citizens weren't so lucky. Me included.
hash_3e6750fb69065c94: ^8Maxis: ^7If it wasn't for Weaver's intervention and willingness to go off the books, I'd be a forgotten memory by now.
hash_199565758ac42bdf: ^8Maxis: ^7Trust him. Trust me. For now, I'm going to have to go dark. I'm en route to meet a contact in Southeast Asia. He says he knows exactly what Omega Group is planning.
hash_383f377228391863: ^<Kalashnik: ^7Whatever is down here, Geiger counter does not approve.
hash_30270b0b3446966d: ^<Dmitriyev: ^7Kalashnik. Have you ever seen such machinery?
hash_28a7d64ae0c33d8b: ^<Dmitriyev: ^7You there! By big machine! Surrender! I said surrender!
hash_2a905040941d1b93: ^<Lazarev: ^7Zdravstvuyte. My name is Pavel Lazarev. I was sent to contain this mess, and you are going to help me. Comrade, state your name...
hash_173e534a02dd2924: ^<Zykov: ^7Kazimir Zykov. Starshina. 1st Guards Tank Army. I, ah...I am mechanic.
hash_382a550309a4b3ad: ^<Lazarev: ^7I was told, despite your limited education, you understand German equipment.
hash_4f6db190bc95687e: ^<Zykov: ^7Well, I...scavenge parts from Panzer tanks to keep our T-34s running. How can I be of service, comrade Lazarev?
hash_753d36588bca2b97: ^<Lazarev: ^7There is a machine I need you to deactivate. It is called a "cyclotron." It leaks...strange radiation. You have seen what it does to men.
hash_6b84ef218aef6840: ^<Zykov: ^7Da, Colonel. What if same thing happens to me?
hash_631abb16671ac111: ^<Lazarev: ^7You will not fail, Zykov. You may not survive, but you will not fail. Understood?
hash_fd3aa42f6c12ccb: ^<Lazarev: ^7Congratulations, tovarisch. You are going to be a Hero of the Soviet Union.
hash_3dd03a21bfc36f6c: ^<Zykov: ^7My dearest Raisa. It is me -- your Kazimir. I am sorry to break my promise, but I will not be coming home to you.
hash_77bbf0c32e1061d: ^<Zykov: ^7I have orders to turn off a German machine. Diesel engines I understand. Radios I can fix. But this...?
hash_75eb67355e017266: ^<Zykov: ^7The things down here tried to kill me. Perhaps they already have. But not before I finish my mission. I cut all power, but still the machine runs. And I swear...sometimes...I hear it call my name...
hash_79c4de8b43a04267: ^<Zykov: ^7I am going to try one more thing...if the dead will let me. I have tools, but not many bullets...
hash_41662076979b66c8: ^<Zykov: ^7That svoloch Colonel who ordered me down here...I do not do this for him. I do this for the world. For Mother Russia. I do this for you, Raisa.
hash_13181c1c0f9fc779: ^<Zykov: ^7My love for you will never die.
hash_2df6f4a4b27022f: ^9Valentina: ^7This is Dr. Aleksandra Valentina, Psychotronics Research Lead for Omega Group. It is the 1st of November, 1983.
hash_5d342bdbf364404e: ^9Valentina: ^7I have just given the order to reactivate the Projekt Endstation particle accelerator. It is a monumental moment in Soviet history. Some, including myself, might even call it a turning point.
hash_27f60df4c1a45641: ^9Valentina: ^7Two officers have volunteered for the task. Their courage and sacrifice represent the pinnacle of Soviet strength. Their names will be echoed through Lubyanka's halls. They will be remembered as heroes.
hash_96e60cbb403ddc0: ^9Valentina: ^7It has all happened so quickly. Four months of research, testing, planning and staging. I must thank Chairman Chebrikov, Chairman Andropov and the rest of the Politburo. Without their support, Operation Undertaker would not have been possible.
hash_24709beae47bc283: ^9Valentina: ^7With the cyclotron's reactivation, not only will we reopen the dimensional gate first discovered by the Germans forty years ago...but also additional dimensional gates around the globe.
hash_2ad342cdd6d92712: ^9Valentina: ^7With these new gateways opened, we will proceed to Phase 2 and begin the real work: research of this new dimension, and the development of new technologies.
hash_487fa056ef26d455: ^9Valentina: ^7These technologies will be critical to our future. It is the turning point that will put us well ahead of our enemies in the West.
hash_2994b73aa5f3a534: ^9Valentina: ^7We were the first. We are the last.
hash_6656fe8e2af63f86: ^9Peck: ^7Operation Undertaker has been declared a..."resounding" success. Intel has reported in from around the globe. We have confirmed the existence of multiple dimensional gates.
hash_6fee962cb638426d: ^9Peck: ^7To the surprise of many, including myself, it appears Dr. Valentina's hypothesis was correct. In fact, her results have surpassed expectations.
hash_5aae270ec7dee8cf: ^9Peck: ^7But now we're on to Phase 2, where my expertise comes into play. I've received a report that a live specimen has already been acquired and transported to my facility for analysis.
hash_1237c937082dc082: ^9Peck: ^7The organisms of this other world are unlike anything I've seen. There is so much we can learn from them. It's not just the creatures, it's these crystalline growths.
hash_c6e1a5ae7c9df49: ^9Peck: ^7The Colonel wants weapons? Why stop there? We can do so much more.
hash_4a3db1a638d4d5b8: ^<Kurtz: ^7I have completed my adjustments, Dr. Vogel. You may begin recording.
hash_2dcd7ea6cba3243e: ^<Vogel: ^7Thank you, I already have. This is Ulrich Vogel, director of Projekt Endstation. 7th of March, 1944. 10:03 p.m. Commencing cyclotron test run number twelve. Dr. Kurtz, please proceed.
hash_7117125a0ce1e226: ^<Kurtz: ^7All readings are within acceptable parameters. Looks like we are getting the collisions we expected and...um...some interesting patterns are starting to--
hash_7a497cdb96b3b64: ^<Kurtz: ^7I do not know. Gauges are red-lining. We have to shut down!
hash_4d07cb4762fa7222: ^<Vogel: ^7Mein Gott! What is happening to the air around the collider?!
hash_101eac70ec6507b6: ^<Vogel: ^7Guards! Retreat! Seal those things in the chamber!
hash_6697236f15feaa28: ^<Vogel: ^7Ulrich Vogel, director of Projekt Endstation. 12th of March, 1944. Five days have passed since the accident, and I am starting to see it not as a setback, but a breakthrough. Literally.
hash_7103cb47d5e66e61: ^<Vogel: ^7The cyclotron continues to operate, apparently without an external power source. We cannot deactivate it, and it is still manifesting the strange phenomenon I call a "rift" and Kurtz calls a "wormhole."
hash_782f3aab85b51062: ^<Vogel: ^7We attached instruments to the end of a long metal pole and passed it through the rift. The readings confirm that somehow the cyclotron ripped through the fabric of spacetime.
hash_51e88d9d0f163f43: ^<Vogel: ^7Something lies on the other side. A parallel world or perhaps a whole universe. But we dare not approach too closely, lest we suffer the same fate as the men currently held in our medical clinic.
hash_463add0023e16e74: ^<Vogel: ^7Those men remain in a state best described as "living death." Kurtz thinks they caught a high dose of some exotic radiation from the other side of the rift. We are checking their blood and tissue samples for traces of rare elements or otherworldly pathogens.
hash_ad7ad349f3d7b0d: ^<Vogel: ^7I pray, whatever it is, it is not contagious.
hash_2b726b4bad8ecda9: ^<Vogel: ^7Vogel. 16th of March, 1944. We have finally isolated an unknown element in the men who were transformed by the cyclotron accident. And even at this early stage, it is clearly a remarkable substance.
hash_4d63e6e8d633a210: ^<Vogel: ^7For now, we have classified it as "exo-element one." Kurtz suggested "Vogelium." *tsk* Such an ass-kisser.
hash_3b1d62de55e65ceb: ^<Vogel: ^7The current theory is that, at sufficient concentrations, exo-element one triggers the horrific transformations experienced by the men closest to the cyclotron rift.
hash_4b09cceddfced80a: ^<Vogel: ^7I am currently designing a chamber to withdraw exo-element one from the occupant. My hope is to somehow purify the men and reverse their necrotic condition.
hash_30172d37d9e671b5: ^<Vogel: ^7If we can learn to control the necrotization process, I believe it could be weaponized. Imagine: an army of unkillable soldiers. Even at this late point in the war, I may have found the key to saving the Reich.
hash_376f54f9fc5cd352: ^<Vogel: ^7Dr. Kurtz. You have memorized the new orders, yes? Did you burn after reading?
hash_8bf51b0a2b8b1d4: ^<Kurtz: ^7Ja, Vogel. And I thought security was tight before the accident. Do you think we can actually accomplish what the Reichstag is asking for?
hash_568a8aa4c32cf4d8: ^<Vogel: ^7I would not have suggested it if I did not think it achievable. But let us guard against overconfidence.
hash_5b1916ce511bdb51: ^<Vogel: ^7If we do not deliver, they will find someone who can. And I am not about to give up control of this discovery.
hash_3db581e79f4e7a2e: ^<Vogel: ^7All we need is to send through a few volunteers to measure the specific relativistic differential--
hash_7379d7e5fbbe5568: ^<Kurtz: ^7Volunteers?! Would you take on such a task?
hash_59858c8d3f5986e4: ^<Vogel: ^7Mind your words, Dr. Kurtz. I would hate for someone to question your commitment.
hash_711a7f84365b44ca: ^<Vogel: ^7What we do now will ensure the Chancellor's dream of a thousand-year Reich. There must be a record.
hash_4bcf298ee75dda48: ^8Weaver: ^7Strike team. Weaver here. I understand this has been a lot to take in. Interdimensional breaches all over the world, an infection transforming people into the undead, not exactly a great two weeks for any of us.
hash_771397afe2b68c79: ^8Weaver: ^7Requiem had to react quickly. The same day I was personally requested to run Field Ops, I was ordered to assemble a short-list of operatives. That's you guys.
hash_2abbe1facaece9ba: ^8Weaver: ^7Here's what we know. Two weeks ago, a KGB-Spetsnaz unit known as Omega Group came here and reactivated its particle accelerator. Their actions caused the Outbreak Zones we're now seeing around the world. This place is ground zero.
hash_1904d1a54141c113: ^8Weaver: ^7Why they did it and to what end --that's what we're going to figure out.
hash_27c8f3a90488c58c: ^8Weaver: ^7We lost two teams before learning about this site. Make their sacrifices count. Let's get some answers.
hash_5574b391867b573d: ^8Weaver: ^7Oh, one more thing. Don't be surprised if the other Division Leads contact you, introduce themselves. They're experts in their field, so show some respect and play nice.
hash_465280fbe2d2da5d: ^8Carver: ^7Strike team, do you read me? Finally, a strong signal. I know the circumstances are less than ideal, but allow me to formally introduce myself. I am Major Mackenzie Carver. My friends call me Mac. You will not.
hash_1e605e1c68f1b684: ^8Carver: ^7And yes, I am that Major Carver. Most likely, all the stories you've heard are true. But that is in the past. I'm a firm believer in living in the now and preparing for the future.
hash_161f11031829f457: ^8Carver: ^7As you may well know, I head up Requiem's Containment and Security Division. It's a post I personally requested.
hash_10fa613b2bf35e1e: ^8Carver: ^7Make no mistake -- we are at war. This is chess. And the Soviets' Omega Group? They just moved their queen into position.
hash_6423ecc9daebdfe1: ^8Carver: ^7They're the ones who opened these portals, and you bet your ass it's to get some sort of tactical advantage over us.
hash_4f4f8193b6136922: ^8Carver: ^7This is an entirely new dimension we're dealing with. The technology it could potentially offer is unfathomable.
hash_7af0dcdd64d9a04b: ^8Carver: ^7We may have nukes, but what if your enemy uses an interdimensional weapon -- something we can't anticipate and counter? This is the new Arms Race and we've already fallen behind.
hash_7ff0018c81193c38: ^8Carver: ^7Now look, I got nothing against these eggheads and their...scientific pursuits.
hash_12d80214e959b31: ^8Carver: ^7I'm just here to make sure DOD gets what's rightfully theirs. That includes Strauss and his Aetherium crystals. If we're to regain the advantage over our enemy, we need to act fast, and make sure these science-types don't keep anything from us. Don't let me down.
hash_21d5c3bd73dcfbf6: ^8Strauss: ^7"There are precious few things in the world more valuable than knowledge -- and one of those is the ability to know how and when to utilize said knowledge." Do you know who said that?
hash_133b054b20440907: ^8Strauss: ^7I did not think so. Dr. Vogel, the scientist in charge of Projekt Endstation, said it to me some forty years ago when I was employed at this very facility.
hash_4982bc98364dc314: ^8Strauss: ^7I know you have your suspicions about me. I hear what your type says about me in the halls. "Mein Gott. Is that Doctor Oskar Strauss, former Nazi scientist? They put him in charge of Energy Research? It is so horrible."
hash_1c2fc8bb0f2fdc65: ^8Strauss: ^7To this I have two things to say. One: I was never a fucking Nazi. I am, and always have been, a man of science trying to survive in a nasty, despicable world. Two: I do not care if you have your suspicions. All I care is if you are able to follow your orders.
hash_28b3e1138f4c0b91: ^8Strauss: ^7This energy source. The Germans called it "exo-element one." I call it by its proper name...Aetherium. It has the potential to revolutionize the world in ways we cannot possibly comprehend.
hash_204088fbf1fb7770: ^8Strauss: ^7I will understand these crystals. And I will learn the how and when to utilize it. I hope, if nothing else, you can appreciate that.
hash_484d6864f8aad053: ^8Strauss: ^7All I ask is that if you let me do my job, I will let you do yours.
hash_4b8704d823c93c2: ^8Strauss: ^7There is no need to be enemies. In fact, one day I hope we can work together, side by side. Perhaps we will even consider each other comrades.
hash_6649e536f8865955: ^8Strauss: ^7Just do not expect a warm hug when you return from your missions.
hash_745d0a94a66a6850: ^8Grey: ^7Strike team? You there? 'Course you are. Sorry, I'm a bit new to all this. Hopefully you don't mind the less-than-formal approach.
hash_1fca9346a001fa89: ^8Grey: ^7Should probably introduce myself. My name is Doctor Elizabeth Grey, head of Unnatural Sciences, and this is about as unnatural a Sunday as I can remember.
hash_41cda61a9086e1ba: ^8Grey: ^7Normally about now I'd be sitting in my lab in Bristol, having a good natter with Pip and Sam, two macaques I work with, over a nice cup of tea. Then, just BAM -- this whole thing happens.
hash_72b31385deea5ddb: ^8Grey: ^7Next thing I know, I'm drafted by the bloody government to be their representative in this new organization, Requiem. I mean, how could I pass that up?
hash_5842883c7d00c274: ^8Grey: ^7Sure, the name sounds a bit ominous, but think of the opportunity, the potential discoveries that await us in this new reality -- there's a chance I could end up changing the world.
hash_464e4285a746722f: ^8Grey: ^7Yes, I know it seems like the proverbial "Dimension of Death" has opened right in our back garden, but there's real life to it -- and that's including the infected undead.
hash_664f9a9d094ae86e: ^8Grey: ^7The untapped potential of this discovery, this Aetherium...it could provide us with the tools to grow, evolve even, as a people and a society.
hash_330c90d101fb07d: ^8Grey: ^7Imagine that: no more war. Or at the very least less war. Put you out of a job though, wouldn't it? No offense, of course.
hash_58221d86a06db42c: ^<Fedorov: ^7Adrik Fedorov, efreitor, Omega Group. My squad just returned from the dark place. Well...not all of us did.
hash_598ccbaec179a339: ^<Fedorov: ^7They send us to gather Aetherium crystals. It is like...picking wildflowers in Hell.
hash_7ad2ef8e68373f2: ^<Fedorov: ^7And of course we say "yes" because we are Spetsnaz. Refusal is not an option. Not if you want to maintain your career.
hash_47a7492da856f747: ^<Fedorov: ^7It has not gone well. I have lost more friends here than I did in Afghanistan. No career is worth that.
hash_21625b3338c1c128: ^<Fedorov: ^7If this is what it takes for me to make sergeant, I can only guess what the Colonel has done to get where he is.
hash_27b3f2a0a5623ec5: ^<Fedorov: ^7I was a different man when I enlisted. I wanted to travel as far from home as possible. And I feared nothing.
hash_55b312931ad41f5e: ^<Fedorov: ^7This mission has cured me of both.
hash_fe24977d2357251: ^<Koslov: ^7Ivan Koslov. Prisoner number 136-778. I was transferred here from Perm-35 labor camp last month.
hash_84d771108e5d0bc: ^<Koslov: ^7Somehow, I have survived five trips into the darkness to gather their fucking crystals. Five.
hash_290283bd4efb266b: ^<Koslov: ^7That bastard American doctor even called me "Lucky Ivan." *spits*
hash_5c5879565e9a2ece: ^<Koslov: ^7They forced us through his gateway at gunpoint. Shot the first man who dared to say "nyet." So in go nine of us. Only Lucky Ivan comes back.
hash_68e26ac7dd41d02d: ^<Koslov: ^7And now? I am in this hellish place on trip number six and...I cannot find the exit. Did they close it? Did they get tired of waiting for me?
hash_7467bb33fb051288: ^<Koslov: ^7These crystals are heavy. I do not know where I am. And I know something out there is watching me.
hash_1e98783ebe69e1a4: ^<Tobias: ^7Tobias Hoffman, sergeant. I was captured on a covert mission in the DDR. My superiors had to deny they ever heard of me.
hash_7d79f2a196788151: ^<Tobias: ^7The Stasi interrogated me. I gave them nothing. So they threw me in a Dresden prison for two years.
hash_1f347e671d923c0a: ^<Tobias: ^7And now a KGB unit I never heard of before has me hunting verdammt monsters in this nightmare world they have discovered.
hash_254a3258315cab37: ^<Tobias: ^7They brought other prisoners -- political dissidents and common criminals -- to gather strange minerals from this place.
hash_5565831b3885daf0: ^<Tobias: ^7But I have skills the others do not, so they make me hunt "specimens" for their American scientist.
hash_1401fc8e5d01bdad: ^<Tobias: ^7It makes sense: why risk their own soldiers when they have someone as utterly expendable as me?
hash_7d958248c156de06: ^<Tobias: ^7So I kill their specimens and drag them back for study. The American is giddy with these new playthings. He promises to reward me, but I know his words are empty.
hash_21d04724f3f94d3: ^<Tobias: ^7Strange man. I swear he feels more...kinship for these creatures than he does for other people.
hash_234791bf70654ecc: ^<Tobias: ^7Truth be told, I do not hate this work. Dangerous, yes, but better than rotting in a jail cell.
hash_3ff3ba3ff93d703c: ^<Olga: ^7My name is...Olga. It is Olga... Olga...
hash_5d8c37e3c5ed4fb9: ^<Olga: ^7Damn it. I cannot remember last name. *coughs*
hash_5558a2ded0b45d2e: ^<Olga: ^7I was pulled out of labor camp to mine crystals. I was...healthy then. But...*coughs/growls*...I think crystals...make me sick.
hash_7cf17b9b3f9ce613: ^<Olga: ^7First came nightmares. I am chair. I am box. I am table. *wheezes* Maybe does not seem scary, but it is.
hash_6f3b9ea971629cf0: ^<Olga: ^7Then came fevers...and pain. Now parts of skin look like wood. Look like brick. Is different every morning.
hash_35793f8d24d471cd: ^<Olga: ^7Bones are crooked. They bend...like rubber. And hair is...sticking together like...tails of rats.
hash_56b7ccc37f1c1b2: ^<Olga: ^7Am I...falling apart? *wheezes* Or am I turning into...something else?
hash_30f320b41a6417e0: ^<Fedorov: ^7Fedorov, Omega Group. We have been reassigned from Aetherium mining duties. That task now falls to...vermin. Enemies of the state.
hash_34f41ed88ee1dcdd: ^<Fedorov: ^7But now they expect us to map the "Dark Aether" -- that is what Peck calls this place. I would like to see him try to survey this... madness.
hash_39fd1a285042c176: ^<Fedorov: ^7I have seen things out here. Unspeakable things. And today...bozhe moi.
hash_5a365e39d34a359b: ^<Fedorov: ^7Usually, large groups of the infected are...chaotic. Mindless mobs. But today I found hundreds of them strangely grouped.
hash_633809c236d6b664: ^<Fedorov: ^7And their clothing...were they uniforms? I dared not get too close, but they looked like...
hash_159bf130dee967f1: ^<Fedorov: ^7No. No, that cannot be right. It surely cannot be.
hash_426823ba96cb586a: ^<Fedorov: ^7This place, it plays tricks on you. I...I just need to get some sleep...
hash_1cc9356bf2061f9e: ^8Maxis: ^7I will. Soon. Stay safe. You will hear from me again.
hash_105c8a37093e9312: ^8Maxis: ^7Yes. I received the files, but I have not reviewed them. My situation is... Changing.
hash_45f5ec4db371bca4: ^<Ravenov: ^7You are no longer with the BND?
hash_1391e11a946d648c: ^8Maxis: ^7Let's just say I am more of a free agent now. There are many spies and traitors within our National institutions.
hash_75736c995d5ef65e: ^8Maxis: ^7Which leads me to wonder - Why are you a traitor? I have seen your record - A founding member of the KGB counter terrorist detachment, Alpha Group. You took part in operations across the globe - Central America, the Caribbean, Angola, Afghanistan.
hash_2bad8807faf7ff0: ^<Ravenov: ^7Yes, I am a loyal soldier of the Soviet Union. I have done questionable things - terrible things. But I am no traitor.
hash_3b7f5d2717266721: ^<Ravenov: ^7If you knew who was running Omega - and I believe you already do - you would not even have to ask me that question. I am not a traitor to my country. Despite their slogans and mantras, Omega are not who we are.
hash_1e187145bcd6923: ^<Ravenov: ^7Look at the files. Learn something of their 'work' - There you will find your answers as to why I am choosing to do what I am doing.
hash_40a0526296b252e8: ^8Maxis: ^7I am troubled in ways I was not yesterday.
hash_6562c919ea3899a1: ^8Maxis: ^7The information I have received from the Soviet informant has confirmed that Omega's plans are further advanced than even I had feared previously.
hash_32dba1e1b55dfaee: ^8Maxis: ^7Omega's 'leader' clearly seeks to control the bridges between this... and the other world. He may well be succeeding.
hash_6144a58665beb627: ^8Maxis: ^7Their internal propaganda claims to offer men the opportunity to become heroic explorers of a brave new frontier... Like the cosmonauts whose first journeys into space shocked the world.
hash_7f44144aec6eaa5c: ^8Maxis: ^7Even if they had a 'choice', these men have little idea or understanding of the fate that awaits them. The horror laid out in the other documents makes clear the truth of their 'glorious contributions'.
hash_560562b0f4ec6e45: ^8Maxis: ^7They - like so many before them - are being used. They are miners at the coal face - stricken by blackened lungs - Not cosmonauts reaching for the stars.
hash_20628e475a84b562: ^8Maxis: ^7Their bodies. Their minds. Their very souls. All of it will be ravaged in Omega's relentless pursuit to harness Aetherium.
hash_2717b2a4bf650544: ^9Peck: ^7Friends are overrated. They can't pay the bills.
hash_3c3400dda110e4c9: ^8Maxis: ^7You do realize the Milgram experiment only showed how subservient people could be... When challenged by an authority figure.
hash_3b827e3710cd2324: ^9Peck: ^7Well, You're very perceptive Ms. Maxis. Even with the blindfold.
hash_7211af1aa0dc7b6f: ^8Maxis: ^7I thought I smelled bullshit as soon as the door opened, but no. It's just the cheap aftershave. It can't disguise the stink of your sweat.
hash_7d416e6a8ec17305: ^9Peck: ^7This 'environment' is more humid than I would like. It's worse than Baton Rouge at the height of summer.
hash_6982296878671024: ^8Maxis: ^7We're not here to discuss your sartorial failings. Let's get this over with.
hash_47fcb5de8bad9a7b: ^9Peck: ^7Over with? No, my dear. Nothing is ending any time soon. Not for you. Not for me.
hash_71ebb6cfb0c4297e: ^9Peck: ^7Besides the restraints on your wrists and ankles, you feel the electrodes on your body - yes? Of course you do. You're a smart girl.
hash_44dba4faf3598579: ^9Peck: ^7Who is your informant? Who told you of our work here? Who was it who dared betrayed me?
hash_2539cd7925424a48: ^8Maxis: ^7Does it bother you? Not having any friends?
hash_2d19ad752967f4b7: ^<Ravenov: ^7It is not fun being on the run - But you know that better than anyone.
hash_11ebdce503705de1: ^<Ravenov: ^7Omega's operations are expanding rapidly - in the way we feared most.
hash_2e1f82c0a07f5bb0: ^<Ravenov: ^7We have noticed an uptick in activity deep in the Ural Mountains - More people coming in every day. There's talk of a... 'special operation'.
hash_6e10ce421b830a76: ^8Maxis: ^7I really do hope that you can hear me.
hash_de7af76fb4dc284: ^8Maxis: ^7Please answer. I know you are listening.
hash_3070e09751b0666a: ^8Maxis: ^7I don't know how long I've been waiting for an answer, but I haven't had one yet.
hash_3cb5efd57499fe3: ^8Maxis: ^7I know you are there. I know.
hash_646ffce0a1dc79c4: ^8Maxis: ^7But I am here, and I have been waiting for a long time.
hash_39cb2191509d26cd: ^8Maxis: ^7How long, I don't know. The days are blurred. The nights are relentless.
hash_6c272406e2b1d9b6: ^8Maxis: ^7Is it a week? Is it a month? More?
hash_315c104589421c72: ^8Maxis: ^7I used to have nightmares about them and I told myself I was being foolish.
hash_13d05ecdf998daec: ^8Maxis: ^7I'm not scared. I have overcome much worse things.
hash_48c3277fac7d7237: ^8Maxis: ^7I will take their power from them by using it.
hash_714a87e687fada3e: ^8Maxis: ^7Now. I hide in shadows. Like they did when I was a child.
hash_4fd7a53bd9976178: ^8Maxis: ^7I do what I need to in order to survive.
hash_60f6b808c21f7875: ^8Maxis: ^7Why do I care what they think of me?
hash_2f2be18d4b2c0ad2: ^8Maxis: ^7I'm just sorry they do not really know me.
hash_3875affcdf41d703: ^8Maxis: ^7I used to worry that morning would never come.
hash_3c8bc6d5815c1c0a: ^8Maxis: ^7But now, I choose to embrace the darkness...
hash_1709ccd24349c07e: ^8Maxis: ^7When I opened my eyes. There was blood on my hands. I stared at it not knowing if it was mine.
hash_18119f3eecf34c77: ^8Maxis: ^7Then I saw the bodies. Omega soldiers. They looked like victims of a frenzied attack. An attack that continued even after they were dead.
hash_78fdea2797cb23b8: ^8Maxis: ^7I have a knife. I do not remember where it came from.
hash_34da294f533b57f: ^8Maxis: ^7This is a dream. A bad dream. It has to be.
hash_14801efcf425ca6: ^8Maxis: ^7That's what I tell myself. Even if it isn't true.
hash_3e18b0446b11838a: ^8Maxis: ^7I pray that they are the same thing.
hash_3a6bd78c89271266: ^8Maxis: ^7I see what I have written and I barely recognize it.
hash_575c882fc08bd7bd: ^8Maxis: ^7I was on a mission. I am still on a mission.
hash_1442d01e6d123758: ^8Maxis: ^7I have written these names over and over.
hash_20ae045cd46b49e1: ^8Maxis: ^7I don't know how or why, but I am remembering.
hash_34008c6ea29f81d1: ^8Maxis: ^7He deserves whatever damnation I have brought upon him.
hash_4d1c95f6cea2e928: ^8Maxis: ^7I was angry before and I am so sorry.
hash_6a5be91a9acdd667: ^8Maxis: ^7That wasn't me. If it was - It really wasn't who I wanted to be.
hash_3aa4825c73cb569c: ^8Maxis: ^7I'm sorry. I'm so, so sorry. I wish I could have kept you safe.
hash_5baec98a44b918a2: ^8Maxis: ^7Maybe that anger made me do things.
hash_27e12bf37b9c1d70: ^8Maxis: ^7I may regret some -- but others, others I meant to do.
hash_71695d2ba54cc030: ^9Peck: ^7Personal Log. Peck. November 9th, 1983. Two days ago, I identified and submitted the *perfect* location for Phase 2.
hash_4ed1ba134002a31d: ^9Peck: ^7After assessing the dimensional breach outside of Khe Sanh, I found a mountaintop formerly occupied by an American base called "Ripcord." It has the ideal dimensional... *fertility* to suit our project's needs.
hash_76da449f7afb7136: ^9Peck: ^7I just received word an agreement was reached with the Vietnamese Government, and construction is set to begin on the 11th. What excellent news.
hash_44b8e9063a788493: ^9Peck: ^7So far, the breaches have been uncontrolled, which greatly restricted our ability to take advantage of this new dimension--
hash_eb8b15d864fe67c: ^9Peck: ^7--BUT. But... if we are able to open our own, stabilized gateway, that operates under our control...
hash_49dd606d73fa60b9: ^9Peck: ^7Well, I mean, come on! We'll be the first with free reign to pilfer, pillage and plunder an alien world, untainted and ripe with resources ready for extraction.
hash_5026407cb031ea32: ^9Peck: ^7It will give us a considerable edge over my former countrymen. Good riddance to them.
hash_698b34c2cdb64a77: ^9Peck: ^7This Dr. William Peck. It is the 8th of January, 1984, 1:13 a.m. This is test number 32 for dimensional breach--
hash_2906bd871ed1a26b: ^9Peck: ^7Let it ride, Dimitri, let it ride! Increasing voltage output.
hash_1d1f844365a04405: ^9Kuhlklay: ^7Amplification exceeding safety parameters!! I'm shutting it down!
hash_441e0d826bb9575: ^9Peck: ^7You touch that button I'll have you gutted like a fish and fed to your comrades in Solyanka soup! Membrane integrity down to ten percent!
hash_7455496402a57477: ^9Peck: ^7Wait! Adjusting distortion frequency to pattern echo-four!
hash_25950b7d06bb0fb1: ^9Peck: ^7Eat your heart out, Dr. Vogel. We'll see who history remembers.
hash_1cb493590d844cd3: ^9Kuhlklay: ^7--Must you start with that every recording--
hash_1acaf6dbd1cbe5b1: ^9Peck: ^7--do not interrupt, Dimitri. This is your chance to learn something from a real Scientist.
hash_62f11c04ae909094: ^9Peck: ^7As I was saying. Test Number 32. "Doctor" Kuhlklay, you may proceed.
hash_12556fa230b11a05: ^9Kuhlklay: ^7Amplification is still approaching the limits prematurely!
hash_6f90e476fb35af62: ^9Peck: ^7It's working! Membrane integrity at forty percent!
hash_2b1e77e5ac8afc02: ^9Peck: ^7Peck here. Personal log. March 19th. After weeks of phasic misalignment, resulting in numerous... *anatomical* displacements, today marked our first successful teleportation test. I'm sure Private Pashkov was happy to arrive with all parts... intact.
hash_7394d5bd6c3c244f: ^9Peck: ^7After the generators last month, this marks the second milestone achievement for Outpost 25.
hash_6ffb75b02de80c8c: ^9Peck: ^7I must admit: our rapid progress is due in no small part to our Dark Aether Miners, or "Aethernauts", as the Kremlin has chosen to call them.
hash_2554c9098c271ac9: ^9Peck: ^7Dr. Kuhlklay tells me crystal collection is up nearly 240 percent. This intake volume has allowed our scientists to continue working around the clock, and is frankly, how we have accomplished this impressive feat.
hash_7f3dad3ccf537b06: ^9Peck: ^7It is true some don't return, but I am told it's a small percentage.
hash_25de181901ccf623: ^9Peck: ^7That said, many of those who do return have displayed physical and psychological symptoms, ranging from infection to amnesia. Unfortunately, these subjects, after study, must be euthanized.
hash_74efbf55f9f033c0: ^9Peck: ^7I've spoken with Kulhklay about developing a memory transference machine, give us the chance to at least recover the affected's memories.
hash_8d544db5a957ded: ^9Peck: ^7That will take time to construct, so in the interim I'm developing a truth serum to assist with interviewing the amnesiacs.
hash_5c903164d2c4cb6a: ^9Peck: ^7Maybe we can pry the truth from their damaged synapses, so their deaths won't be a total waste.
hash_263dc4d138339701: ^9Peck: ^7Proceeding with examination of upper abdomen. Dimitri: retractors.
hash_73903c4188931107: ^9Peck: ^7Organs appear... somewhat similar to our own... but everything seems merged, interlinked. Observe the lungs. Similar location, but its pleura extends and connects directly to the heart, passing through the endocardium.
hash_29381d5f0000649a: ^9Peck: ^7There appears to be... something engraved on the interior of the creature's back. What is that?
hash_5da3bf7b8c2cac68: ^9Kuhlklay: ^7Chto za chert. That. Is a face.
hash_4f30eb44c344c058: ^9Peck: ^7Yes, there does appear to be a warped, stretched pigmentation that resembles a human face.
hash_7b2bf24944c4a8b2: ^9Kuhlklay: ^7Resembles?? Look: it even has a bump where the nose should be. Wait...
hash_121c3b2281e4321f: ^9Kuhlklay: ^7Govno! It is Private Glaskov! We sent him to the other side last month, but he never come back. Is this... is this thing him??
hash_4dc19f85f3b03139: ^9Peck: ^7That last remark is to be struck from the record -- we have no proof this creature is Private Glaskov. Let's continue--
hash_129cf0760605b6fc: ^9Peck: ^7I suppose that's as good a place as any to terminate the session. Subject has turned itself into a cassette tape.
hash_6edc8dedc1d89181: ^9Kuhlklay: ^7Fucking stupid Peck! "Be quiet, Dimitri! This is a chance to learn from a real scientist!" "Dimitri, do this, Dimitri, do that. Shame on you, Dimitri, I will have you turned into soup! I'm Dr. Peck, and I'm a big, smart, real scientist."
hash_7dfbaa53a119d154: ^9Kuhlklay: ^7Fffffuck you. How about that, Pecker-man? Fuuuuuuuck you.
hash_1109b789d4d980fb: ^9Kuhlklay: ^7So I decide enough: time to work on my own invention! I take the aetherium crystal and design new rifle that would make Kalashnikov weep. And what does Peck do?
hash_fed6eb13546f11e: ^9Kuhlklay: ^7He LAUGHS. Says it is a waste of time. Calls it a child's toy. "Stop being so small-brained, Dimitri!"
hash_55b69a1612e2556d: ^9Kuhlklay: ^7Small-brained? I show will show you, Peck.
hash_ede71622d75d877: ^9Kuhlklay: ^7You are not the only smart man at this facility.
hash_655840c2d5aeed2a: ^9Kuhlklay: ^7Peck wants me to give up, probably because Peck wants to steal it for himself. Now he can never assemble it. When I leave this place, I will take it with me and sell it to the highest bidder.
hash_36fe03e9d3fbe269: ^9Kuhlklay: ^7"Maybe I underestimated you, *Doctor* Kulhklay." Of course you did, Peck. You see, I always have had a keen eye for opportunity.
hash_537a0e0459afc663: ^9Peck: ^7--that's not to say I don't have my suspicions. Once I've gathered sufficient evidence, I--
hash_5bcc28c240302d90: ^9Gorev: ^7"Highly improbable." Why do Americans talk like this? It is either truth, or not truth. Why must you be so non-committal to facts? I do not understand this.
hash_3766f02065148b8c: ^9Peck: ^7What exactly do you need from me?
hash_4d1738f6d107bbc2: ^9Gorev: ^7Orders from Colonel. And orders are simple. Pretend to be mole, plant trap, apprehend Maxis.
hash_39b213e3778508d4: ^9Gorev: ^7Interrogate her. Torture her. I don't need to know the specifics. As long as she confesses and reveals who mole is, I am happy. It is good when I am happy, yes?
hash_5654a32d0f34f646: ^9Peck: ^7--did I not say no interruptions-- Gorev?? You're here. In Vietnam.
hash_6900ae0923852ea6: ^9Gorev: ^7In the flesh, comrade. What? Old Friend cannot pay visit?
hash_4d9409db84c91e3: ^9Gorev: ^7You look so rigid, Peck, so nervous. You remind me of son, before he does his silly theater shows. He freezes up, like he sees ghosts, and forgets lines. That or he soils his pants. I trust that is not case here?
hash_1bd47169dea466d0: ^9Gorev: ^7Sit down. Please. Before you hurt self. You look rather pale, even for you. How are you not getting sun here in such temperate climate?
hash_5e0e657aceb13b42: ^9Peck: ^7May I inquire as to the purpose of your visit, Gorev?
hash_6217ac20a401da02: ^9Gorev: ^7I am here with special message, one I decided to deliver personally.
hash_4f0d1437e95eda3f: ^9Gorev: ^7We intercepted communication from BND Agent Maxis. You remember her... the leaked Endstation tape?
hash_56089d06307f32cb: ^9Peck: ^7Why would I give a rat's ass about her? Isn't she dead?
hash_4bd110f90391cdd9: ^9Gorev: ^7It is funny you say this, because not only is she very much alive, but she has turned one of your men. At this very facility. He is planning to deliver your research to Requiem.
hash_281c399b6dc01efe: ^9Peck: ^7So - 'Sam'. Do you realize what this is? Do you even know? Of course you don't, so I'll tell you. It's a gateway into the other world.
hash_5d4ac43ee9206445: ^9Peck: ^7We are made from earth, and we will return to earth... Some of us, sooner than others.
hash_534a7961a558d5d8: ^9Peck: ^7From dust you are, and to dust you will return.
hash_7e2d38aa48a98ffb: ^9Peck: ^7Have you ever even dreamt of such a thing? Have you ever imagined what it would be like if everything you knew to be true was just turned upside down? Changed forever.
hash_4f85a65ded0fa918: ^9Peck: ^7That's what this represents. It's a door to another world. One that could enrich or destroy everything depending on who holds the keys.
hash_3246d021f6f1e55a: ^9Peck: ^7Your silence isn't going to help you in any way, you know. In fact, it's just going to make things worse.
hash_4a55c4872d3705c7: ^9Peck: ^7We will find your 'informant', believe me. That's the funny thing about secrets. They can't stay secret forever. Sooner or later, they are always exposed, along with all their inherent beauty or ugliness.
hash_71b30102cdc918a4: ^9Peck: ^7You know, I don't think you realize just how small of a cog you are in this machine.
hash_4f961453d7f4f076: ^9Peck: ^7No one is coming for you, because no one cares about you.
hash_2831dadcc922ddd3: ^9Peck: ^7Honestly? I'm doing you - and the world - a favor.
hash_455325e669541f7d: ^9Peck: ^7Hello?? Hello??? Can you hear me? Is anyone there???
hash_e8c3c165f8a7810: ^9Peck: ^7The dial tells me this is the correct broadcast frequency, so I'm just going to assume you can hear me. Whichever Omega lackey happens to be receiving this transmission, start dialing the Colonel. Now.
hash_394d5d2f9c6b6df3: ^9Peck: ^7I've got a, uhhh, developing situation over here.
hash_6b6db8c8dceca796: ^9Peck: ^7Outpost 25 has fallen. Everyone here is either dead, dying, or infected. I'm the last one alive.
hash_3e70d496d5eb9719: ^9Peck: ^7I want to make this unequivocally clear: This is not my fault. It was the gateway.
hash_6012b26f5a3b705c: ^9Peck: ^7Without warning, it unleashed a massive burst of Aetherium. The infection spread quickly, and as my men began to turn, I observed a phasic barrier surround the base.
hash_650603afb51e1a5f: ^9Peck: ^7My men tried to escape, but anyone who entered this "Phase" quickly succumbed to a terrible case of death.
hash_44bab4a61224d392: ^9Peck: ^7More creatures keep arriving every hour. I'm trapped in a room with little food and only a literal pot to piss in.
hash_77d8006ca8ffee25: ^9Peck: ^7Get me the hell out of here.
hash_2586fc789a973ef1: ^9Valentina: ^7Is this everything? Surely there is more.
hash_4f3c1df1d14a3126: ^9Valentina: ^7Have it delivered to the address. Make sure you are not discovered by Peck.
hash_1d52e329dff50407: ^9Kuhlklay: ^7Believe me. He is half of the reason I am doing this.
hash_632e69ea3d1a167d: ^9Kuhlklay: ^7Why... for the good of the Motherland, of course.
hash_7f13fcfc8367e978: ^9Kuhlklay: ^7I assure you, Dr. Valentina, this is everything.
hash_55dfc89467468d5f: ^9Valentina: ^7Research on membrane permutations? What about the particle distortion modules?
hash_45b171dd54b90a02: ^9Kuhlklay: ^7Everything you need on targeted dimensional breaching is there.
hash_611ebe3ba0fd6fb3: ^9Kuhlklay: ^7You are not taking it with you?
hash_53396289b459b9c2: ^9Valentina: ^7Is there a problem with my order?
hash_5cb22392cf9cca98: ^9Valentina: ^7--thinking is a dangerous thing, is it not, comrade?
hash_7b33625da6b0e272: ^9Peck: ^7To my friends at Omega HQ: Peck here at Outpost 25, with an update on my situation. Requiem is here and, believe it or not, that's actually "good" news.
hash_6d881c2d89f3a2bf: ^9Peck: ^7"Now, why would you say that, Peck?" I can hear you ask. Well... let me explain. Do you know what I love about Requiem?
hash_6bfacaed31f421bc: ^9Peck: ^7They're idiots. And idiots are good for one thing: following instructions. Obeying without a moments hesitation. Like a lemming leaping off a cliff.
hash_4b5a4f7ae550b1f9: ^9Peck: ^7Well these little Requiem lemmings leapt right into restarting the power for me, which means I can now begin satellite transfer of all our work back to Omega HQ.
hash_1fe43c080cf02776: ^9Peck: ^7The facility may be lost, but Omega's work will live on. Don't thank me. Thank Requiem. What good. Little. Lemmings.
hash_2377e24fbc4e3af0: ^9Valentina: ^7Oh, Peck. When I heard of your situation, I cannot say I was surprised.
hash_714615e954ec0371: ^9Valentina: ^7What was it? Experiment gone wrong? Did you forget to carry "the 1" in equation? Drop deadly vial?
hash_4e916d5ec31fadbe: ^9Valentina: ^7Or was it worse? Something more sinister. How many men have you sent to their deaths in other dimension? Maybe one came back for revenge? Hmm?
hash_219ee205219b51df: ^9Valentina: ^7Rest assured, we are assessing situation. It does not look good for you.
hash_1b7229f091846de4: ^9Valentina: ^7I told them it was big risk, hiring American. They are not built to last.
hash_67dd1984c1b4a085: ^9Valentina: ^7I'll report back soon with our decision.
hash_277c18276626cf79: ^9Valentina: ^7Peck. It is Valentina again. Omega has made decision, and looks like your ace up sleeve actually worked.
hash_1983e3812ebc8ef8: ^9Valentina: ^7We are receiving your satellite transfer. Download should be complete within hour. Once it is done, you are to destroy mainframe -- ensure there is nothing left for Requiem to acquire.
hash_6f9da9a85795e5a7: ^9Valentina: ^7Omega teams are en route to your position for evac, ETA two hours. Do try to stay alive until then. Valentina out.
hash_43ca2e55db7d1064: ^9Gorev: ^7Hello, Peck. I have been informed to your current situation. Most unfortunate, especially for man with bright future.
hash_75ace0eb0dff3301: ^9Gorev: ^7I had big hopes for you. "An American in Moscow" -- like classic Hollywood movie, da? I was Gene Kelly, and you... well, you were the other one.
hash_5f871bc8600fb5b6: ^9Gorev: ^7When I last spoke to you, I gave you simple task. Capture Maxis. Find the mole. Simple.
hash_535174ceb861a5b3: ^9Gorev: ^7One week later and you have outdone yourself. You have destroyed your base. Gotten countless loyalists killed. But at least you learned who mole was, da?
hash_3a94e13c332c4ea0: ^9Gorev: ^7But wait... This is not true. You did not find mole. You also lost most valuable intelligence asset, because you think it was smart idea to throw her into other fucking dimension!
hash_19d7d5096c6408ad: ^9Gorev: ^7Do not worry, Peck. Gorev is here now to clean up your mess. I will find your mole. For his sake, I hope he is dead. If he is not, he will soon wish he was.
hash_48466b5fdff2b525: ^9Kravchenko: ^7Dr. Peck. Do not speak. I have no stomach for excuses. Just...listen.
hash_7b1ea2f85f3e6114: ^9Kravchenko: ^7Outpost 25 has fallen. You failed me. Ever meet anyone else who failed me? Nyet. They are all dead.
hash_46beaa474861795b: ^9Kravchenko: ^7However, we are receiving your research. That is the only reason I am willing to...overlook your transgression. But you will make it up to me.
hash_63203bac5707b3f2: ^9Kravchenko: ^7The Americans and their Requiem group pose a threat to our operations. You get one more chance to keep us ahead of them. One.
hash_61b07124c790a4d0: ^9Kravchenko: ^7Now, forget about Requiem. Gorev will handle them -- and their mole -- personally.
hash_703380a105274817: ^9Kravchenko: ^7You will focus on your work. Give me something to show Moscow we are not wasting their resources.
hash_4106dbba28d3d4c4: ^<Pyotr: ^7I do not know how long it has been.
hash_5e98bc46efb8c065: ^<Pyotr: ^7How long have I gone without orders? How long... Without purpose?
hash_48a1abbbd7be4df7: ^<Pyotr: ^7Not, not just a war, but... losing myself.
hash_76e22a1435a33e40: ^<Pyotr: ^7There were soldiers. An army. One I recognized, but hoped I would never see again.
hash_645a39ad01c254f1: ^<Pyotr: ^7I am afraid that wherever I go...
hash_1c024cc5cc8cf1bb: ^<Pyotr: ^7There was a crooked man, and he went a crooked mile.
hash_2a0b87e5a3529376: ^<Pyotr: ^7She told me that I was not worthless.
hash_581be97fbab0f8ed: ^<Pyotr: ^7I will - We will - Fix this crooked house.
hash_24c9bcee83c18c12: ^<Pyotr: ^7He found a crooked sixpence against a crooked stile.
hash_5b745d55cc860f29: ^<Pyotr: ^7He bought a crooked cat, which caught a crooked mouse.
hash_44127579e92718f8: ^<Pyotr: ^7And they all lived together in a little crooked house.
hash_2b89cf88c1d882c6: ^<Pyotr: ^7There was a woman, that I met.
hash_662931a21365683c: ^<Pyotr: ^7She told me never to lose faith.
hash_6cd457b61368482c: ^8Maxis: ^7This could be our only chance to catch up with the Soviets. I'm going to meet with my contact.
hash_2fba79f063e1e77f: ^8Weaver: ^7Sam. I don't want you to get yourself hurt.
hash_316a037e56754aee: ^8Weaver: ^7I'm rarely angry, Sam. You should know that.
hash_6e06504799e63763: ^8Maxis: ^7No. I know that you're just very good at hiding it. I have news.
hash_26e61b9a4a424ebc: ^8Weaver: ^7Tell me what's going on and please, Sam... Don't lie. That would make me angry.
hash_d39267106403549: ^8Maxis: ^7I have a contact within Omega group. He wants to meet. I've seen the intel he has first hand. He's the real deal.
hash_61d9e5a5c58df8f: ^8Maxis: ^7There's an Omega Operation underway at a facility about halfway between Hue City and Khe Sanh. Headed up by one of their top Scientists. Doctor William Peck. You heard that name before?
hash_7321ed74a07f9c78: ^8Weaver: ^7I know the name all too well. He may have a 'brilliant' intellect, but he's an arrogant narcissist who cares only for stoking his own ego. Above all else he's a fucking traitor to this country.
hash_20b537cd7f43f645: ^8Maxis: ^7I know, I know. But this 'Peck' is also about to help the Soviets secure the breakthrough they need to control access to the other dimension.
hash_37bef3f13627436: ^8Weaver: ^7Okay, let's assume your intel is solid and this is all true. You have to let Requiem take it from here. Where are you now?
hash_ca7d16849f2bd8: ^<Ravenov: ^7I am Sergei Ravenov. I know you need Peck's research. I know you need to close the gap. I know you know how quickly you are falling behind.
hash_2098fa3eb904fdc9: ^<Ravenov: ^7Their Aetherium research is way beyond yours. Way beyond anything you could imagine. Maxis would want you to stop them weaponizing it further. Even if it meant she sacrifices herself for the greater good.
hash_6977ec038f865a59: ^8Weaver: ^7If you are lying to me. If you betrayed her. If any harm comes to her... I will kill you myself.
hash_3bc6cacedefc949f: ^<Ravenov: ^7It will not come to that. I have already told you - Omega are ahead of you. Every step of the way.
hash_34c21fb3f8eb675b: ^<Ravenov: ^7You're wrong. They're listening. They always are. That's why Maxis is where she is now.
hash_6933df7327770dc5: ^8Weaver: ^7You're the 'contact' she told me about. Where is Samantha now?
hash_62757deb7e767585: ^<Ravenov: ^7When I arrived at the meeting they were already there. Omega. They took her.
hash_65188bd71163f33f: ^<Ravenov: ^7They will keep her alive. At least for now. They will have taken her to their facility. The one where you must go. Where you must send your people.
hash_3c44ad10a9ec63f9: ^8Weaver: ^7Who are you to tell me what I should do?
hash_331845e6bc816d9: ^8Weaver: ^7Thank you all for coming. I can see from your faces you look worried.
hash_1e2624a980f09a4f: ^8Strauss: ^7I think the Major is reminding you - and not very subtly - that this is a military operation. We are merely advisors.
hash_1562c0f7584e5c31: ^8Grey: ^7Well, am I wrong? We are going in - right?
hash_41fce5ae6714935e: ^8Weaver: ^7Doctor Grey is correct. We need to send the team to secure their research... but we also have to extract a prisoner.
hash_457efd7ec82bc390: ^8Carver: ^7Your Russian contact? Surely he's burned - or maybe even playing us for fools. This has got wrong written all over it.
hash_3349e71954989a8: ^8Weaver: ^7No. The Russian contact is not a priority. I'm talking about someone else - Agent Samantha Maxis.
hash_300b486f3c7ac53a: ^8Strauss: ^7Ah, yes. The mysterious Ms. Maxis. I thought she was 'more than capable' of taking care of herself?
hash_aafc19ed123679a: ^8Weaver: ^7She is. But there's another player in the mix. One who may go out of his way to bring her harm.
hash_2bb9de2a7ffa4277: ^8Strauss: ^7Oh, that's not good - Peck is a 'nasty piece of work'.
hash_5e31ca1e5eee248b: ^8Strauss: ^7Concerned. Not worried. There is a difference.
hash_8e3396f9447ed9a: ^8Weaver: ^7We believe we have identified the purpose behind 'Outpost 25' - Omega's secret base in Vietnam.
hash_33e6e0578d9a4fec: ^8Weaver: ^7My contacts believe they have developed the technology to enter into the Dark Aether at will.
hash_4856f3e45bb18489: ^8Carver: ^7No, it is not fucking marvelous. It's another indication that we are losing this war.
hash_281e4f16d3d194e1: ^8Weaver: ^7Intel suggests they have successfully harnessed the energy of the crystals - For purposes not yet known.
hash_818097e17a79534: ^8Grey: ^7We have to send the team in. This is a chance to ... Why are you raising your eyebrows like that?
hash_58111441233d8020: ^8Meyer: ^7This is Heinrich Meyer, station chief, Berlin -- Office of Requiem. Weaver, we have a developing situation over here.
hash_2ed890a72bbffde1: ^8Meyer: ^7Reliable HUMINT places Dr. Aleksandra Valentina of KGB-Spetsnaz Omega Group here in West Berlin.
hash_261092427c3565f2: ^8Meyer: ^7She was observed scouting several locations in the city. Objective unknown.
hash_33dd1964cb6c1613: ^8Meyer: ^7This is very distressing, to say the least. Dr Valentina is directly involved with Omega's interdimensional research. If she is here expecting, or intending for something to happen...
hash_b8b8a6a18058cc: ^8Meyer: ^7Weaver, we have been very fortunate so far that most of Omega's operations have been in remote, rural areas.
hash_5451350ca74eeffd: ^8Meyer: ^7Berlin, on the other hand, is the focal point of the Cold War. The world is always watching us. If they were to launch an op here...
hash_21c403d4726fd49e: ^8Meyer: ^7I have a team trying to intercept her communications. I will alert you should they succeed.
hash_5286233c45e6cb07: ^8Carver: ^7Outpost 25. Just look at this place. This hilltop used to be a U.S. Army Fire Support Base called "Ripcord." Nothing left of it now -- this construction's all new.
hash_7cc4cf24c4eff30e: ^8Carver: ^7Our intel reports said it was walled off. Impenetrable. Omega's very own Fort Knox. Not hard to see why.
hash_349b22358569394d: ^8Carver: ^7I'll make this clear: we're behind. Requiem's made progress, but it pales next to what Omega's accomplished.
hash_3063a3a0b564d034: ^8Carver: ^7Teleportation? A new kind of super-battery? And that assault rifle? Won't be long until the Reds have it in mass production.
hash_6be688973ea6592b: ^8Carver: ^7If we could recover that rifle tech, or their research on weaponization, it would be a very good day for Requiem.
hash_1450c28c34b22a82: ^8Carver: ^7Hell. Maybe I could pass it along to the D-o-D, give them something to cheer about. But we'll keep that one between us, won't we?
hash_211c3f362b1aa326: ^8Carver: ^7Now, all this sour talk doesn't mean Requiem hasn't had some wins. Your equipped with one right now: the W-A-N-Ds: Weaponized Aetherium Neutralizer Device.
hash_484d840cda88fabf: ^8Carver: ^7Cool toy, right? Little pet project of mine. One of my men brought me the concept, and once I saw the schematics I realized the tactical edge they'd provide in the field.
hash_7b4be066f999426c: ^8Carver: ^7Allocated one of our science teams to develop the tech. Dr. Strauss initially objected, because of course that grouchy old German did, but he eventually came around.
hash_7beb5888cafc24e5: ^8Carver: ^7Sure, the names might be a little splashy, but you've got to let the eggheads have a little fun during R&D.
hash_4708a8a4d4d64061: ^8Carver: ^7I won't lie. It's a strange feeling, sending you to 'Nam. Feels like yesterday I was being flown out. Man, that first week...
hash_6a72639e40ea78a8: ^8Carver: ^7It was hot. Wet. No matter what you did, you couldn't get rid of "the stick". You'd try washing it off and it'd just make it worse -- and don't get me started on the damn lizards in the showers.
hash_111441023f8d197b: ^8Carver: ^7Hard years. I lost men. Family. Brothers. Then there was Apache Snow. But that's a story for another time.
hash_c70b26d6f2d7652: ^8Carver: ^7Let's just say when we came back "the stick" stuck with us. I spent years trying to clean it off.
hash_5820a9fa680fa68c: ^8Strauss: ^7Here you are. Outpost 25. The progress they have made at this facility... we may as well be the N-A-C-A watching the Sputnik launch.`
hash_7ee63fcdaf70d3fd: ^8Strauss: ^7I would be lying if I said their Aetherium-based power source hadn't caught my eye. It is interesting work... albeit crude and unrefined. They approach the process like a blacksmith when what it needs is an architect.
hash_71718c0da08cda2e: ^8Strauss: ^7Recover that research, and I will refine their work in weeks, ending this Aetherium energy "space-race" before it's barely begun.
hash_22c28ddb8d3634e7: ^8Strauss: ^7Aetherium has proven to be fascinating in both its gaseous and solid, crystalline states. It appears the infected and Dark Aether creatures require it for their very survival, not unlike oxygen in our own reality.
hash_f0f6e79e27ba4d6: ^8Strauss: ^7We've observed that the farther you are from a breach, the less exposure you risk. If Aetherium is their "oxygen," this explains why they are restricted to these "outbreak zones."
hash_328e68a23d739c5: ^8Strauss: ^7But I suppose this is all rather boring to you. I may as well be attempting discourse with a slab of meat - A bovine with a submachine gun.
hash_31686faadaa8fcf4: ^8Strauss: ^7You would do well to remember how Aetherium has benefitted you in the field. Major Carver's W-A-N-Ds. The experimental explosives you clear pathways with. Two examples of things that would not exist if not for my work. You're welcome.
hash_54a3d3965c6cde6e: ^8Strauss: ^7The goal of my work has always been to create the tools necessary for humanity's improvement - not its destruction.
hash_5e7407628b43a0df: ^8Strauss: ^7Ja. I know what you're thinking, but I was very young when the Uranverein whisked me from university to Endstation. I was promised the opportunity to explore a new frontier of atomic research.
hash_c6ec705d48394cc: ^8Strauss: ^7When I realized that meant weapons research, I requested reassignment. Little did I know my transfer would be to a much more insidious project, led by Dr. Friedrich Steiner.
hash_ef9875b5632ac3d: ^8Strauss: ^7After a year I literally could no longer stomach it. I defected as part of Operation Paperclip.
hash_177acf72f38f628a: ^8Strauss: ^7It has been something of a storied career since then, but, given Aetherium's potential, I am still hopeful Requiem will make the right decision on where to focus its efforts.
hash_3b61a2573359357: ^8Grey: ^7Well... we're in the thick of it now, aren't we?
hash_79cdd648605e8916: ^8Grey: ^7So far, these breaches have been random, and we've had to scramble to react to their sudden appearance. But if Omega has the tech to control when and where these portals open...
hash_1647693b89bf4d65: ^8Grey: ^7No. I shouldn't even entertain that thought. Maybe it's just down to the region's dimensional fragility and they haven't actually developed the tech to open them willy-nilly. Least not yet.
hash_52cb3a0e97a34b3c: ^8Grey: ^7Now, as for this whole conscripted labor thing? Forcing people across the threshold to collect crystals and data? That's not okay.
hash_1b1e27c31c1b2423: ^8Grey: ^7Hopefully my device will help us solve that problem, at least in terms of research gathering. More on that later.
hash_4684f3f8b873fe8e: ^8Grey: ^7What I'm still really keen to understand is the transformative properties of Aetherium. We saw what happened to those poor sods at Endstation.
hash_26849be156713b4f: ^8Grey: ^7Some of the infected remain mostly humanoid, while others resemble more powerful, 'evolved' creatures. What made their transformations different?
hash_c0537be54293994: ^8Grey: ^7Take that infected Omega Soldier, the one who helped us with the particle accelerator. Why did he turn... into that? That's one of the things I'd like to answer. Maybe not here, maybe not today, but -- it's on the list!
hash_3464a349d98d8fb9: ^8Grey: ^7We've seen the element's impact on humans and the environment: the infected transformations, the blossoming crystals. Now what I'm really eager to learn is, can we harness and control the effects?
hash_343e4dde15f3f1c0: ^8Grey: ^7Keep the benefits and discard all the crap that hurts us? We saw what happened when Boyer genetically modified bacteria -- we got insulin. Changed the world.
hash_7cd54bc344b4e4b: ^8Grey: ^7So what if we alter bacteria from the infected? What genetic secret do you unlock? Super-strength? Pain resistance? Immortality?
hash_3166adc2ab9d972a: ^8Grey: ^7Okay no, actually I do not like the sound of that at all. I know I'm essentially working for the military now, but I'd really rather focus on how all this helps the world. Helps people. That's what I want. I hope you feel the same.
hash_78345d41c6c315c6: ^8Meyer: ^7Weaver, this is Meyer -- Berlin Station Chief. Urgent question: did you get the memorandum I submitted on Saturday? If so, why is there still no response?
hash_684b1ad9d6902b67: ^8Meyer: ^7Forgive me, but I do not think anyone at Langley grasps the seriousness of the situation. Dr Valentina is here. In Berlin.
hash_54c3004c6f3bda34: ^8Meyer: ^7This city is divided. East and West are nose to nose here. If she does something...drastic, the consequences could go global -- in the worst possible way.
hash_54bdbfb1ff77ea65: ^8Meyer: ^7Just...please advise how best to proceed. Personally, I'd like a Requiem strike team en route here right now, but I leave that decision to you.
hash_17670f402ff8befc: ^8Weaver: ^7Team - I can't overstate just how important this mission is. We're at risk of falling so far behind, we may never catch up.
hash_1249737843c8696d: ^8Weaver: ^7My contacts in the field have provided intel that suggests Omega are not only advancing their Aetherium applications, but they have in fact harnessed the power to move in and out of the other dimension at will.
hash_4977ff7f5cca202e: ^8Weaver: ^7Hmm... The other dimension? Well, it's got a name that you may have already heard. I'm not exactly sure who first coined the term, but we've taken to calling it the Dark Aether.
hash_5422af2abbbcb9a7: ^8Weaver: ^7The name is probably no more ominous than the reality. Omega's next move will doubtless be to try to weaponize it.
hash_1084e11f711993b8: ^8Weaver: ^7I'm sure I don't have to tell you how bad that would be...
hash_3b337524d5dda03: ^8Weaver: ^7You already know what the mission parameters are. You know what needs to be done. Even if we can't apprehend Peck, we must recover what remains of his intel. But there's more than that.
hash_132281312ac4742a: ^8Weaver: ^7You are already someone who knows when to read between the lines.
hash_ada8c23aed2e2a9: ^8Weaver: ^7You are someone who knows there are other battles to be won - Battles to avoid a bigger war.
hash_30b2f385640fcd78: ^8Weaver: ^7This is personal for me. You need to make every effort to extract Samantha Maxis.
hash_1e4d04da6b07bf12: ^8Weaver: ^7William Peck... This... 'fucker'... is a traitor. He deserves to be brought to justice.
hash_3a673dfb175719eb: ^8Weaver: ^7If you want to know what you're dealing with, I think it would be entirely appropriate to call him a malignant narcissist.
hash_18a30417164bb8e0: ^8Weaver: ^7However smart he may be - or thinks he is - The only thing he cares about is himself.
hash_3c30a85062a8a011: ^8Weaver: ^7Strange as it sounds - We could really use him right now.
hash_651abf162d7463e8: ^$Weaver: ^7If you damaged my vehicle, I will be very angry.
hash_6e08bc03d2a7b92c: ^$Weaver: ^7I am no stranger to the road of bones.

hash_1ee5e0f2a193dfa3: ^9Valentina: ^7Father, I did it! I told you we would be together again -- really together. And here I am.
hash_fa0f058529bb81a: ^<Vogel: ^7My child. I knew you would come. I never lost faith in you -- as you never lost faith in me.
hash_761971200b143279: ^<Vogel: ^7Tell me, my clever Angelika, did you have any trouble crossing into the Dark Aether?
hash_4c986703bb5690d4: ^9Valentina: ^7None. The portal you hid in Berlin worked perfectly. And Omega is none the wiser. Their trust in "Aleksandra Valentina" was as blind as it was complete.
hash_294a1f13636ec9cf: ^9Valentina: ^7I suppose a lifetime of living a lie has finally paid off.
hash_6ebffc39f70190b6: ^<Vogel: ^7Indeed, but your work is far from finished. We have reached the moment of truth for Operation Baldr.
hash_1d175b52b4790461: ^9Valentina: ^7I know, father. And I am ready. I did not spend all those years playing a Soviet lackey just to fall short of the prize now.
hash_271e18eaff235a60: ^9Valentina: ^7Marching jackboots will once again echo down the streets of Berlin like thunder. The glory of the Fatherland will be restored. This I swear to you: Task Force Baldr is coming home.
hash_551412f21be11f08: ^9Valentina: ^7Father, I have always wondered about the day you crossed into the Dark Aether. What happened, exactly? I understand you were doing your duty, but I have always wondered... why did you leave me?
hash_12b6c22693c3718d: ^<Vogel: ^7That... was a difficult day, Angelika. One I try not to think about. What mattered then was getting Task Force Baldr in place. What matters now is completing the mission.
hash_13626dd5bb22f976: ^9Valentina: ^7Of course, father. I meant only that abandoning me must have been almost as difficult for you as it was for me.
hash_38e68e70a801d7ff: ^<Vogel: ^7But I never abandoned you. The fact that you are here is testament to that. Now, are you prepared for what comes next? If you are to lead our army, you must... ascend.
hash_753a49610dd0b01c: ^9Valentina: ^7My body means no more to me than the name I left behind. I will proudly remold it for the honor of leading the charge to reclaim Germania. My entire life has built toward this moment.
hash_78e2e039ca6c64e1: ^<Vogel: ^7As has mine, child. As has mine.
hash_344ef0baf9b0161c: ^<Vogel: ^7You look every bit as glorious as I envisioned. How do you feel, my child?
hash_3d0c01706587845f: ^9Valentina: ^7How do I feel? I feel incredible! I thought I knew what it was to wield power before. Now power sings in every fiber of my being! Nothing will stand against us!
hash_3dbefca15a913e6: ^<Vogel: ^7Then go to the head of our army and lead them to glory! Unleash the judgment of the Reich on the soft, weak ingrates who sullied the Fatherland!
hash_65e28c735d852b83: ^9Forsaken: ^7Tell them their day is done! The sun sets forever upon their divided world!
hash_53a00e65c0ad9e4a: ^<Vogel: ^7Of course, child. My time here has... left its mark on me, but I am the one who guided you to this moment. I am still me.
hash_5973b215094c1d7d: ^<Vogel: ^7Now, go. Make me proud one final time. The Reich must rise from the ashes.
hash_34028e4994251a87: ^<Zykov: ^7Hello again, my friend. It is your old comrade Zykov. And, yes, we are still comrades, even if you now serve Omega Group.
hash_cefa3dc20809e06: ^<Zykov: ^7This secret war we fight -- and the ultimate enemy we both face -- transcend the politics of East and West. And now, thanks to Dr. Valentina, we have entered a dangerous new phase.
hash_21e4fbb2f841a7bd: ^<Zykov: ^7She thinks she is carrying out her father's wishes. She is wrong. The being that has visited her since childhood is not her father.
hash_2c450c0729f6198c: ^<Zykov: ^7The Forsaken is not simply powerful. He is a master of deceit. I have seen him do this before -- alter his appearance, play upon emotions -- all to make others do his bidding.
hash_21418552e3481943: ^<Zykov: ^7I have seen others here become drawn to him, follow him, worship him. And now the Forsaken commands a vast army, hungrily eyeing our world.
hash_49bb4f35037cc682: ^<Zykov: ^7This is the nature of the great evil I have been warning you about. This dark universe is no longer enough for him. He lives to consume -- and when you reopened the gateway at Endstation, he looked upon our world and saw a banquet to be devoured.
hash_7c38f657af8f0299: ^<Zykov: ^7I can still help you stop him, but only if you free me from this place. Only if you bring me home.
hash_53ad3f9df5be6428: ^<Zykov: ^7Things were not always like this, my friend. I remember a time here in the Dark Aether when the Forsaken did not even exist.
hash_255f3b436dc2c4d9: ^<Zykov: ^7When I first crossed over, things were very different. Back then, there were many powerful entities at war here, forming alliances, betraying each other...
hash_72f4c6ef5ed71ec2: ^<Zykov: ^7Not that I realized it at first, any more than an insect would know the names of leaders in the Great Patriotic War.
hash_4513d294d7386c83: ^<Zykov: ^7But eventually I came to recognize the Lords of the Dark Aether. They had been locked in an ever-changing stalemate since the dawn of time.
hash_2bef50ee00297dcc: ^<Zykov: ^7And then, one by one, the Forsaken hunted them down, consumed them, and made their power his own.
hash_1e294099cb91e2fd: ^<Zykov: ^7The Forsaken imposed order upon the Dark Aether. Those who remained rallied to him, seeking his favor and pledging loyalty.
hash_3614e8c7deb2ad46: ^<Zykov: ^7This is a different place than when I arrived. It is infinitely more dangerous.
hash_12914ed26a941dce: ^<Lazarev: ^7This is Colonel Pavel Lazarev, interrogating prisoner Lukas Kurtz on second of February, 1945.
hash_711c27a5f021e252: ^<Kurtz: ^7I will tell you where the rest of the Endstation staff are hiding only if you agree to spare Angelika and allow me to look after her.
hash_278fa9d0554ce7fe: ^<Lazarev: ^7An interesting proposal. But even I would not consign a child to be raised as a Nazi. So here is my counter-proposal...
hash_384e17dd1d5e771: ^<Lazarev: ^7You come back to Mother Russia and continue your work -- for me. She will receive a proper Bolshevik education and becomes a productive member of society. But only if you give up your comrades.
hash_21297e696b636ff5: ^<Kurtz: ^7How do I know you will keep your end of the bargain?
hash_226c0be6a68d7373: ^<Lazarev: ^7Because you are going to make yourself too valuable to execute. Starting right fucking now. Understood?
hash_66fbbe2f075eae57: ^<Kurtz: ^7*sigh* Bring a map. I will give you names and locations...
hash_28cb0872f038d507: ^<Lazarev: ^7Dr. Kurtz, you worked at "Projekt Endstation." Why did you and so many others desert the facility?
