hash_370f21537dc9be05: ^<Kurtz: ^7We were ordered to evacuate. We did our duty to the Fatherland. And that is all you will get out of me.
hash_6e6d8b1db38a56c1: ^<Lazarev: ^7I lost 14 men shutting down the mess you left behind, so I have very little patience for bravado or delays of any sort. You will talk.
hash_1fb338b3ca56a527: ^<Kurtz: ^7Do what you want to me. I don't care any more.
hash_d014cd847f62803: ^<Lazarev: ^7Perhaps not, Dr. Kurtz. But if you do not immediately tell me where the rest of the Endstation staff went, I will have that little girl we found hiding with you shot.
hash_7a833c3316742bc9: ^<Kurtz: ^7No, wait! Angelika has done nothing! She only sought shelter from the fighting!
hash_46ed15f96627c31d: ^<Lazarev: ^7She matters to you, and for that she will die.
hash_40557bf8b26f6a2b: ^<Kurtz: ^7Kill her and you lose any leverage you have over me. But... I am willing to strike a bargain if it will save her life.
hash_75256b433caa0ff7: ^<Kurtz: ^7I saw what it did to your father! It took years before I understood the pain we caused, the atrocities we committed. I will not allow you to follow in his path.
hash_1405a08dde9ca2e9: ^9Valentina: ^7You do not understand. I must! He told you I must complete his work. "Take her. Teach her. Be there, both of you, when Operation Baldr bears fruit."
hash_5c2a2f1b5fa907c3: ^<Kurtz: ^7This acceptance letter is going in the trash -- better yet, the fire.
hash_5d49c0b760655815: ^<Kurtz: ^7We shall not speak of this again.
hash_b69f3d88944c736: ^<Kurtz: ^7Aleksandra? Would you join me for a moment? There is a matter we should discuss.
hash_224be1fa761b8e34: ^<Kurtz: ^7I was hoping you could enlighten me to the meaning of this envelope I received today.
hash_3af3606bfd7f8e85: ^<Kurtz: ^7"Dear Miss Valentina. On behalf of the Committee on Admissions, your application to the Moscow Institute of Physics and Technology has been formally accepted."
hash_90fa7b4f93d5f62: ^<Kurtz: ^7We had an agreement. Anything you wanted in life, I would support you, except one thing.
hash_5090747684cfb280: ^<Kurtz: ^7--You promised me you gave up this foolish pursuit! Do you know where this road leads? I have seen it. Lived it. Horrors you could not possibly imagine!
hash_27461b1faa13ae9e: ^9Valentina: ^7But, but I am good at it. The world out there, the factory, I do not understand. But this, physics and microbiology--
hash_cef01e794fde521: ^<Kurtz: ^7Aleksandra. Is it time for tea already?
hash_51c1667fc8a3f992: ^9Valentina: ^7How dare I? How dare you denounce his work! How dare you sit there and feed me lies!
hash_5082daec97be77b4: ^9Valentina: ^7I will go to University, Uncle. You will not stop me. Father is disappointed you lost your way. You abandoned Operation Baldr.
hash_4224f8de52f12ce: ^9Valentina: ^7My name is Angelika Hannabelle Vogel. My father has a plan -- and I will help him complete it.
hash_305c847da5ceb040: ^9Valentina: ^7It is finished, Father. I did as you instructed. Do you approve?
hash_3ecf19e9980e3df: ^9Valentina: ^7Yes, Uncle. Be careful -- it is quite hot.
hash_5e5b9223d7b5518e: ^<Kurtz: ^7Aleksandra, can I have a moment please?
hash_78eedfbdc7a8d55d: ^<Kurtz: ^7About our discussion yesterday. I know you may not appreciate it now, but please understand my only concern is for your well being.
hash_75aa8045c4e8ea6c: ^<Kurtz: ^7Your father was a... complicated man. It was a different time. What we did was... wrong. I only wish to protect you from the mistakes we made.
hash_5f737262ced271e9: ^<Kurtz: ^7I am sorry, what did you say?
hash_8661b1f4b4edcc7: ^9Valentina: ^7My father was a brilliant man. And you were a pathetic worm lurking in his shadow.
hash_279844ae4a734ec3: ^9Peck: ^7Well, well. How the tables have turned. Last time we got to chat in private was Outpost 25. Remember? When you came into my house, broke all my toys, and shit on my floor? You were like a feral street dog. With a bad case of worms.
hash_1e46f15a7adb026: ^9Peck: ^7But now look at you. All trained and neutered. On my leash.
hash_2dc9e4883143360d: ^9Peck: ^7I should thank you, really. All the trouble you've caused me these last seven, long months. If you hadn't destroyed my Inversion warheads, I wouldn't have the chance now to make you my... bitch. Well worth it.
hash_7796812ed24a68e0: ^9Peck: ^7And now you're going to stop Valentina. Maybe even kill her. And to think, Omega thought I was the traitor. You can almost taste the irony.
hash_754f0252b4e27cef: ^9Peck: ^7You see - She played them for fools. When she activated that particle accelerator at Endstation, I knew something was wrong. I could smell it. She was too eager. Despite the dangers, despite the risks, she was hellbent on turning that thing back on. Almost like she had a hidden agenda. Which of course she did.
hash_2cd8a47af53154a2: ^9Peck: ^7But she's your problem now. You're going to clean this mess up. For me. Get it? Got it. Good.
hash_52eb5d7579a6facf: ^9Gorev: ^7Ah, the infamous Requiem strike team. After a year of being's Omega's itchy skin rash, it is almost a pleasure to finally make your acquaintance.
hash_66762691501f55d2: ^9Gorev: ^7I do not believe we have had formal introduction. I am Gorev. No first or last name. Just Gorev. Want to know secret? Gorev is code name. Family name is, well, I do not want the attention. Grandfather's brother, he was famous soldier in Stalingrad.
hash_2519a1be888542ad: ^9Gorev: ^7You see? Some secrets are okay. Not like our Doctor Valentina. She has been quite the busy bee, da? Buzzing around, using Omega's resources to pursue her own agenda. Harboring the biggest secret of all...
hash_45d6adf14f4d88a0: ^9Gorev: ^7Her father being Doctor Ulrich Vogel, of Projekt Endstation? How that managed to elude us all is a question I am very interested in answering.
hash_5e934183d482dfb3: ^9Gorev: ^7But, as Colonel has said, the voice she hears is not really her father. It is this other entity. The Forsaken. I have heard Kravchenko call it "the wolf". Like from child's story. Red-hooded girl. This wolf changes itself, so it is familiar to us. So we trust it.
hash_3445f2c9b3811238: ^9Jager: ^7Hallo, Requiem. Are we enjoying beautiful, sunny, East Berlin? Perhaps not as luxurious as the amenities of the West you are so accustomed to, but still -- an improvement over your most recent residency, ja?
hash_2401e0379a1a0221: ^9Jager: ^7I've seen the bodies carried out of our Potsdam facility... Brutalized. Though as I understand it, you were given the "5-Star Treatment." No breaking of bones, no poking or prodding. The Colonel needed you in "tip-top" shape, he said.
hash_2a222652ab0aedaa: ^9Jager: ^7The Forsaken. It weasels its way into the minds of its victims, preying on their memories, hiding behind familiar faces. It found the perfect weakness for our sweet Valentina: her dearly departed... Daddy.
hash_169be3565d1ba9bb: ^9Jager: ^7The Colonel is very interested in this creature. It is a shame, really. I had hoped the Colonel was smarter than that.
hash_4c3b5eede0e3018c: ^9Jager: ^7The Dark Aether is a vast ocean. The Forsaken, just one white whale. There are other realms, other worlds. It is a universe, after all. Not a singular place.
hash_660ba853eb3b18e5: ^9Jager: ^7The first natural resource we discovered yielded energy beyond our wildest dreams. Do we dare imagine what else lurks in the darkness?
hash_751915582e477e19: ^9Kravchenko: ^7When I was chosen to lead Omega, it was clear the unit would be shut down in months, if not weeks. I was to be Chebrikov's scapegoat.
hash_3a956cf1486ac068: ^9Kravchenko: ^7After everything I had done for my country, for the KGB, for Dragovich: Nova 6, the Numbers Program, the mole -- this was my reward. I was to take the fall and quietly disappear to a place I would be forgotten.
hash_5bc2db12b1543a8f: ^9Kravchenko: ^7I gave the order to scour our archives for a new operation, a new purpose. I had little hope anything would come of it.
hash_65b06aabf1fcbe96: ^9Kravchenko: ^7Then Doctor Valentina brought me the film reels. A recording documenting the discovery of a Nazi operation called "Projekt Endstation". It was a gateway to another world. You know what happened next.
hash_d2e15f8a967ee5d: ^9Kravchenko: ^7I took Aleksandra under my wing. I supported her projects, gave her unparalleled access to resources.
hash_2747b2a465f7bd6c: ^9Kravchenko: ^7I came to think of her as the daughter I never had.
hash_343bfc62bbeeb1d3: ^9Kravchenko: ^7But it was all a lie. She used me. She used us all. Find her. Not for me and my career, but to prevent the creature that infected her brain from entering our world.
hash_7c4208c90174c5f0: ^9Kravchenko: ^7To whomever needs to hear this - There is someone who would like to speak to you.
hash_5e6d8954d34b1eb6: ^8Raptor One: ^7Fuck that shit! Fuck Omega! Fuck this fucking asshole! You get a chance to get out - YOU FUCKING TAKE IT!
hash_3eef739e4343f692: ^9Kravchenko: ^7Please ignore your friend's bad advice. For his sake.
hash_ed4f2dd56572c41: ^9Kravchenko: ^7It is better for all of us...
hash_118b3e55589eeff0: ^9Kravchenko: ^7If you do exactly what you are told.
hash_1ca98698eb06c462: ^8Raptor One: ^7Hey Y'all. You know me right?
hash_7d02e347819d45b0: ^8Raptor One: ^7I just wanted y'all to know that I'm in good health. Safe and well. Maybe a little prostate trouble, but I'll deal with that another day.
hash_2cdd9226df26c63: ^8Raptor One: ^7Point is, I'm being well looked after -- and at no point has anyone shoved a knife in my face in a threatening manner.
hash_5ff7d5d101d46401: ^8Raptor One: ^7Plan is: you do exactly as instructed, and we all get to go home.
hash_7cd2ecf5edab6717: ^8Raptor One: ^7Basically... you're gonna be getting the runaround as usual -- but just go along with it... and I might just make it out of here with my binocular vision intact.
hash_3606fdcb9b486779: ^9Kravchenko: ^7See? I keep my word -- your friend is safe. And he will stay that way so long as you follow orders.
hash_2e278c613bfb7769: ^<Vogel: ^7This is Ulrich Vogel, director of Projekt Endstation. 27th of January, 1945. 7:20 a.m.
hash_113603887183f2cd: ^<Kurtz: ^7*sigh* Jawohl, herr doktor. You... you will not be forgotten.
hash_36e9c6882c14589b: ^<Vogel: ^7If the Reich lives on, it will all be worth it.
hash_502d3acd01c894d0: ^<Vogel: ^7Task Force Baldr is in position, I am powering up the cyclotron, and we are about to embark on--
hash_4f10a288c0bf866c: ^<Kurtz: ^7Dr. Vogel? I, ah -- sorry. I did not know you were recording.
hash_73e720d6f07d99ca: ^<Vogel: ^7Why are you here, Dr. Kurtz? Did you not read my final orders?
hash_37c1b466d38bed8e: ^<Kurtz: ^7Ja, herr doktor. That is what I wished to speak about. This last part, about your daughter...
hash_5496032c2980119c: ^<Vogel: ^7I know it is asking a lot, Kurtz. And I know you and I have not always seen eye to eye. But I trust no one more than you to look after Angelika when I am gone. If nothing else, you are... thorough.
hash_3c4af03bdec02aa0: ^<Kurtz: ^7I am... honored, sir. But this may not be necessary. I beg you, do not evacuate the facility before launching the operation. With the staff here, there is a chance we can stabilize the collider and safely--
hash_2423023b45790f66: ^<Vogel: ^7Kurtz. Stop. You showed me yourself how Operation Baldr will surely overload the power couplings. But calling it off would doom the Reich. This, my friend, is the only path forward.
hash_5de5b8210b3e3051: ^<Vogel: ^7Take her. Teach her. Be there, both of you, when Operation Baldr bears fruit. Finish my work.
hash_59572bf77d4f49d8: ^<Vogel: ^7Make sure the staff clears out. Get to safety. Live a long life and tell Angelika her father loved her. I will alert the task force when the breach is stable, and I will see them through alone. Understood?
hash_5524859301d2fe23: ^8Agent Jack: ^7Okay... This is a weird one. So weird, that for the benefit of the record I would like to make it 100% clear that my recent psychiatric evaluation cleared me for active duty in my current role -- AND any other duties the CIA deems necessary.
hash_40ad20721198d556: ^8Agent Jack: ^7So, with that said, let me lay it all out on the table.
hash_6df032aa37cb191: ^8Agent Jack: ^7The robot -- the fucking robot -- the one we didn't even ask for is a stone cold lunatic. Wait, let me make it more clear... He's a psychotic murderer.
hash_4e556134ca56d624: ^8Agent Jack: ^7Let me backtrack a little... We took delivery of the unit with little or no indication of its purpose. All we got was a note from some department called Requiem stating that he was being assigned to us.
hash_684c39700f1285b7: ^8Agent Jack: ^7None of us knew what the fuck was going on, but we followed the directives, sat the thing down, and plugged the bastard into an outlet. Nothing. He didn't even start blinking or light up.
hash_374ae004c096b0da: ^8Agent Jack: ^7Agent Bedard laughed the whole time, saying this was another bullshit waste of Government funding. He even drew a mustache on the Robot's face. We were all laughing about it when we went to bed.
hash_788c4706c3ca4175: ^8Agent Jack: ^7We weren't laughing the next morning.
hash_2b3663d983cf76d8: ^8Agent Jack: ^7Bedard was dead. Strangled. No word from HQ on what to do, so we unplugged the damn thing and hoped that was the end of it.
hash_756a97c53484886b: ^8Agent Jack: ^7It wasn't. Next morning Agent James was just as dead as Bedard.
hash_19e64c36c8da393e: ^8Agent Jack: ^7So I chained that bastard robot to his charging chair, and removed his damn hands. I just pray that's the end of it.
hash_3c5b0141f9cc22b8: ^8Klaus: ^7Honestly. I think I can do it myself.
hash_430f2ebc536c0de8: ^8Klaus: ^7I was wondering if you could give me a hand... Well -- both hands. My hands.
hash_7b57c6cf104f9439: ^8Agent Jack: ^7What the fuck are you doing, Klaus? Agent Rico! The bastard's on the move again!
hash_3d0c74359a615aae: ^8Klaus: ^7Here they are. I won't ask why you took them away. I'm sure you had your reasons.
hash_473331d51ccbd1eb: ^8Klaus: ^7Reattaching your hands -- when you have no hands -- is not exactly easy.
hash_6751117f2c3c6a09: ^8Agent Rico: ^7Goddammit, Jack -- you pissed the bed again?
hash_2e8e2fad56da05f6: ^8Agent Jack: ^7That metal bastard's in my fucking room!
hash_22c1b7bb647596cf: ^8Klaus: ^7Hello Agent Rico. Can I ask why you are you carrying that baseball bat? Do you want to assist in the killing of Agent Jack?
hash_333ea6fb6fcaa58d: ^8Agent Rico: ^7Damn... That was a night... And not a good one.
hash_4b831c06f6438798: ^8Agent Rico: ^7Fuck. Three agents dead in as many days... Bedard... James... then Jack.
hash_901c882954946b2: ^8Agent Rico: ^7Jack was the worst. I saw it happen. I saw that soulless shiny bastard choke the life from him.
hash_72bc9d55ca4980a9: ^8Agent Rico: ^7I hit him with a baseball bat repeatedly, but he just wouldn't stop. He even kept going for bit after the battery popped out of his stupid metal head.
hash_1d3bdc92e820e7cb: ^8Agent Rico: ^7I dragged his metal ass back to the chair and chained him up again. Then I threw the fucking battery as far into no man's land as I could. Which... was pretty far. Jack always said I was a better pitcher than a hitter.
hash_199cb45fa05df52e: ^8Agent Rico: ^7Aside from the agents the damn robot murdered, Agent Jones got himself wasted trying to deliver the nuke.
hash_3acce4f8d0904995: ^8Agent Rico: ^7So... it's just me now. The rest of the Station staff are gone. For good.
hash_799e103d27b25d54: ^8Soldier: ^7Look. I hope this gets to the right person, but I'm worried... In fact I'm scared as hell.
hash_762628b489d129c1: ^8Soldier: ^7I did not take possession of the package. Worse than that, I have no idea where it is.
hash_6c61035bead6eed2: ^8Soldier: ^7Rico was supposed to be in Car 5. Maybe he was. But he... it... never arrived.
hash_4b1fb5456212fd3f: ^8Soldier: ^7Right now, I don't know what I'm supposed to do. I don't know how we're going to seal the breach.
hash_6677631e6ad8fd0f: ^8Grey: ^7Sam... There's someone here to see you.
hash_6496136c92494c5e: ^8Grey: ^7Sam... It sounds like you're saying goodbye.
hash_4acc91bd05909f41: ^8Maxis: ^7The Forsaken is almost upon us, and I might be the only one who can stop it.
hash_2a87bbb551427464: ^8Grey: ^7I don't want you to do this.
hash_f3e7227c49a0d7c: ^8Maxis: ^7So... What are you going to tell the Director?
hash_17ea7e74ecc09b4b: ^8Grey: ^7I'm going to tell him that you are in control.
hash_5cd56ea75de6e02: ^8Maxis: ^7You will look after her won't you?
hash_62a605f7f6be818: ^8Maxis: ^7Hi Baby! I've missed you so much! You've gotten so big!
hash_27ac7ee9664940dd: ^8Grey: ^7The Director said we could break the 'no visitors' rule today, but...
hash_502badcb861a2f5e: ^8Maxis: ^7Not just a social call. Is it?
hash_701017322756be3b: ^8Grey: ^7He wants a second opinion - mine - about your... State of mind.
hash_6e4a224cbd289d8c: ^8Maxis: ^7He wants to be sure I'm in control... Of myself.
hash_40620a0a7675ba69: ^8Grey: ^7It's floating! The television is floating!! How can you do that?
hash_6b14cb6931f9cc12: ^8Maxis: ^7I can do a lot of things.
hash_345c8527d51da860: ^8Maxis: ^7Thank you for everything, Liz. You've been a good friend. More...more than a friend.
hash_25b3809f34895ac5: ^8Weaver: ^7Hello, Sam. I'm not allowed to visit in person, but I just wanted to... check in.
hash_1b34f69c94b3ed10: ^8Weaver: ^7I know I can't tell you what to do - you wouldn't listen anyway - but seriously...
hash_7e92bf55977836d7: ^8Maxis: ^7I know my orders, Weaver. I assist with the infil, but then...
hash_7da484485b6893c2: ^8Weaver: ^7You stand down. We can't risk any mistakes. We both know how badly things can go South if we act... impulsively.
hash_5ae476c415f8c91: ^8Maxis: ^7You're talking about the boy, aren't you?
hash_34d49a007a819afa: ^8Maxis: ^7Weaver wants me to sit this one out, but he's not really calling the shots anymore.
hash_14c9210b25dd58d4: ^8Maxis: ^7The Director is the one who knows what needs to happen.
hash_56243f22d01f1800: ^8Maxis: ^7If you... if you do run into the folks at Requiem...
hash_37393cd9ef31789c: ^9Peck: ^7--to the left, the left! NO, your OTHER left. Jesus Christ, this is why we use the imperial system--
hash_471362af2b39749f: ^9Peck: ^7We won't have adequate time for testing. I'm not even sure the particle accelerator will be ready by that date.
hash_38cd38474b4a2f29: ^9Kravchenko: ^7I don't want to hear excuses, I want to see results. As does the Chairing Committee.
hash_7c572b3b2e4bb559: ^9Peck: ^7Pardon my french, but this could fuck us. We are trying to extract a person buried inside a dimension filled with billions of creatures. A single miscalculation could turn this place into its own fucking outbreak zone.
hash_4586116ed339f39c: ^9Peck: ^7You can't just throw a dart at a calendar and declare a deadline. Science. Takes. Time.
hash_7bb76a1fcaf8496d: ^9Kravchenko: ^7Operatsiya Izbavitel is the crowning achievement of everything Omega has done until now. Once we have captured the Forsaken, he will be a weapon of unparalleled power to do our bidding. He will destroy the West in one fell swoop. We will be heroes.
hash_6c9509343e378efa: ^9Kravchenko: ^7You will get it done. And it will work.
hash_2225c7f6c32e9527: ^9Peck: ^7What are you looking at, Mr. Metric System? I said to THE LEFT!
hash_6ee2f07c654370e6: ^9Kravchenko: ^7Doctor Peck. Hard at work, I see.
hash_1de369890ba36ad2: ^9Peck: ^7Colonel?... I wasn't expecting you for another week.
hash_21e1dac965b5dfbd: ^9Peck: ^7Oh. We're proceeding on schedule, Colonel. As anticipated, your reallocation of resources has accelerated our timeline. We're looking to be fully operational by the end of June.
hash_1b2f09bc630eea33: ^9Peck: ^7Uhm, that was what we agreed upon? We set Zykov's extraction for July 4th.
hash_2cf51812520b05e7: ^9Kravchenko: ^7Plans have changed. Zykov's extraction is now June 4th.
hash_1df81130367bd1a1: ^9Peck: ^7A month?? You gotta be shitting me. You can't reasonably expect us to move up the schedule by a whole month??
hash_2a992f83600628c9: ^9Peck: ^7--by twenty?? What are you, insane?? Don't you dare--
hash_2dc081b6720462e6: ^<PA System: ^7Warning. Dimensional Breach in progress. Proceed to safe zones and await further instructions.
hash_3a945c1ce4219c73: ^9Kravchenko: ^7Captain, get your men into position, I want the threat neutralized now!
hash_7e67c3e9f7bafa97: ^9Peck: ^7This is Dr. William Peck. It is the 4th of June, 1985. 9:32 AM. This is test number 8 for dimensional extraction--
hash_1e0239fba8e81d3d: ^9Kravchenko: ^7--must you start with that every single recording?
hash_331214db9282434b: ^9Peck: ^7Wait, what are you doing? We need to close that gateway immediately--
hash_6925cd6b450643d5: ^9Peck: ^7--Aetherium levels are spiking across the facility, your men--
hash_9baafd68804557b: ^9Kravchenko: ^7--my men are loyal to Omega. "We were the First. We are the Last." That portal does not close. Not until we have Zykov.
hash_814ea18a7fdfc00: ^9Peck: ^7All teams are in position, ready to proceed. Colonel?
hash_543d75f58c8b71cc: ^9Peck: ^7Barrier membrane is fluctuating. Increase voltage output by ten.
hash_121d76d54ee8ae0e: ^9Peck: ^7We're picking up something, I'm just not sure what.
hash_5b7076c40ec5d3fe: ^9Peck: ^7--I'm just telling you the date has changed, all right? June 4th. If you want him, you'll have to move fast.
hash_318175d2e9af44fb: ^9Peck: ^7The Forsaken's cage has been completed to your specifications. Once Zykov gives us the creature's location, we'll extract him directly into our captivity.
hash_2d9e3868e155e18: ^9Peck: ^7Kravchenko is blinded by abject loyalty and his determination to appease his superiors. You know this. Ever since you first told him about the Forsaken--
hash_66c62e5eecc31d85: ^9Peck: ^7Don't bullshit a bullshitter. I'm not stupid -- I know it was you. I'll admit, at first I thought it was Strauss... maybe Weaver, but it's been you this whole time. You're the Requiem mole. I just want to figure out why.
hash_659b0d4a97f79a5a: ^9Peck: ^7Hey, remember: you came to me at Outpost 25. You told me to get rid of her, despite Kravchenko's orders. I threw her in the Dark Aether for you. Just because you didn't anticipate they'd get her back, that's not on me.
hash_7daa01afce3cbac7: ^9Peck: ^7All I'm saying is, you want this thing: the Forsaken. You want it so badly that you don't care which side gets it for you, as long as you get it. If you're gonna pull this off, you need me.
hash_25073e2b6ececda4: ^9Peck: ^7So we have an agreement? Clean slate?
hash_a428a3a98c1bec1: ^9Peck: ^7Good. I'll let you know when. Have your men ready.
hash_4919630108c266c3: ^9Gorev: ^7Your contact, he can guarantee our safety?
hash_40cc028429847eb4: ^9Jager: ^7We will be granted safe passage -- and possibly employment, depending on how we play our parts. We are privy to a world of secrets few know even exist. In the right hands, we are more valuable alive. But, in Kravchenko's...
hash_3bc29a0387226f96: ^9Jager: ^7Cheer up, Gorev. We're the heroes in this. Like your Spaghetti Westerns. Ja?
hash_1ef85c7ec66ecdc9: ^9Jager: ^7I'm Steven McQueen, and you're... well, you're the other guy.
hash_796e7da047329abb: ^9Gorev: ^7Provided events transpire as you predict... then yes.
hash_a39d3f24927cfee: ^9Jager: ^7I will not let that man catch me with my pants around my ankles.
hash_5d7e3f8448e4b8: ^9Jager: ^7So, to recap. First: Kravchenko and Peck free Zykov. Who, in turn, points them to the Forsaken's location.
hash_74eab5411f645637: ^9Gorev: ^7Once they have that, they extract it from the Dark Aether and place it securely in their prison box.
hash_7639b1c87bd2c02a: ^9Jager: ^7At which point we swoop in with our hind, as instructed, to take the cage to the facility outside Moscow.
hash_62b36ecc2de37c3b: ^9Jager: ^7That is... if everything goes according to plan. If things fall apart?
hash_3deeadaad1ede0b: ^<Ravenov: ^7The Lost Russian. A man out of time, buried so deep within the Dark Aether, special equipment is needed to free him.
hash_72ae774014907bca: ^<Ravenov: ^7But where to house such a massive operation? You need space, power... privacy.
hash_2c737470d154c8d4: ^<Ravenov: ^7And what of my end of the bargain? Agent Maxis.
hash_460431cea58cdd60: ^8Weaver: ^7Once we have Zykov, she'll be released. I have the Director's word.
hash_a2628dd8e28b0d6: ^<Ravenov: ^7I could care less about his. Do I have yours?
hash_1e4882cab7f84ee0: ^<Ravenov: ^7There is an old Spetsnaz Training Facility. At the Zakarpatska Oblast, in the Ukraine. It was given to Omega for early Operatsiya Inversiya testing in '84. We called it 'Test Site Anna'.
hash_25b0499b157ad9cd: ^8Weaver: ^7...I have friends who did. I didn't know it was repurposed.
hash_4801417edfd08b57: ^<Ravenov: ^7Ah, good. I was getting worried you actually did end up in that Dreamland cell.
hash_4bd58d0ec1dc8746: ^<Ravenov: ^7With good reason. It was shuttered after an incident in '81. I trust this is all you need?
hash_6a195a50081d3530: ^8Weaver: ^7I'll keep you informed when we make our move, Ravenov.
hash_7ad51bd433f0310: ^<Ravenov: ^7I'll do you one better: I'll be there.
hash_50d57930945c60d0: ^<Ravenov: ^7I trust our mutual friend is listening in?
hash_799fd1b17aa92bba: ^<Ravenov: ^7You can never be too sure these days. Trust is in short supply, especially amongst allies.
hash_29face7d60ff9cbf: ^8Weaver: ^7We're still combing through it, but so far we've been able to corroborate everything in there.
hash_45006695092f4fe6: ^8Weaver: ^7There's just one thing missing. Operatsiya Izbavitel: where will it happen?
hash_6c7409c9a7de31ee: ^<Ravenov: ^7Quite the undertaking, isn't it? A massive particle accelerator, and a specialized machine built with a single purpose -- to find, and extract, a needle from a haystack.
hash_18198cba2605c20d: ^8Strauss: ^7Throughout my studies of Dark Aether crystalline structures, few have intrigued me as much as the symbiotic relationship shared by three particularly unique and rare crystals.
hash_150e9b3188814f5c: ^8Strauss: ^7On a molecular level, these three are codependent. While each can survive on its own, they are exponentially more powerful when unified.
hash_6240151790d347af: ^8Strauss: ^7There is the Polymorphic Crystal Core, which has developed the most fascinating survival technique -- it can reconfigure its form at will.
hash_5d1128368b3b47e: ^8Strauss: ^7There is the Energetic Geode, a highly volatile crystal that can evolve when impacted with high concentrations of Aetherium.
hash_5a846896bcccf0e9: ^8Strauss: ^7And there is the Tempered Crystal Heart -- the name is no misnomer, it is quite literally the crystalline heart from a Dark Aether species, extracted only when exposed to extreme heat.
hash_e408b1510931e88: ^8Strauss: ^7When all three are submerged in an Aetherium pool, they coalesce, forging an ancient Aethereal weapon.
hash_7df00fe8296a33eb: ^8Strauss: ^7The Tempered Crystal and Geode are both naturally occurring. But considering its function-driven final form, I believe the Polymorphic Crystal is manufactured by something in the Dark Aether, enabling the symbiotic relationship among the three.
hash_778c38dd4f424e9a: ^8Strauss: ^7As to who created it, we may never know. But their creation speaks for itself.
hash_48dd208ce350708f: ^8Weaver: ^7How the hell... how did Grey turn this thing on?
hash_25164c32e99efdbe: ^8Weaver: ^7Yet we're not the only ones you're talking to. You've been playing both sides.
hash_549c0839da1a6a5c: ^<Zykov: ^7You both want the same thing: to stop the Forsaken. I just want to come home. How I accomplish that means little to me.
hash_703d6449f4b3b2cc: ^8Weaver: ^7Pretty selfish. Needs of one over the needs of millions.
hash_5de7a013b7e9f616: ^<Zykov: ^7You do not know the Dark Aether the way I do. You could not possibly understand what I have done -- what I have sacrificed -- to survive this wretched Hell.
hash_290aea34293ed1a9: ^<Zykov: ^7If you were in my shoes, you would not be so quick to judge.
hash_674f675c4f805d88: ^8Weaver: ^7Here's what I know. Omega is planning on bringing you home. I know where and I know when.
hash_3c230850d00003b9: ^8Weaver: ^7I just need to know one last thing: if we recover you from Omega, will you side with us? Will you help us?
hash_12d355d737ff81f: ^8Weaver: ^7You will help us stop the Forsaken. I want your word. Russian to Russian.
hash_6cb19ef270627725: ^<Zykov: ^7It is funny. When I speak to Russia, I talk to American. When I speak to America, I talk to Russian. Your world is... confusing.
hash_5b808d3e62c44e0f: ^<Zykov: ^7No, Grigori. It was simple once. Once upon a time, you knew who your enemies were.
hash_6cda8f88d493d44: ^8Weaver: ^7You don't know me. At least, I don't think so.
hash_a031ac2af812872: ^8Weaver: ^7From your point of view, I bet its hard to tell the difference these days.
hash_44279c5019a9dbba: ^<Zykov: ^7Ah: so Requiem. Omega would not possess such self-awareness.
hash_6bdd76bd8dd89e5b: ^<Zykov: ^7But you are... Russian. And you side with the Americans?
hash_7b620b1322fc5a67: ^8Weaver: ^7I think you know it's never that simple.
hash_3e6e30ea71bc34ee: ^8Weaver: ^7My name's Grigori Weaver. Special Operations Officer at Requiem. For the last seventeen months, you've been in contact with my team. You've helped them survive. You've tested them. All with a singular purpose: coming home.
hash_45e4dc315680a424: ^8Weaver: ^7Major Carver. To what do I owe the pleasure?
hash_54078d1ea5efb206: ^8Weaver: ^7If our operation is a success... Kravchenko will have no moves left to make. Omega will be finished. Chebrikov will decide his fate.
hash_2437c78e3d83e145: ^8Weaver: ^7When you work under the Soviet hammer, it always ends the same way.
hash_1ea539de346d85cd: ^8Carver: ^7So. We finish this. Omega is defeated. Zykov helps us stop the Forsaken. Then what?
hash_3c903ae4f4eb1787: ^8Carver: ^7I dunno, I just... can't shake this feeling.
hash_65c01b569f37f0b0: ^8Carver: ^7During Apache Snow, I took part in... let's just say I haven't forgotten it. It came back with me. I couldn't wash it off. We called it "The Stick".
hash_362d77c455eb59a9: ^8Carver: ^7Requiem, the Dark Aether, this whole op? We can't just wash this away either. We know things most can never imagine.
hash_7eabc66b83fc9812: ^8Carver: ^7Well, considering we're on the verge of victory... I think I'll take that drink now.
hash_23a1e5229cb11a96: ^8Weaver: ^7About time. Grab a chair. What's got you in such a good mood?
hash_2fcd77976ad97968: ^8Carver: ^7I could ask you the same thing.
hash_158deacd016e4ba0: ^8Weaver: ^7At 1500 tomorrow, Operation First Domino will be underway. Our team touches down at the Zakarpatska Oblast. Within an hour, Kazimir Zykov will be in Requiem custody.
hash_75390299715a950d: ^8Weaver: ^7If we have the opportunity, we engage, but Zykov is priority one. You know this.
hash_17d6197dd931956a: ^<Unknown: ^7Come. Closer. Do not be afraid, my child. It is only me.
hash_7a977906651707db: ^<Unknown: ^7I have missed you. Oh, how I wish I could have been there more. Watching you sleep. Holding your hand. Teaching you all that I know, then unleashing you upon the world to do... great and terrible things.
hash_206a2d93ef141c66: ^<Vogel: ^7But I taught you enough. And I was always there in spirit -- in your heart. I must be content with that. For you are no longer my child. You stand upon your own achievements now.
hash_3cf9dc3a2dfc9187: ^<Vogel: ^7Never forget me. And never forget how proud I am of you. My greatest work. My gift to the world.
hash_3bfd911fe9f08da6: ^<Unknown: ^7Now... tell me what you have done for me.
hash_78796995aa6e646d: ^9Valentina: ^7--Honestly, I am surprised you thought this could be kept secret.
hash_ad9855c77bd7fea: ^9Valentina: ^7No... I don't think that is necessary.
hash_401d9009aef04c9: ^9Peck: ^7You act like I've done something wrong! All I did was talk to it!
hash_7b3b8feea554571b: ^9Valentina: ^7And what is it? Who is it? This person on the computer.
hash_6d1955c633fa542a: ^9Valentina: ^7Speak up, Doctor! Are you loyal to Omega's cause or to yourself? Who are you are speaking to?
hash_539ccf4d08b81dc0: ^9Peck: ^7Ugh... He won't tell me his name. He just told me I need to prepare.
hash_678254d2695d67ed: ^9Peck: ^7He says something is coming... an army of some sort.
hash_5aa4cd036561fb87: ^9Valentina: ^7This army. What did he tell you of it?
hash_48b28101094e023: ^9Peck: ^7He called it... the greatest evil the world has ever known. He said he would help me, if I helped bring him home.
hash_28a8e9e7bb350134: ^9Peck: ^7Ugh... I don't know. Maybe I am losing it. I've been working too much. I can't sleep. Seeing things that aren't there.
hash_9112f8036bb24d1: ^9Peck: ^7You should speak to him. Maybe it would make more sense to you.
hash_7c04876f6c4e693e: ^8Carver: ^7While a whole lot has been going right for us in the Oh-Zee, Field Ops is reporting an increase in Dark Aether assaults on our strike teams and security patrols.
hash_5346d4cc35f6c1f7: ^8Carver: ^7It's almost as if the infected are changing up their tactics. They're starting to ambush our people with heavily armed undead... hordes.
hash_31f8ef1201979024: ^8Carver: ^7Well, maybe "horde" isn't quite the right word. That implies a lack of organization. But the reports I'm seeing refer to specific combinations of enemies -- foot-soldiers supporting elites, working together in a coordinated fashion.
hash_5ad7a7350b2c907d: ^8Carver: ^7This all started happening after we took down a few of their high-value targets. I can't help but think they've realized we're going after their top brass, and now they're out for payback.
hash_6c07b2055d535272: ^8Carver: ^7I don't know. Maybe I'm overestimating their brainpower. I mean, even ants will pull together to defend their queen.
hash_41c9161cde4a459b: ^8Carver: ^7But what if I'm right? What if these hordes really are organized death squads? Our little war with the Dark Aether may have just entered a whole new phase. Fuck.
hash_48af8be157c6549f: ^8Carver: ^7Okay, Mac, okay. Just gotta take a breath now and shake off these jitters. Think it through...
hash_47a779de2a9bc806: ^8Carver: ^7Fact: Dark Aether hostiles come in different classes, different threat levels. It's why we're calling some Specials, some Elites, and some... Apex-level.
hash_2a43f59707f00545: ^8Carver: ^7Fact: we've seen them work together, attacking us with a mix of offensive capabilities. Reminds me of how we outfit platoons with a range of weapons -- riflemen, snipers, heavy gunners. The others roll their eyes when I point this out, but I know a tactical unit when I see one.
hash_253c1b0efbfbdd4c: ^8Carver: ^7And then there's what I saw today, while I was waiting in the Director's office...
hash_ccd0218a07c74e3: ^8Carver: ^7It was right there on his desk, face up in his in-box. Straight from the DNI -- "Eyes Only." You don't just leave that kind of document lying around. Was he testing me?
hash_8299383d01d081a: ^8Carver: ^7Anyhow, the memo confirms what I've been trying to warn them about. They know there's a top dog on the other side -- some kind of entity in charge of the rest.
hash_425569bb356a7ce9: ^8Carver: ^7So why aren't we talking about that? Why aren't we making plans to take that damned thing out? Gonna have to play this cool, act like I didn't see nothing.
hash_56cb9f0cf18bef24: ^<Vogel: ^7Ulrich Vogel, director of Projekt Endstation. 29th of January, 1945. *sigh*
hash_3ffd138c177e5a3d: ^<Vogel: ^7Well, it is finally done. Two days ago we bid farewell to those sent here by the Fuhrer to carry out Operation Baldr. Godspeed, heroes of the Reich.
hash_629d69e51a17d46e: ^<Vogel: ^7Unfortunately, the strain proved too much for the cyclotron. Several seals blew on the cooling unit and radioactive steam contaminated the station.
hash_66a3110cf64a532f: ^<Vogel: ^7I ordered an evacuation. The entire staff is gone now -- on their way to join our forces in retreat, but with the Red Army advancing, I can only hope they got away in time.
hash_1c327afd58ccaf18: ^<Vogel: ^7As for me, I have chosen to remain and monitor the equipment. I must confirm Task Force Baldr is in position. Everything now rides on their success.
hash_2629319f4e274d91: ^<Vogel: ^7I have no illusions about my chances here. This is Soviet territory now and when they find me they will surely kill me. But in a sense they are already too late.
hash_2bfa6fcfe166f092: ^<Vogel: ^7I alone have secured the future of our nation.
hash_73e9fd28b03284aa: ^<Ravenov: ^7These scientists report directly to Valentina and Peck. We both know what that would mean for Requiem.
hash_51a70c348c0e6eb: ^<Ravenov: ^7The embassy is a death sentence. You know this. We may as well deliver them straight to gulag.
hash_65234b2d38cfac0f: ^8Weaver: ^7Okay... okay. Let me run it upstairs. I'll be touch.
hash_2cc6474b842899b6: ^8Weaver: ^7Oh, and Ravenov? Don't ever call me on Sam's line again.
hash_68988e59df81f347: ^8Weaver: ^7Ravenov? You've got some balls using this line after what you and Sam did.
hash_40744971ff9ba1d3: ^<Ravenov: ^7We did the right thing. You may not say it out loud, but I know, in your heart, you agree.
hash_4be7bd68bcf5488d: ^8Weaver: ^7If you have intelligence, you contact me, Ravenov. Maxis is not C-I-A. She can't help you.
hash_6c0d64fca301dd19: ^<Ravenov: ^7And yet, we achieved what you could not: dissent and division within Omega itself.
hash_351d97f7eb87b16f: ^<Ravenov: ^7The fallout from Operatsiya Inversiya. In Omega. People are talking. Staff are scared -- concerned about the KGB's direction. Some believe they have gone too far.
hash_39f6545df0b276be: ^<Ravenov: ^7I have been contacted. By a group of Omega Scientists. They wish to defect.
hash_7a509ff1e84bce16: ^8Weaver: ^7Great. They know where the embassy is in Moscow.
hash_31e9dfe35df72494: ^<Ravenov: ^7Don't be a mudak, Weaver. These are good people. They defect not out of hatred, but out of passion. They seek to right Omega's wrongs.
hash_5f6c54bd893e8b56: ^<Ravenov: ^7Khoroshiy, comrade. That is the spirit. I will be in touch. When the time is right.
hash_5d21c83d5f7f76b5: ^<Ravenov: ^7Khoroshiye novosti! Good news indeed. I knew you would see things my way.
hash_f748ebc6f994a91: ^8Weaver: ^7Here's the deal. First. I need names, ranks, ages, breakdowns on all the defectors -- and their roles.
hash_dab24672447c46b: ^8Weaver: ^7Next. The scientists are to travel to the Ural Mountains. We'll use my strike team for evac while they're in the Oh-Zee.
hash_233764707926af11: ^<Ravenov: ^7It will be done. When the scientists are in position, I will contact you to provide extraction.
hash_4b93024f932a5fcd: ^8Weaver: ^7One more thing. We do this, we do it my way. You work with me. No more of this behind my back bullshit. Understood?
hash_1ec255391299ba13: ^<Zykov: ^7Oh, my friend, I am so happy to speak to you like this. For so long, I feared I would never again find a worthy ally.
hash_4d6916c4fdc9c712: ^<Zykov: ^7I also hope someday soon you can tell me about how the world has changed. I have caught glimpses now and then -- glass towers, cars everywhere, passenger planes filling the skies...
hash_7f0ebde7a925c569: ^<Zykov: ^7I tried my best to stay current -- especially when I crafted this machine, this..."computer." We did not have those during the war.
hash_2874c8fce58b07f8: ^<Zykov: ^7But there have also been many changes over here since I arrived -- and none of them good.
hash_3831870caa492957: ^<Zykov: ^7This is why I had to contact you. To warn you. The threat at your doorstep is even greater than you know. We have much to do, you and I.
hash_3ae27506303c12ba: ^<Zykov: ^7Sometimes I watch you salvage scraps and take them to the Crafting Table. I see you transform useless garbage into weapons and... you remind me of me.
hash_62984f73a46ad55b: ^<Zykov: ^7I have watched you for some time now. I spent countless days preparing to communicate even before my first message at Endstation.
hash_15d9d60afc82e0e0: ^<Zykov: ^7That was a great moment -- the culmination of years of work. Gathering parts. Cobbling together the machines I sent to help inform you... to give you what you needed to survive.
hash_19e94d60e24f4051: ^<Zykov: ^7I suppose I should be thankful this place is filled with so many items from our world. It is a junk yard of the ages. Scraps from different places and eras litter this landscape.
hash_4e466dfce1a35a1e: ^<Zykov: ^7But even after all this time, I do not know how or why they got here. I only know they provided this old mechanic with just enough tools and materials to save my life... and possibly yours.
hash_24bc941ac0875e7f: ^<Zykov: ^7But as you know by now, I was not the only one watching you. I was not the only one making plans.
hash_b1f54ceb8caafd: ^<Zykov: ^7The people you answer to -- the ones giving you orders. Surely they are beginning to realize what you are up against.
hash_e7805a1202445cc: ^<Zykov: ^7There is indeed an army gathering here in the darkness. They have waited even longer than I have to cross into our world. The invasion is at hand.
hash_6e93b265c1bc54c7: ^<Zykov: ^7It will happen soon, and in the worst place possible. For all your efforts to keep the Dark Aether secret, that may no longer be an option once this army mobilizes.
hash_189d9d7afead7546: ^<Zykov: ^7You have seen their like before. The greatest evil the world has ever known, corrupted by this place into even greater darkness.
hash_7e7eff68dbd8cd9: ^<Zykov: ^7Warn your people. Make ready. They are coming and you must stand fast against them.
hash_6f31b6e787ef2134: ^<Zykov: ^7By now your commanding officers are aware of me, yes? They must also be asking why I am helping you. What is Zykov the Survivor hoping to gain from this?
hash_3cc34d0519c505c5: ^<Zykov: ^7Americans. For them, everything is about gain. That much I know. I do not say this to be unkind. America was built on self-interest. It is the bedrock of human nature.
hash_26e0e3fb25d2054e: ^<Zykov: ^7My friend, what I hope for, first and foremost, is to save our world from the Dark Aether. If nothing else comes of this, my sacrifice will have been worth it.
hash_22d843a73f0044af: ^<Zykov: ^7But I am not without self-interest. I am human, after all. And so I very much hope you will find a way to release me from this dismal prison.
hash_28d1102c337107a: ^<Fedorov: ^7Adrik Fedorov, efreitor, Omega Group. *weary sigh* Why do I still call myself that? Why do I even keep making these reports?
hash_1a0dd1a9483b7e4f: ^<Fedorov: ^7I lost track how long I have been here. Surely it has been years. There used to be more people here. Lost, like me. But so many are gone now -- food for the dragon.
hash_223ace587386f874: ^<Fedorov: ^7Yes. A dragon. That is also a rocket ship. *nervous laugh* I don't even try to make sense of these things any more.
hash_531cbc81d2e67641: ^<Fedorov: ^7What I know for sure is the dragon must be fed. It demands sustenance. And then it delivers this banquet of souls to the One.
hash_4bdde366295f4606: ^<Fedorov: ^7I... do not like to even speak of the One, but his shadow falls over us all, and we must pay tribute.
hash_42964d9517b5016b: ^<Fedorov: ^7At first we sacrificed the weak. Strangers, friends, it did not matter. Then, we who still remained began hunting each other...
hash_4666b276d1ed65f0: ^<Fedorov: ^7I... I have to go. It is hungry again -- I have to go!
hash_14aa74efa3338905: ^<Fedorov: ^7Fedorov. Efreitor. Omega. Still here. Still recording...
hash_13c107fa9dfec368: ^<Fedorov: ^7When I first arrived, many things frightened me. I would not admit this, of course. I was Spetsnaz. We feared nothing. But, still...
hash_115d498f8f4f6043: ^<Fedorov: ^7Anyone who has to fight and kill a comrade...who died a week before...and then tells you they felt no fear? Yerunda.
hash_6f9ec7b5a0af869e: ^<Fedorov: ^7But what disturbed me most in those early days was the ball of light that sounds like children laughing.
hash_737780d147535779: ^<Fedorov: ^7What was it? What was it made from? The souls of dead children? Did it... did it consume children? Did it use their laughter as a lure? None of the possibilities were good. Bozhe moi, it disturbed me.
hash_3fc4a82bd3fb8f6c: ^<Fedorov: ^7But, you know...I stopped seeing it after a while. I began to think I had just dreamed it up. And then, just yesterday, there it was. Giggling.
hash_b22cb77be299687: ^<Fedorov: ^7And I found... I was not scared anymore. I was just... sad. I will never again hear that sound for real. I will never have children of my own. I will never, ever know such innocence again.
hash_7808b147e7363432: ^<Fedorov: ^7And now I have my answer. I know what the orb is made of. It is made of heartbreak. It is made of loss.
hash_7c2a5c3bd1628ddd: ^<Fedorov: ^7I have not felt like... myself in a very long time. I know the change is upon me. I have seen it in too many others... to not recognize it in myself.
hash_133578b92c37276: ^<Fedorov: ^7Began with mouth... tasting like battery. Then my skin turned... bluish... and started to crack.
hash_216c9b9d15cae69b: ^<Fedorov: ^7At first... I shed flakes of skin. Then...I noticed the flakes...were made of crystals. *coughs*
hash_5cd22e94216a18f1: ^<Fedorov: ^7The One...has chosen me. He is making me...into one of his soldiers.
hash_99e611dd94c096a: ^<Fedorov: ^7The...crystals they... They call to me now. I try to stay away, but... the more I change... the more I need them... *coughs/growls*
hash_55e48d3b38bac4f2: ^8Maxis: ^7I may have helped 'open the door', but that doesn't mean I was in control.
hash_608611b27cd5ac9: ^8Grey: ^7How can you be you sure if you don't really remember?
hash_3858dbc3a911836c: ^8Maxis: ^7I'm no stranger to memory loss - my childhood is almost a complete blank - but that doesn't mean I don't know who I am and what I've done.
hash_3164d8ff46190c1b: ^8Grey: ^7You really don't remember anything prior to the orphanage? Who looked after you? Before? After?
hash_15d304dc377382be: ^8Maxis: ^7Be careful, Lizzie - You shouldn't expect anyone to look after you. Only you can do that.
hash_1a49a321aa7cf53d: ^8Grey: ^7I'm... gonna go now... If that's okay?
hash_5476139ce5f38a84: ^8Grey: ^7How did you know it was me?
hash_4b2ab6d115190e61: ^8Maxis: ^7I don't know what Strauss and Carver get up to in their personal lives, but as far as I know - You're the only one who wears heels.
hash_3c65cdbf4986ecfe: ^8Grey: ^7How are you doing, Sam? Have any more memories... come back?
hash_5c6f3d5f2d724a9b: ^8Maxis: ^7About my time in the Dark Aether? Only what you already know. It's mostly a blur - Scavenging supplies by day, fighting for my life by night.
hash_62b7bfe8566dd22: ^8Maxis: ^7Not that it matters - it's always dark over there.
hash_472cce064bb5206b: ^8Grey: ^7I am sorry. I really, really am.
hash_13ff9a24510d15ca: ^8Grey: ^7Have I said that before? If I didn't - I really meant to.
hash_1be2bf4b32a0104f: ^8Maxis: ^7If you're here to ask me if I was the one who made all this happen - the answer is no. I didn't make the outbreak zones.
hash_325c89108330e30c: ^8Grey: ^7But it... almost sounded like you had 'some' control over the creatures at Outpost 25.
hash_703e721e5c449845: ^8Maxis: ^7I keep dreaming that I'm in the field - Fighting for something. Over and over again.
hash_5305298ff0631636: ^8Weaver: ^7Sam, you understand that we - I - can't let that happen... not yet.
hash_7b7db4f3cd16e027: ^8Maxis: ^7Do you think there's something wrong with me?
hash_6260d3dac3913ccb: ^8Weaver: ^7Get some rest, Sam. It's important that you feel better.
hash_2713a0f567a22b1c: ^8Weaver: ^7I was... hoping we could talk about yesterday.
hash_36e1abd10b9ebca9: ^8Maxis: ^7It's hard to keep things straight in my mind... Especially with the cocktail of drugs you're giving me... every day.
hash_798fffbd17d6c458: ^8Weaver: ^7It's for your own good, Sam. We just want to help. Your 'outbursts' are a cause for concern - You must understand that.
hash_1f80763448ec0789: ^8Weaver: ^7The nurse was only trying to do his job.
hash_74ee52674175db25: ^8Maxis: ^7Besides - the 'medications' don't help. They don't stop the dreams.
hash_3d1cdf53d79b1c4e: ^8Weaver: ^7Dogs can be very comforting. They're empathetic. They pick up on your emotions.
hash_5ed534cbe97b28d: ^8Weaver: ^7Yes - I brought you a rottweiler. She's not dangerous. She would never hurt anyone.
hash_7a6277d8633c95e3: ^8Weaver: ^7Because I trust you, Sam - and I need you to know that.
hash_2a19376b1cfe2009: ^8Weaver: ^7I want you to work out who you are - for yourself.
hash_345635d5e9ee3816: ^8Weaver: ^7But - Maybe you should... start keeping a diary - just to get down your thoughts.
hash_7f87139e1587f3a5: ^8Maxis: ^7What makes you think I haven't been doing that already?
hash_7a6f745023ff08cf: ^8Weaver: ^7Take care of yourself, Sam - and the dog.
hash_2975a09d25883ac5: ^8Weaver: ^7There's someone I'd like you to meet. Someone I think might help you feel better.
hash_72bb2a7fa2ae7c92: ^8Maxis: ^7I'm in a white, sterile room, Weaver. I'm not sure who - or what - you think is going to make me feel better.
hash_970676a325e6c91: ^8Maxis: ^7I've already met Grey, Strauss and Carver... Who's next?
hash_166a4464c6773c2: ^8Weaver: ^7I thought you might appreciate making a new friend. Someone who won't ask any you more questions. Someone who doesn't want anything other than to make you happy.
hash_48fa1b0c30b36877: ^8Weaver: ^7She. She's a she. I get that the short hair and large build doesn't look too cuddly, but I thought her being here might be good for you - Some companionship while you...
hash_3aabd98017d4cf72: ^8Maxis: ^7I wish I was there with you - in the Ural mountains - Fighting back. Trying to make sure we don't lose ourselves completely...
hash_675a8e2f8e063b2b: ^8Maxis: ^7But, no - I am here. Not where I should be. Not where I want to be. You won't even hear me. They took my radio.
hash_1b59da78de32a015: ^8Maxis: ^7No. Not alone. I do have a friend - someone who cares about me.
hash_7a9a5121168d8d3e: ^8Maxis: ^7But... I don't even know her name.
hash_5212f0ba3b102537: ^8Maxis: ^7You are doing the right thing. That's what matters.
hash_30a00e0f8cacac71: ^8Maxis: ^7We will catch up - We have to believe that.
hash_28838223831b7593: ^8Maxis: ^7Despite what Omega are, I know there are good Russians out there...
hash_53c41fb81511e35a: ^8Maxis: ^7None of us should be defined by our nationality... Our Race.... Our gender...
hash_27044579afc3ab4: ^8Maxis: ^7I think I know a way to get in contact with him...
hash_6306923bbc10bec7: ^9Kravchenko: ^7--Just a moment. 22nd of July, 1984. Commencing meeting.
hash_4b1d62fa0c20f8e2: ^9Valentina: ^7I am, above all else, loyal to Omega. While it is true you have--
hash_6e49eeea9eea8853: ^9Valentina: ^7--"adjusted" its parameters, if you believe it is the correct course of action, you have my full support.
hash_4165fe54d0da075e: ^9Kravchenko: ^7I already had that. Give me your honesty. You must have questions.
hash_29997edbaffc8b5e: ^9Valentina: ^7...where did I fail? When I brought it to the Committee, they seemed impressed. Did my targets present too great a risk? Was my plan too ambitious?
hash_475473ab7f53dbb2: ^9Kravchenko: ^7You were not ambitious enough! But that is not a failing of yours. There is much you do not know.
hash_7fec0cc8a535391b: ^9Kravchenko: ^7My intelligence tells me there is something out there. It is watching our world, looking for a way in. If it finds one... we must be ready.
hash_13dd93547e6249e8: ^9Kravchenko: ^7Rest assured. The West will be ours. But first... we must face the wolf at the door.
hash_20ca4aaa7084a77b: ^9Valentina: ^7As always, I follow your orders. I am committed to our cause. We were the first--
hash_6b26a22874d08595: ^9Kravchenko: ^7--And we are the last. Very good.
hash_718a3dcc7d18dec4: ^9Kravchenko: ^7Without you, my Operatsiya Inversiya would not exist.
hash_741fb1fda5ced881: ^9Valentina: ^7Always happy to build a solid foundation, Colonel.
hash_41e64bf9073f3703: ^9Valentina: ^7You said you wanted to see me?
hash_7fed17f93c0569c0: ^9Kravchenko: ^7Doctor, how do you find my leadership techniques?
hash_3814703f031fa62: ^9Kravchenko: ^7...and you would agree that should be our goal, da? To produce results. Above all else.
hash_20551f586dea76af: ^9Valentina: ^7Of course, Colonel. What is this about?
hash_42d749d1bbb38404: ^9Kravchenko: ^7It occurred to me you have said very little about my... "commandeering" of Operatsiya Inversiya.
hash_7c66ffe477000e46: ^9Kravchenko: ^7Come now. It was your project. Until I swooped in and... snatched it from you. You must be upset. Angry.
hash_3a037186d8a746fa: ^9Peck: ^7Ok ok...Now just a sec. This is one of our men. And the armor is very similar... but it is not the same. Look at the color. The design. This isn't my work.
hash_56352f5021771ac4: ^9Peck: ^7And as far as I know, Aetherium crystals rot your brain, they can't give your car a new coat of paint.
hash_7abd9e2a50c1ff49: ^9Gorev: ^7We keep this between us for now. The Colonel... has developed "fiery" new ideas. I do not wish to add more kindling. Understood?
hash_63b7d20c6a66fccc: ^9Gorev: ^7Good. Peck: see that this "thing" is destroyed.
hash_15cab1a3e2abc83f: ^9Valentina: ^7If it is not, Gorev, at the very least it will be amusing.
hash_2ac312fc88b69935: ^9Peck: ^7Funny. Come over here, hold this retractor.
hash_1b1ea419d8e32b88: ^9Peck: ^7Almost... got it. Here. Look at this.
hash_514d1ca98b7d870a: ^9Peck: ^7Lieutenant Kazakov. Omega Armored Division at Outpost 25. He--
hash_41d2f13e07ba2744: ^9Valentina: ^7--he escorted the Aethernauts in one of your tank suits, yes, I saw the blueprint. What is your point?
hash_5171b5df5b5d4027: ^9Gorev: ^7I am confused as well. We have seen this before. We lose men in Dark Aether, they come back with bad skin rash. This Krasny Soldat is no different than others we have seen transformed by Aetherium.
hash_720c989c623ae343: ^9Peck: ^7Ah! See, that is what I thought as well. You're half-right.
hash_30eeb2ddb758f206: ^9Peck: ^7Peck. Personal log. September 3rd, 1984.... 2:35 AM. The Witching Hour approaches.
hash_f91771263315f3d: ^9Peck: ^7I found one of those computers. From the... from the Dark Aether. Omega's studied them, but don't have much to show for it.
hash_2458d47416662d0: ^9Peck: ^7But I've... I've spoken to someone. Someone on the other side.
hash_8dea605608a69b3: ^9Peck: ^7I haven't told the others. Need to be careful. Keep my cards close to my chest.
hash_26a0c4f6e1f5aac0: ^9Peck: ^7It's been nearly two months since my arrival. Work on the Inversion Warheads proceeds as planned. Operations continue to run smoothly, but...
hash_3a864a7c429af4ed: ^9Peck: ^7Damn it all, you're right, Peck. You're always right. That's not what this is about.
hash_5ccf7d8694907302: ^9Peck: ^7Look... too many sleepless nights. Maybe it's too much time down here in the deep... in the darkness. I could go to the surface, but there... there are things up there science just can't explain.
hash_2545db5e54419b4f: ^9Peck: ^7The demonic echoes that keep tormenting my staff... an aethereal orb that...
hash_21ac7b5115ed838c: ^9Peck: ^7I don't know... it cries out with the laughter of children? It's enough to drive a man insane.
hash_5705ceaa742c91c9: ^9Peck: ^7Ugh. Not that I'm insane. No no, I'm holding it together. Nothing to worry about here. Old noggin's good.
hash_35fd495d5323cbce: ^9Peck: ^7But we keep trying to bend this reality to work for us. We mine and pilfer for resources to build our weapons and warheads... we really have no clue what we're dealing with, do we?
hash_900d739100c3c8b: ^9Peck: ^7I mean, one second this place is trying to kill you, the next it's dropping treasure chests out of the sky. Am I crazy, or... or are we vastly underestimating the powers in play?
hash_7d3238ca9a0f9df9: ^9Valentina: ^7He visited me again tonight. As I slept, he appeared before me. He is but a shadow to me. So close yet so far. He told me to have faith. I must stay the course.
hash_603e87e9d2e38926: ^9Valentina: ^7There were recent developments last month that were... unanticipated. He assured me that all was not lost. His plan, our plan, is still on schedule.
hash_4553ca4b8b7eb427: ^9Valentina: ^7He had... new instructions for me. I will see that they are completed.
hash_6c07f23be6496dcc: ^9Valentina: ^7We will be reunited. We will rise again. Our destiny is all but assured.
hash_71c3212f5a7b4acd: ^9Valentina: ^7Hello Peck--it seems like you're finally settling in. Back in "groove," as it were.
hash_17e46d54b9374a6f: ^9Peck: ^7...let me assure you, we're making excellent progress. Harnessing those crystalline creatures has certainly sped up development.
hash_40de178ee387933b: ^9Valentina: ^7Is that so? I trust you are taking appropriate security measures.
hash_4a91f5e468d7d069: ^9Peck: ^7Hey now. I only lost my eye, not my attention to detail.
hash_10255bfc28eb1a0d: ^9Valentina: ^7Is that supposed to be a joke?
hash_77b8e9e24b4a6927: ^9Valentina: ^7Just send me a report on your latest security protocols.
hash_219f23bb22711278: ^9Valentina: ^7And that facility blueprint I asked for.
hash_29f8844153f5a29: ^9Peck: ^7Yeah, well, "the Groove" used to have 20/20 vision.
hash_227adcc2151610fb: ^9Valentina: ^7*Tsk-tsk*. You Americans are so soft and spoiled.
hash_6aca6fc61e96cd0a: ^9Valentina: ^7Life is full of pain, Peck. After my Father died, my uncle took me in. He was cruel, did not believe woman should have education. Made me work in his factory.
hash_643feac1036166b9: ^9Valentina: ^7So what did I do? Every night I snuck into library and I read. Biochemistry, microbiology, physics. At sixteen, I was accepted at university.
hash_320be09d06435d38: ^9Valentina: ^7If I can survive childhood, you can survive little eye problem.
hash_554674e86856f803: ^9Peck: ^7How did you convince your uncle to let you go to school?
hash_67d03030e12a4725: ^9Valentina: ^7Convince him? When he found out, he tried to imprison me in basement, so I slit his throat.
hash_1f5ac3a6f529c104: ^9Gorev: ^7Comeback Kid. One of my birds said you were looking for me.
hash_a37ca65297163d2: ^9Peck: ^7Just. Just have your men do sweeps for these Echoes. The Colonel has accelerated our delivery schedule for the warheads. We cannot afford any more delays.
hash_7f819470f958b456: ^9Peck: ^7You're goddamn right, I was. I need your security teams to prioritize these, these...
hash_2f634620ae7203d: ^9Peck: ^7These fucking things! I've lost three scientists this week.
hash_4eb67d375d328cd3: ^9Gorev: ^7Oh-ho-ho, slow down, William. Take breath. You sound like my son when he breaks toy.
hash_3eb2e14ea5221ac0: ^9Gorev: ^7Now tell me what has happened. But in calm, rational voice. Like adult man.
hash_7ef7c321b0d4ab52: ^9Peck: ^7Look. Infected, I can handle. Undead dogs? Sure. Crystalline men? No problem.
hash_486190d2cc9863ef: ^9Gorev: ^7I have heard of this creature. It can summon friends to its position. Loud scream. Made of fire.
hash_523fc12287c88fdb: ^9Peck: ^7Yeah, well, one got the jump on Doctor Leonov while he was taking a leak. You ever see that? It summon a dozen "friends" while you're in the john? Custodial spent two days cleaning up what was left of him.
hash_4713853dae2b9d89: ^9Gorev: ^7What are you asking for, Doctor? What can I do to make you... "happy man?"
hash_32b5320c1d9b9e59: ^9Gorev: ^7I am growing concerned, is all. His behavior since coming here has been erratic.
hash_23544d5763e3976e: ^9Gorev: ^7Nyet. I was going to draft report--
hash_ead986e2d090271: ^9Valentina: ^7--hold for now. Give me a few days. Let me investigate.
hash_1d03597280f1fe9c: ^9Gorev: ^7Saves me paper work. I have little interest in chasing ghosts.
hash_65d235e8a31ee93e: ^9Valentina: ^7Peck has always had his quirks. You know this.
hash_22fd05f062d42acb: ^9Gorev: ^7Yes, but he is more skittish than usual. He is talking to himself. He spends all day and night in that silo.
hash_7ecc2412769ae825: ^9Gorev: ^7It is hard to say. He has developed new obsession. You have seen strange computer, yes?
hash_363944844eadb9c2: ^9Valentina: ^7Exoscience disassembled one. We are struggling to make sense of it. Its mechanisms are... complex.
hash_32b2f27a7183a964: ^9Valentina: ^7I have heard of others who do this. It is like moth and flame. They are drawn to it, but do not know why.
hash_2c85c2aabf8eed37: ^8Grey: ^7So - I've been thinking a bit about the Beacon. You know - the thing we've been casually using to move between different areas of the Outbreak zone?
hash_507fe138cf462076: ^8Grey: ^7Well, we don't know what it is - or who built it. Same goes for the funny little vending machines.
hash_427d11c0d8fbd045: ^8Grey: ^7We think they're safe - certainly no one's lost anything while using them - but they are something of a peculiarity...
hash_5571afc061b8da1c: ^8Grey: ^7They appear to have been cobbled together from machine parts pulled from different time periods in our world - A bit of this from the '50s, a dash of that from the '60s, a sprinkle of something from the '80s... You get the idea.
hash_6fe23b09c3a27583: ^8Grey: ^7It just doesn't really make sense them being here. Now - I've got a theory - and it is only a theory - that someone or... something in the Dark Aether has sent them here to help us.
hash_2b7fad9dd9af7242: ^8Grey: ^7Not sure, but definitely something to look into...
hash_1294b9953b97b1ef: ^8Strauss: ^7I was reviewing Aetherium production reports this morning, and... it seems we are running out of storage space.
hash_6508e17e62e281be: ^8Strauss: ^7My, my. The worm has certainly turned for Energy Research, ever since we began operations in the Urals. I have more Aetherium now than I know what to do with, thanks mostly to my harvester units.
hash_6c953992ee85684d: ^8Strauss: ^7This embarrassment of riches has allowed us to put several new projects into development, not least of which is Requiem's very own teleporter.
hash_74466a2c82b01c9c: ^8Strauss: ^7Oh, it is not quite ready yet, but I would bet my slide-rule that it will surpass the crude portals Dr. Peck slapped together in Vietnam.
hash_546ce7395670b62b: ^8Strauss: ^7Then there is the new prototype from the weapons lab. Carver asks about it every day, like a child impatient for Christmas. *chuckles*
hash_27dfdd5afa0505da: ^8Strauss: ^7Patience, Major. You shall have your new Wonder Weapon soon enough.
hash_5c57bac664c0ae35: ^8Weaver: ^7I wanted to ask - Do you have any doubts about the decisions we've made regarding Agent Maxis.
hash_13895af5dc68ca5b: ^8Carver: ^7Doubts? As you know - in the military - doubts rarely do you any good after a decision has already been made.
hash_4c647be24e40858f: ^8Weaver: ^7But does that mean you don't have them?
hash_720c2d59c9fcbfc1: ^8Carver: ^7We all have doubts, Weaver. It's what makes us good at what we do. It's what makes us human. If we didn't have doubts we might as well just put a tactical computer program in charge of operations.
hash_55919892cf69c71: ^8Weaver: ^7I'm just worried that our decision to take away the radio she used to talk to the team could render her more... Unstable.
hash_7b78e6d1aef005b7: ^8Carver: ^7All the more reason to stick by the decision we made. Regardless of how useful she's been in the past, the last thing we need is instability within our chain of command.
hash_2363224b6cc799cb: ^8Weaver: ^7She's done so much for us. We wouldn't even be here if she hadn't risked her life to get us the Project Endstation footage.
hash_871e3b2eb918c3d: ^8Carver: ^7I know... And I know how close you are to her. The most important thing we can do now is to make sure that she gets better... To make sure that she in no way compromises our mission. Of that, I have zero doubts.
hash_e2c0038c68c092d: ^8Weaver: ^7Thank you, Major. I appreciate your perspective.
hash_21a3819131ab4d61: ^8Weaver: ^7It may seem like our work in the Ural Mountains has just gotten started, but Langley already considers Operation Threshold a massive success.
hash_2013f47c370ae7f0: ^8Weaver: ^7They said an ongoing operation in the heart of the Soviet Union was impossible. The logistics alone -- getting equipment and personnel in and out -- was enough of a challenge. But we got creative with the rockets, satellites, cargo drops... we even developed a way to refuel Raptor One mid-flight. A lot of dedicated people made this happen.
hash_7113c1fe7731d27b: ^8Weaver: ^7Then there's the risk of triggering World War Three. Fortunately, both sides have a vested interest in keeping these outbreaks from the public. So anything short of a full-scale battle with Soviet forces can remain our little secret.
hash_2b11ece9560a5d22: ^8Weaver: ^7Just be careful out there. What you've accomplished so far has enabled us to significantly catch up with Omega's Aetherium research. We haven't quite closed the gap yet, but I know you won't quit until we're ahead.
hash_5b5ccc9f7eaf230d: ^8Strauss: ^7I thought you'd like to know that our rocket retrieval crew in the North Atlantic have just recovered their one-hundredth payload of Aetherium collected in the Urals. Quite the milestone.
hash_5851db16e12ab05c: ^8Strauss: ^7Success was far from assured when Operation Threshold was still on the drawing board. Oh, I knew my Aetherium harvesters would function as designed. The hard part was bringing them back home where we could put it to good use. And we are putting it to very good use.
hash_258354fce97ca8af: ^8Strauss: ^7My Essence Conversion Modules, on the other hand, require more direct participation from you. The creatures must be lured close and, ah... liberated of their essence. It is a rather visceral process, and the subsequent conversion of essence into objects can only be done within the Outbreak Zone. A dangerous endeavor, yes, but Major Carver assures me you are "up to the task."
hash_49145268c15d157e: ^8Strauss: ^7I suppose this is my way of saying we could not have gotten this far without you. No matter what technology we may employ, you are Requiem's most valuable asset. Bravo.
hash_5631efe99cd700ab: ^8Grey: ^7Well... We certainly do live in strange times, don't we?
hash_4c80bc0c8a2f540a: ^8Grey: ^7First off, I wanted to thank you personally for your work on the Recon Rover missions. The lessons we're learning are going to prove invaluable as we move forward.
hash_7a0e46cd74f0f719: ^8Grey: ^7As you no doubt witnessed first hand, the specimens on board the Rover were physically 'transformed' after they passed into the Dark Aether.
hash_79e8f161b1590c20: ^8Grey: ^7We're trying to ascertain if this process is similar to what we saw with the creature we dubbed 'the Mimic' - but we're just not sure.
hash_24f7665817c24d7f: ^8Grey: ^7Or, were the specimens actually 'replaced' by other objects from the Dark Aether? If so - does that mean there are there now little monkeys lost in there?
hash_3ed6e6a14feb1acd: ^8Grey: ^7The Rover did managed to transmit some audio and video recordings during its mission, but I really don't even want to get in to that right now.
hash_637b358037156ac4: ^8Grey: ^7Our working theory is that Aetherium functions in the other dimension like oxygen does in our own. That would explain why the infected can't move beyond the Outbreak Zone - If they did, they just wouldn't be able to survive... Like a fish out of water.
hash_5958cb80c30d1233: ^8Grey: ^7Last thing - Do let us know if you start experience any strange symptoms or feel that you yourselves are... er... 'changing' in any way?
hash_1077e04c6afb1bf2: ^8Grey: ^7I honestly wouldn't want you to go through anything like whatever the poor Monkeys did...
hash_ef672be9076543b: ^8Carver: ^7Carver here. If there's one thing I've learned from Operation Threshold, it's that you know how to take down the biggest and baddest the Dark Aether has to offer. And hunting those HVTs has yielded good information for the lab-coats and number-crunchers. But my mind's been on the big open question hanging over it all.
hash_41ef0650dca5f912: ^8Carver: ^7If these S.O.B.s do have a pecking order, and there's any rhyme or reason to their attacks, then that suggests some sort of command structure.
hash_44eada6125bf7b21: ^8Carver: ^7I mean, we see the HVTs call in reinforcements. We see them work together, like undead platoons. So who's calling the shots over there? Who or what is their commander-in-chief?
hash_7310b77cc382da68: ^8Carver: ^7I want you to help me find out, strike team. My fellow experts over here don't want to hear it when I tell them these things operate like an army. What I haven't told them about yet is the document I saw on the Director's desk.
hash_25c82917b2663f97: ^8Carver: ^7The folks above my pay grade know there's gotta be a hierarchy. They're just not ready to call it out yet. So find me something they can't ignore -- some intel, some evidence. Help me figure out who's in charge on the other side. And then we'll paint a big, fat target on them.
hash_71cca4ece2ddc0cb: ^<Zykov: ^7My friend, though we have never met, you and I have been through the fire together. You won my respect -- and my trust. So it is only right I tell you who I am.
hash_201b99476adaf7ea: ^<Zykov: ^7My name is Kazimir Zykov. I am -- I was -- a sergeant in the Soviet 1st Guards Tank Army. Long, long ago.
hash_29f7a2da217bcf81: ^<Zykov: ^7We were in Poland, driving the Nazi scum back to Berlin. That is how I ended up where this all began.
hash_28f55cb759b00390: ^<Zykov: ^7We found Projekt Endstation almost by accident. And you know what waited in that place.
hash_622d1acc066ccfef: ^<Zykov: ^7When Moscow sent a Chekist to bury the problem, it fell to me to do the digging.
hash_62cebb1fea59b48e: ^<Zykov: ^7I will tell the whole story one day. What matters now is that -- just like you -- I accepted a mission no one must ever learn of, knowing it would probably get me killed.
hash_735e2c80140af905: ^<Zykov: ^7And, like me, you shoulder your duty without complaining. So let us help each other complete the mission. We can survive this... together.
hash_3b79c11191978fac: ^<Zykov: ^7Back in the Great Patriotic War, mine was among the Red Army units that crippled the Nazi war machine on the Eastern Front. Then we chased the bastards out of the Motherland and across Europe.
hash_56421b7eb54ac35d: ^<Zykov: ^7I was a mechanic. I kept our tanks running. No easy task when every day we advanced, and getting new parts from Moscow was almost impossible.
hash_44b2c3a7e06ce2a6: ^<Zykov: ^7So I took parts from the Tigers and Panzers we destroyed, adapting them for our T-34s. I got very familiar with German machinery. This would prove to be my downfall.
hash_3fd14353f8e367a7: ^<Zykov: ^7A colonel named Lazarev from what you now call "KGB" was sent to contain the evil we uncovered at Endstation. He ordered me to go in there alone, because I had the best chance of understanding and shutting down that infernal machine. And then Lazarev ordered me sealed inside.
hash_36427cedff225908: ^<Zykov: ^7I understood what was asked of me. I would never see my wife and daughter again. Still, I saluted and I did my best. This was for my family, my country... for a better future. Even now, if asked again, I would still say, "yes."
hash_5d358a5524931eb5: ^<Zykov: ^7So. You are wondering how a tank mechanic from the war survived for decades trapped in -- what do you call it? -- the Dark Aether.
hash_acf2dc0e44d7364: ^<Zykov: ^7I often ask myself the same thing. The answers are many. Some I have already given you in my journal. The fort I built. The weapons I found. The machines I restored. And, of course, my dog Cinder.
hash_4657b22a67cef11f: ^<Zykov: ^7But mostly I was lucky. The rest is because I am Russian. It is in our nature to endure.
hash_6fe08c0c88e939be: ^<Zykov: ^7But I never lost my desire to escape. To come home. To learn what became of my family.
hash_5ebdde88179c7f71: ^<Zykov: ^7As you saw in my journal, I have been able to visit for brief periods, almost like a ghost. But always I am pulled back here.
hash_3773f41aa3c8c080: ^<Zykov: ^7I do not know why I am tethered to this place. I see your people cross back and forth freely... and I burn with envy. There must be a way for me to one day do the same.
hash_4326d834bb0b4fb: ^<Zykov: ^7For now, I will share more of my journal with you. There are things in it you should know. For both our sakes.
hash_5413437b9d7cc37c: ^9Kravchenko: ^7Ah... Doctor Jager. Come. Sit. What news of our little "pet project"?
hash_36548707ce1da7a9: ^9Kravchenko: ^7Once you have confirmed Requiem's arrival, I will make my move.
hash_7bc94076c70ea8f9: ^9Jager: ^7There is one other thing. Something Dr. Zarkova said. She has built a machine. She would not go into specifics. Something she hid from us.
hash_64460caf8d9fdb0: ^9Jager: ^7She says it will change the war.
hash_793eb8e04dcbc1ed: ^9Kravchenko: ^7Find out what this machine is. Be sure you bring it back, whatever state it may be in.
hash_4d28c921231a20a7: ^9Jager: ^7I have done as you have asked. Doctor Zarkova has welcomed me into her little circle of defectors with open arms. She does not suspect I am acting under your orders.
hash_34920e29d8154be4: ^9Jager: ^7In this process, I learned that my Records Manager, Cherneski, is one of the traitors. Shame, his organizational prowess was unmatched. He will be missed.
hash_368b2aced3c8a363: ^9Kravchenko: ^7Well done, comrade. You have confirmed their plan?
hash_66a82263156a0ce2: ^9Jager: ^7Ja, Colonel. Zarkova has made contact with Ravenov. He has made arrangements with Requiem for their extraction.
hash_339e8f4d8b53dc13: ^9Jager: ^7In an effort to secure their trust, I arranged their transport.
hash_1c9c8205aab32630: ^9Jager: ^7I'm sure the KGB will not mind if I "borrowed" a Hind.
hash_a2ed6a65b509c5f: ^9Kravchenko: ^7Pah. Cost of doing business. I trust you are ready for the rest of the task?
hash_30cba2c6897b9fae: ^9Jager: ^7My paralytic cocktail is powerful enough to incapacitate an elephant. Though, unfortunately for them, they will still be able to feel pain when I begin my... work.
hash_5770a311b1833df5: ^9Kravchenko: ^7Spare me the details. Just remember: use them to make a statement. This is what happens when you betray us.
hash_73cd1d03911f79d9: ^9Gorev: ^7--and as you requested, the Requiem strike team -- and their pilot -- have been transferred to Potsdam.
hash_a53c6b5b572912: ^9Kravchenko: ^7This department will not survive another scandal. Using Requiem's team keeps it off the books, and keeps the noose from our necks.
hash_393bd5888136d37b: ^9Kravchenko: ^7Smile, Gorev. We may yet live through this.
hash_2cdafcf70764034: ^9Kravchenko: ^7Oversee their transport personally, Gorev. No mistakes. No escapes. No "accidents." I need them alive.
hash_3fe40f09ea1ec3a5: ^9Gorev: ^7Would their... termination not send a stronger message to the West? We apprehended them operating on our soil. We should make a statement -- a demonstration of strength that inspires our brothers.
hash_6eb275a5a30a3ff0: ^9Kravchenko: ^7Yes, comrade. We should send a message. And we will. In time.
hash_292aefe33bd08db7: ^9Kravchenko: ^7But first, I have work for them. In Berlin.
hash_6d99cad686eaa3be: ^9Kravchenko: ^7A certain member of our organization has gone to ground recently. I am sure you've noticed their absence.
hash_12aa08dd9570143d: ^9Kravchenko: ^7I believe they are scheming against us -- and will take action in Berlin. We must use Requiem's team to stop them -- and keep the Kremlin in the dark.
hash_69de0fbd5a3adefe: ^9Kravchenko: ^7That is enough, Gorev. We still need him able to speak. Remove the gag.
hash_101f67c75276cd0: ^8Raptor One: ^7Call sign... Raptor One... Captain... United... United States Air Force... Service Number FR-16...9-8...6-3-4-2. "Peace Is Our Profession."
hash_3d2b63542bf41b7d: ^8Raptor One: ^7But you can go fuck yourself.
hash_4017c3d9e939187: ^9Gorev: ^7How are you feeling, pilot man? Eh? Ready to tell us name?
hash_47f469448a984caf: ^8Raptor One: ^7Call sign Raptor One. Captain. United States Air Force. Service Number FR-16-9-8-6-3-4-2. "Peace Is Our Profession."
hash_129886c92d77c6e5: ^9Gorev: ^7Ah. Still you persist with brainwashed American loyalty nonsense. Colonel?
hash_7e73e29ca48598b: ^9Gorev: ^7Feeling more sociable? Or do we need more icebreaker?
hash_49e135681a420923: ^8Raptor One: ^7Call sign Raptor One. Captain. United States Air Force. Service Number...
hash_46a05683d7f7b42: ^9Gorev: ^7We have plenty of time, Pilot Cowboy. This is not western spaghetti. You are not man with no name.
hash_76e1c8587ef7c6a1: ^8Carver: ^7I know. I can see it in your eyes.
hash_40ed60b5e9ae9fbb: ^8Carver: ^7Sorry. I just mean... I know this is personal, but that doesn't mean you have to take it that way. I spent the best part of ten years feeling the way you do right now -- downing the liquor, trying to numb the guilt of my own failures.
hash_1476e2a8a3b3f795: ^8Weaver: ^7I know... I can see it in your eyes.
hash_d477eb1a08c931d: ^8Carver: ^7Yeah. You should. That guilt isn't going anywhere. But you ain't gonna deal with it any better with the Scotch. You're still gonna have to look yourself in the EYE every morning.
hash_57bf170f0b9e8b17: ^8Carver: ^7Anyway, I was on my way out for the night. I just wanted to tell you... I know how you feel. Honestly.
hash_1a25f350e27545d: ^8Weaver: ^7You could say that... What can I do for you, Major?
hash_7415a7c618582133: ^8Weaver: ^7Yes, Yes... Mac. What can I do for you?
hash_506a7183c9fb7ba5: ^8Carver: ^7I was hoping I could do something for you. You're clearly under a lot of stress at the moment... I take it you've been getting it both barrels from the Director?
hash_35cb9d9403bdf6b8: ^8Carver: ^7Look -- I don't want to speak out of turn. Feel free to put me in my place if needs be, but I know how you must feel... losing the team and all.
hash_5bc465c88aa53b26: ^8Weaver: ^7No. You don't know how I feel. You can't. This bastard -- Kravchenko. We go way back.
hash_6d8976d52fc923d7: ^8Strauss: ^7Doctor Grey! To what do I owe the pleasure?
hash_2dc19d4b5e17bb94: ^8Strauss: ^7After how Ms. Maxis led you astray?
hash_6937bd08fd9dc90a: ^8Grey: ^7Fuck me, Strauss... Do you have to be such a prick?
hash_614a4709ba6f476: ^8Strauss: ^7Well, I try not to be -- but I am very busy!
hash_169ff25e24c78120: ^8Grey: ^7I honestly don't know how Weaver hasn't punched you in the face already...
hash_d041bfb29b7c3c0: ^8Strauss: ^7So. That's two things I can't help you with. Dare I enquire as to the third topic you wanted to discuss?
hash_13a01b1c5aa02f3e: ^8Grey: ^7I wanted to... see where you were at with your research regarding the Aetherium Neutralizer...?
hash_7a35faf6871f7812: ^8Strauss: ^7Well... it's really quite fascinating. The potential for travel in and out of the Dark Aether -- safely -- could yield many benefits...
hash_32367caa83dfc4: ^8Grey: ^7No shit, Sherlock. But what about the downsides?
hash_6b6e384f57dc381d: ^8Strauss: ^7Yes. We are. I can't help but wonder if those within the other dimension have harnessed similar powers. Could they perhaps be... on their way here?
hash_424091dfcbf9acd3: ^8Grey: ^7You really are a barrel of laughs, aren't you? I'm going to bed. It's been a long enough day as it is...
hash_4e7100b6e24136f5: ^8Strauss: ^7Forgive my levity... and perhaps my... brevity? How can I help?
hash_fb382c8f63110fb: ^8Grey: ^7I just wanted to talk to you about a couple of things. Well... three actually.
hash_7e619238a1adf73: ^8Strauss: ^7Hit me. Not literally, of course. I just mean... What do you want to know?
hash_6733f0e13e44a8cf: ^8Grey: ^7I'm not presuming anything. I just wondered if you had more information on their current status.
hash_5c8ebd542dda9faf: ^8Strauss: ^7Shouldn't that be a question for Weaver?
hash_284f2f24b8b2da91: ^8Grey: ^7Yes. Yes. I'm just... trying to... not piss him off any more.
hash_354032902f0be7cf: ^8Carver: ^7I don't like being out of the loop, Weaver.
hash_e38caa207d11b69: ^8Weaver: ^7Neither do I! This is all coming down from on high. You, Strauss, Grey, even me for fuck's sake -- none of us are on the "need to know" list.
