hash_13c304f41c9fdd35: ^8Carver: ^7Jesus... I had no idea things were that bad.
hash_912a0490ae2eec3: ^8Weaver: ^7They are that bad, and all of us need to hope that they don't get any worse. Strauss and Grey's research has already been seized for reasons... unspecified.
hash_222c97e63d4673d3: ^8Carver: ^7Fuck. Are we falling apart here, Weaver? Have we been mothballed?
hash_6a0ce683a96aaded: ^8Weaver: ^7I wish I knew the answer to that, Major.
hash_4a5a7bcd48ade990: ^8Carver: ^7Major Carver. Unless we've completely abandoned the chain of command.
hash_46d863fce796b95e: ^8Weaver: ^7From your tone, I'm guessing you heard about the outbreak situation in Berlin?
hash_56ca7541816fbc26: ^8Carver: ^7Damn right I heard about it. I still have friends. Some of them in high places. Higher even than you. Why the Hell haven't we sent a team to engage?
hash_8101cc015cbafa8: ^8Weaver: ^7You answered your own question -- Orders from above. Not only has the Director made it explicitly clear that we are not to engage, but he's also taking a LOT of our other options off the table.
hash_30fa16724fee5b6c: ^8Carver: ^7I think I'm going to need a little context on that statement.
hash_f8b3fed51a58d9a: ^8Weaver: ^7The Director is handling the situation in Berlin personally.
hash_11d76528dc951fe2: ^8Carver: ^7What? Like he's gone there himself? As in boots on ground?
hash_35808055af2d67b4: ^8Weaver: ^7Dammit, Carver. You of all people should know there are ways to make things happen without actually holding a gun to someone's head.
hash_18061fd506155bf2: ^8Weaver: ^7I don't know who else is listening to this -- and I don't care -- but this message is for you, Kravchenko.
hash_2ddecc08586bb84b: ^8Weaver: ^7You made an enemy of me a long time ago, but I wanted you to know for sure -- there's no way on God's green earth I'm going to let you walk away from this.
hash_38fc92294243de40: ^8Weaver: ^7If any harm comes to anyone on my team, you're going to regret it in ways you can't even imagine.
hash_fd4c346189abaf1: ^8Weaver: ^7You know the saying -- an eye for an eye? Well, this is going to be worse. Far worse.
hash_1e8321bd853d91b6: ^8Weaver: ^7Think about it. A good, long think about what I might decide to cut from you...
hash_785c483059bf505b: ^<Ravenov: ^7How did you get in contact with me?
hash_4a512d1215abf95f: ^8Weaver: ^7Ironically, Maxis helped me with that -- even though she doesn't know it yet.
hash_4d6f3dd5683e9581: ^8Weaver: ^7I want a lot of things, most of which I'll never get. I'm sure you can relate -- especially now that you're a marked man... an enemy of the state.... several actually. You helped my team walk in to a trap.
hash_d800ad4e9e48d77: ^<Ravenov: ^7I betrayed no one. Like Maxis, I was trying to do the right thing. I had no idea events would play out like they did.
hash_456de904060fe91b: ^8Weaver: ^7See? That's your problem. You're not as smart as you think you are. Too much fire in your belly, too much ice in your heart -- but not enough smarts. Not where it counts.
hash_213664c213590ca1: ^<Ravenov: ^7Are you any different? Hm? At least I'm here -- in the field -- putting my ass -- and HEART -- on the line.
hash_5e3ff16eae8517bd: ^8Weaver: ^7Well... maybe you can redeem yourself, Ravenov. Maybe.
hash_309431862c92860c: ^8Weaver: ^7But just so you know -- I am rapidly running out of fucks to give.
hash_1c4f0fcc3405432e: ^<Jager: ^7Hallo? Scheisse! Ravenov, it is Doctor Hugo Jager. I hope either you or Requiem find this recording. Most of us survived the crash. We are heading to Monument Island, where I hope we will be safe from Omega.
hash_13291f1e1a57fb0f: ^<Jager: ^7Before you ask: ja, that is on the other side of The Phase, but the scientists I am with? They have created something incredible. A device that will allow us travel through the Phase without dying... or worse!
hash_781efbc04a3abb4c: ^<Jager: ^7They only have one prototype, but they are assembling another from spare parts so you can follow us. Unfortunately, we are missing a component: an Aethereal Orb.
hash_1abe6f9ebee366a5: ^<Jager: ^7Find one and bring it to the bridge. There will be a *slightly* modified Recon Rover waiting for you.
hash_2ff1c3202f48d86a: ^<Jager: ^7Please hurry. Omega shot us down. They will not leave the job unfinished.
hash_61f8b8d9f67c60ef: ^<Jager: ^7Ravenov! Requiem! Jager here. If you are hearing this, you must have found the Rover and completed the device. They call it an Aetherium Neutralizer.
hash_6c200bee47d6128e: ^<Jager: ^7It does what it says on the tin -- it neutralizes Aetherium particles in the air, pacifying a radius around the device by boosting power from the orb's primordial energy. Allowing safe passage through the Phase is just one of many potential applications for this device.
hash_140a6bc5bab2e105: ^<Jager: ^7This improvised device should hold a charge long enough to traverse the Phase. Once you are through, make your way to the Monument. We will be on the roof.
hash_4c428d25f0a2902c: ^<Jager: ^7We eagerly await your arrival. Too long have we been silent about Omega's atrocities. There is much for us to discuss. Soon we will change the world.
hash_1b81629b9e9bb387: ^<Jager: ^7Hello Requiem. So glad you could make it. Enjoying my handiwork? Do not worry, they did not go quietly. Dr. Zarkova? She put up quite the struggle. It was almost honorable.
hash_26aba3720e1fc566: ^<Jager: ^7But there is no honor in betraying Omega. It is a despicable act of cowardice. When Kravchenko learned of their plot to defect, I could not volunteer fast enough. Once I infiltrated their group, the Colonel gave me two tasks.
hash_2687e9bb448756fd: ^<Jager: ^7One: kill the traitors. Easy enough. Nothing a hacksaw and a gas can could not solve.
hash_576d7d27070fa4c4: ^<Jager: ^7But the second? To lure Requiem's so-called "elite" strike team into a trap. That added a complication, but fortunately, crashing helicopters is easy once you've poisoned the pilot.
hash_2eecf5ef99afcff3: ^<Jager: ^7As for the Aetherium Neutralizer -- rest assured, it will be well taken care of in Omega's hands.
hash_377a269a041aec42: ^<Jager: ^7Soon we will change the world, Requiem.
hash_443248504de132b1: ^<Unknown: ^7You have done well. You have made me so... proud.
hash_5ccdc7157682ac42: ^<Vogel: ^7And now, at last, our time has come. A lifetime of preparation is about to be rewarded.
hash_55a257b1c6b40a41: ^<Vogel: ^7Soon you will reveal yourself -- a threat so close they never saw it coming.
hash_79181244295a8388: ^<Vogel: ^7How long have we awaited this day? How many times have you proven yourself to them, made them value and respect you -- the better to plunge your blade in their backs?
hash_3ace70a9f9b122df: ^<Vogel: ^7Gather your things. Bid farewell to this false life you lead. Go to Berlin. Everything is in place.
hash_1cba0c4e48eaea64: ^<Unknown: ^7We are waiting. We are ready. Initiate the process and your labor of love will at last be complete.
hash_1942e4c4a8f448a1: ^<Zykov: ^7Hello, my friend! I have been wanting to speak with you again. We have so much to do, and we are running out of time.
hash_7e8949d7b7d7be4a: ^<Zykov: ^7Soon, my friend. Just keep checking in with me. I am counting on your help.
hash_48f095d07fa4f669: ^9Peck: ^7Uh, yeah. About that. My colleagues are starting to ask questions. I think they might know about you. They've definitely seen me on this computer and they're wondering what I'm up to.
hash_3bf07c1614f0476b: ^<Zykov: ^7I see. This may take some finesse, Dr. Peck, but you must somehow reassure them you are not "up to" anything they would not approve of.
hash_16430d40d004706f: ^9Peck: ^7Easier said than done. Gorev and Valentina watch me like hawks, just waiting for me to screw up.
hash_118c98e7eaedd525: ^<Zykov: ^7They cannot understand your genius, Peck. They also do not know your inner pain. Not like I do.
hash_4ebdef764c65298d: ^9Peck: ^7Look, if you help me round up more of those "tempest" guys, I could make new inversion warheads -- get back in the Colonel's good graces.
hash_5b8733dd4fac0f: ^<Zykov: ^7Nyet, my friend. That seemed like a good plan when we first conceived it, but now? I would not set you up to fail yet again. Besides, I have a better idea.
hash_1b61ec70e4dbd09: ^<Zykov: ^7I am beginning construction of a new device. I will spare you the details until I know it can work, but it is exactly the sort of weapon your colonel is looking for.
hash_5164ec501e528c71: ^9Peck: ^7Okay. When will you know if this new gizmo is viable?
hash_31c088ffc55ab011: ^9Peck: ^7Hello, Zykov? You there? It's me. Peck.
hash_1897be10afbe7f09: ^<Zykov: ^7Hmph. They can keep their medals. Just help me come home.
hash_68468b99bfc34e71: ^9Peck: ^7Okay. Let me know when your device is ready. We'll work on how best to repatriate you. Over and out.
hash_ff41de1d7e41e29: ^<Zykov: ^7Yes, my friend. I am here. Where else would I go?
hash_80c6e6c14514d7: ^9Peck: ^7So. My coworkers definitely know I'm in contact with you. They even know your name.
hash_38fbc91c3da60455: ^9Peck: ^7No, they see you as a potential goldmine of Dark Aether intel, and they don't want to punish the one guy you'll talk to.
hash_5ba084b6e02022a8: ^9Peck: ^7In fact, Gorev told me to ask about the entity you say is in charge over there. It's real, right?
hash_44d0d3c1668f4296: ^<Zykov: ^7It is an existential threat to all of you, my friend. It is the reason I am building my new device.
hash_59b55d7d8cc1f950: ^<Zykov: ^7It is something we will need when the real invasion comes. But tell your people I will reveal more details only if you help me come home.
hash_4dc8ac5346288dcc: ^9Peck: ^7You got it. They might want to debrief you for days, but if you deliver on intelligence and firepower, they'll make you a hero of the Soviet Union.
hash_87b30e4b48b462f: ^8Grey: ^7If... If I give you access to my comms protocols... it could be the biggest mistake I've ever made.
hash_794c03a879b58138: ^8Maxis: ^7Do you know what it's like to be cut off from the outside world? To have no way to see - or even communicate - with the people you care about?
hash_455db76c1d64847d: ^8Grey: ^7I'm a long way from home, Sam. This was a big move for me - Coming here... doing... all of this.
hash_168b37830a8fc5f4: ^8Grey: ^7If I give you my console key - I could find myself back in Bristol before you can say Jack Robinson.
hash_30fbc2cc6c79615b: ^8Grey: ^7Sorry - old saying. Not sure how old. My mum - Liz - used to say it. It means things happened very quickly. It means...
hash_1655611e15e53a: ^8Grey: ^7I don't want to get in trouble with Weaver.
hash_5a9e235cb4afd3eb: ^8Maxis: ^7Things don't always happen quickly. Sometimes they take a long time. Sometimes too long.
hash_4dcc8657b1e60d17: ^8Grey: ^7Well... Getting sent back home is probably the most optimistic outcome. I could find myself facing charges... and in prison.
hash_21a4830d249a3aa0: ^8Maxis: ^7But you will... do it - right Lizzy?
hash_6c1ae94f24d5f537: ^8Grey: ^7I'm... not sure, Sam. I'm really not.
hash_20b6cdce750d3196: ^8Grey: ^7Look... I could get myself in so much trouble.
hash_164a9b85d9c035ba: ^8Maxis: ^7Did you do what I asked, Elizabeth?
hash_573a1ca31bc24fb1: ^8Grey: ^7I'm not sure if I can... Honestly.
hash_4b364d12b9a02594: ^8Maxis: ^7You know we're on the brink of War, Elizabeth.
hash_4bbbed5917f702b4: ^8Grey: ^7I know, I know. But being here at Requiem... it's a big opportunity for me. I don't want to throw away my career - my life.
hash_5f66b36d2b62202: ^8Weaver: ^7NO SAM. The right thing to do, would have been to come to me. To let me do MY job!
hash_404958d80afaa6d1: ^8Maxis: ^7Is it your job to keep me muzzled like a dog?!
hash_3825fe54b769c51e: ^8Maxis: ^7I'm sorry... I didn't mean to do that.
hash_7b869d7876aaa8c1: ^8Weaver: ^7This, is why we have a problem Sam.
hash_2cc872d10677d54c: ^8Maxis: ^7I was trying to do the right thing.
hash_6faf950b56f3279f: ^8Weaver: ^7I told you what the right thing to do was - Look after the dog. That's it. You're confined to quarters - No more walks. Someone else will take care of that.
hash_57949a6130fddd05: ^8Weaver: ^7Now... I have to try to straighten all this out with the Director.
hash_16d7b1e770db7b00: ^8Weaver: ^7Who. The. Hell. Do you think you are?
hash_7c5e417bb3d52e76: ^8Weaver: ^7I thought I did. But I NEVER thought you would do something like this.
hash_20877be661412d75: ^8Weaver: ^7How dare you contact the team to drag them into whatever scheme you and Ravenov thought was important.
hash_158983794241b843: ^8Weaver: ^7And involving poor Doctor Grey in your misguided bullshit??
hash_9fee53639efe470: ^8Maxis: ^7It was the right thing to do. It was the only way.
hash_7387c3e4d6c3125c: ^8Maxis: ^7Hey - Take your hands off me! Weaver, call them off!
hash_47893a283065a0c0: ^8Weaver: ^7Don't make this any harder than it already is.
hash_3c6b7407468d7acb: ^8Weaver: ^7It's okay girl. I'll look after you.
hash_273451f4a051ea2d: ^8Weaver: ^7I can't, Sam. My hands are tied.
hash_39d0a9c3dacce4fe: ^9Kravchenko: ^7November 30. 1984. It has been just over two weeks since the...
hash_486c01a8fcd86df7: ^9Kravchenko: ^7...unfortunate disaster involving Omega's Reality Inversion Warheads. It appears chaos follows Doctor Peck wherever he goes.
hash_3ae95492f6ec8130: ^9Kravchenko: ^7I have been told Peck's removal is not viable. He is our premier expert on Aetherium, and there is no time to find and educate a suitable replacement. Another unfortunate disaster.
hash_61c33bee79cd6481: ^9Kravchenko: ^7Peck hoped the missiles could be recovered... But, as I suspected, our salvage efforts have proven futile. What remains of the warheads belongs to the ocean now. We must begin again.
hash_40acb45e18fc48d2: ^9Kravchenko: ^7We cannot afford another setback at the hands of Requiem. I had hoped to deal with them after Operatsiya Inversiya, but I can see now they require my immediate, and undivided, attention.
hash_1b912b4f3d2f763b: ^9Kravchenko: ^7If there is any consolation, it seems Requiem remains in the dark about our agenda. They believe the Inversion Warheads were to destroy the West.
hash_2762b93efbc18f74: ^9Kravchenko: ^7Little do they realize a greater threat looms in the Dark Aether. The entity must be contained.
hash_6420293043b1180c: ^9Valentina: ^7My father visited me once again. Our day of victory approaches. His triumphant return. His righteous revenge. The world is not prepared for what we shall unleash. He could not tell me when, only that it would be... soon.
hash_338561c0092bf27b: ^9Valentina: ^7After so many years, decades, it is hard not to feel excitement. Ever since I was a little girl, I have dreamt of this moment.
hash_7bd4f4c412acae8a: ^9Valentina: ^7I will never forget when his ghost first appeared to me. I was five. Maybe six. At first I was terrified, but how else is a child to react? But when he called me by my real name, I knew it was him. He has guided me ever since.
hash_754a6fbef7774839: ^9Valentina: ^7If all goes according to plan, not only will I have completed his mission... but he will be free. No longer trapped in that dark, evil, place.
hash_4316659afa593eb8: ^9Valentina: ^7I can save him. I have to.
hash_64f9099b0984c367: ^9Valentina: ^7The time is soon. Our day of victory approaches. East, West, Requiem, Omega, even Kravchenko -- they have no idea what is coming for them.
hash_68521dd9152d2435: ^9Gorev: ^7--there is nothing yet, Colonel. Even if he is still in Russia, which I doubt, he has gone to ground. A ghost.
hash_114cd2b941236bc6: ^9Kravchenko: ^7As it is, I already have someone for that job. You must continue your work with Peck. Those warheads were our best chance of containing "the entity."
hash_324584385b91eccf: ^9Gorev: ^7The "Entity"... so far, I have had no luck in finding such a thing.
hash_2530d4b431387aa0: ^9Gorev: ^7We have interviewed over a hundred Aethernauts, and while there is no shortage of strange encounters with outlandish creatures in the Dark Aether, none can recall anything that matches your description of this entity.
hash_473c8816a7034ad: ^9Gorev: ^7Perhaps your source in Requiem is acting on incomplete information--
hash_4e68ec5ee3c182da: ^9Kravchenko: ^7--my source is not to be questioned nor challenged. The threat is real. This is not a discussion: Find it. Before it finds us.
hash_56dd13932d7c257: ^9Gorev: ^7Distributed. There is nowhere in the Eastern Bloc he can run to. Any of his remaining allies have been made aware of his transgressions.
hash_57848016d76f65ce: ^9Kravchenko: ^7"Transgressions"? You make it sound like he kicked your dog.
hash_17d2230df4aba255: ^9Kravchenko: ^7The fucking traitor. How did this slip by you?
hash_2d348ecfebe5d56c: ^9Gorev: ^7I am searching for answers myself. I had known the Kapitan for many years. His record would suggest he was incapable of such betrayal. He was the perfect soldier. A true soviet.
hash_120a61f5597d99cb: ^9Kravchenko: ^7A fucking coward. This is the last thing we need. The Kremlin is asking questions, Gorev. I am not accustomed to having to explain myself. I am not accustomed to being spied on.
hash_2ffc9166e2080ee2: ^9Kravchenko: ^7Chebrikov's rats are everywhere, waiting to scurry back and report our latest failure. Outpost 25. Ruka. Omega is gaining a reputation. And now there are rumors of dissent within our own ranks. One more "incident" and we are finished.
hash_1c09400f9222ebad: ^9Gorev: ^7No, If you are worried of mutiny, it will be snuffed out, Colonel. You have my word.
hash_7730b96616d15b18: ^9Kravchenko: ^7Like I did with finding the mole?
hash_448b060e05cb6548: ^9Kravchenko: ^7There is the question, Gorev, of what is to be done with Peck. This is twice now his projects ended in failure. Omega's reputation will not survive a third.
hash_5176186ef122bad: ^9Kravchenko: ^7Why am I only hearing of this now? How long has this been going on?
hash_53abccc22fb6093: ^9Gorev: ^7Valentina assured me she wrote a report on the matter and delivered it to you personally.
hash_727bcdccc247b23a: ^9Kravchenko: ^7Tell Peck to keep talking to his friend. Have him ask about the entity.
hash_258c3b7edc4fe85d: ^9Gorev: ^7You know my feelings on this matter. I would love nothing more than for our one-eyed cowboy to be strung up in the gulag.
hash_65fff3a1aa9ee982: ^9Gorev: ^7However, I cannot say the failure at Ruka lies with him. Whether he knows it or not, Peck has been under 24-hour surveillance. I can safely say he was not the one to leak the documents to Ravenov and Requiem.
hash_313d4bc12358624c: ^9Kravchenko: ^7Do I look like a fucking plumber to you, Gorev?
hash_296e80eeba5ed2f1: ^9Gorev: ^7Peck has not outlived his usefulness. He is still our most knowledgeable scientist on Aetherium. In that regard, he has no equal.
hash_6ce8f58a2a223e26: ^9Gorev: ^7More importantly, I believe he could help find this entity of yours.
hash_3f5f48120b076d8: ^9Gorev: ^7As you know, Peck has been talking to that Computer. Apparently he has built something of a rapport with its creator. Perhaps he is familiar with your creature.
hash_7233545ebd772fa5: ^8Weaver: ^7Well, people, we've got a bit of a clusterfuck on our hands, don't we?
hash_4fe097d1c8cbeb8b: ^8Carver: ^7Our own strike team running an off-the-books operation cooked up by a Soviet officer and someone on house arrest? Yeah, the Director's gonna love that.
hash_53a5401fefe85404: ^8Strauss: ^7A-hem. Agent Maxis is not under arrest, per se. "Under observation," perhaps. Though no one observed her straying outside the chain of command...
hash_6323fcde055a1dfa: ^8Grey: ^7Look, maybe it wasn't sanctioned, but was it really wrong of her to dump those warheads in the sea? She might have saved the East Coast from becoming one big outbreak zone.
hash_6caa57711b255061: ^8Weaver: ^7It wasn't her call, Grey. She should have come to me first. However good her intentions -- nobody hijacks my troops.
hash_df1c7b577c18ee7: ^8Carver: ^7Besides, I have serious doubts that those warheads were really meant for use against us.
hash_9578bfc365fb530: ^8Strauss: ^7Carver, this isn't more of your "Dark Aether Overlord" talk, is it?
hash_189431700f8d18ad: ^8Carver: ^7Do I walk into your lab and slap the test tube out of your hand, Strauss? No. Show me the same respect. I think Omega recognizes the real danger here, and so should we.
hash_5822412262c69db1: ^8Grey: ^7So, if those missiles were meant to stop something worse than what we've already seen... and we just eliminated them... did we just leave the world more vulnerable?
hash_7872e8b1d4ee0b6c: ^8Weaver: ^7Meeting's over, people. I don't know how this will all shake out, but it wasn't our best day by a long shot.
hash_50b03a46422cb49e: ^8Grey: ^7Weaver, I don't know what to say...
hash_6ce0a62459e451: ^8Weaver: ^7You keep your notes on our central database, yes? That would explain the new orders.
hash_7da044c7f2d51020: ^8Weaver: ^7The Director wants to run more specialized tests on Maxis. If you're asked to cooperate, you do as instructed. Are we clear?
hash_89e3d3511d48552: ^8Weaver: ^7And, Grey? Remember, if it's on the mainframe, everyone above my pay grade can access it. If there's something you want to tell me, you tell me in person.
hash_122bb642f0939379: ^8Grey: ^7I promise, Weaver, I won't keep anything else from you.
hash_2df7362c47e768a4: ^8Weaver: ^7I'm glad we understand each other. Dismissed.
hash_6ac8896cd80a1dab: ^8Weaver: ^7There's nothing to say. Your lack of military experience is no excuse for what you did. You knew better and you did it anyway.
hash_14b3eae539c596a4: ^8Grey: ^7I just wanted to let her talk to the team. I didn't know what she--
hash_1edc1e3f75aae2d1: ^8Weaver: ^7One thing you are not is stupid. But I also don't think you're a traitor. Which is I why I'm taking the heat on this one.
hash_2a237cb6df68dd96: ^8Weaver: ^7No one upstairs is aware of your role in Sam's little side operation, and that's how it'll stay. As long as you never fucking cross me again. Understood?
hash_309af3dc41e491f9: ^8Grey: ^7Agent Maxis is still showing high levels of Aetherium contamination in her bloodstream. But the way it's affecting her is different than any other subject I've observed.
hash_1c390f3c90f98a07: ^8Grey: ^7It's not just her eyes. There are things happening on a cellular level I can't quantify yet.
hash_2866aed6864ca319: ^8Weaver: ^7Welcome back to the Ural Mountains. It's been a few weeks, but now that you've been cleared to return to active duty I expect you to be on your best behavior.
hash_53940de205ceafe8: ^8Weaver: ^7You got off lightly. After what you did in Ruka last month, you should be facing a court martial. You can thank the Director for intervening and sparing you that fate.
hash_4fabe075af1b46b3: ^8Weaver: ^7The incident has been expunged from your record. It never happened.
hash_9f15b8c91113dda: ^8Weaver: ^7As far as the CIA is concerned, the missile launch was a mechanical failure. You were never there.
hash_5d3897e4a4ea79dd: ^8Weaver: ^7And in case I haven't already made myself clear: you acted without oversight. You participated in an operation without the approval of anyone at Requiem. That cannot happen -- ever again.
hash_5c820acfab02052c: ^8Weaver: ^7You do not answer to Maxis. You answer to me. If she contacts you through a back channel, you report that to me. She is not one of us. She is not Requiem.
hash_1d68c669674d4917: ^8Weaver: ^7Now. That being said. Your actions had a ripple effect through Omega. Ravenov contacted me -- he's in touch with scientists who want to defect. We're working on a plan to extract them.
hash_106e5d751039739e: ^8Weaver: ^7You are making an impact in this fight. You just have to do it the right way.
hash_6ed134b7ef0e7b14: ^8Grey: ^7Well look at you: Requiem's Strike Team, back in action! I imagine that must feel nice.
hash_73fa54b784a16597: ^8Grey: ^7Now. I wasn't looking directly at it. I had just finished an eighteen hour day. I was exhausted. I mean, I probably just imagined it... right?
hash_6ec18a23b27a899d: ^8Grey: ^7So. About what happened with Sam... Not sure if you heard about my role in that whole... "business."
hash_2950f0f25359400e: ^8Grey: ^7Earned myself a bit of a slap on the wrist for that one. Not to worry, everything's fine. ...Or so I've been told.
hash_95098daf1567ccf: ^8Grey: ^7Just imagine if those missiles had detonated. The effects of Aetherium on a populace of that size... the outcome would have been grim.
hash_2e262a27a67f8070: ^8Grey: ^7It's tricky to nail down, Aetherium. From our tests at the DASA stations, the only pattern we've established is that there is no pattern: the effects of Aetherium exposure vary greatly between subjects.
hash_5a80481d2fcaef29: ^8Grey: ^7Yes, many suffer from advanced necrosis infections -- "the undead." But there are others whose side effects appear strictly cerebral. Hallucinations, paranoia, amnesia.
hash_eabd575adf68da: ^8Grey: ^7Then there's Maxis. Not sure what to make of her. No necrosis. Only side effect appears to be the amnesia, but there's more going on there.
hash_31d02ac2a942e4fb: ^8Grey: ^7Her Aetherium concentration? Off the scale. Highest I've seen. Normally a subject with a fraction of that exposure would be fully transformed... but she seems unaffected. So far.
hash_7239e3b9c697c19c: ^8Grey: ^7Now I'm not saying she's dangerous. We just don't know what she is.
hash_5f4545ba3ddab7c5: ^8Grey: ^7I probably shouldn't tell you this... but something happened. I think. It's not clear. When she asked me for my access codes... I swear I saw her diary move across the desk. By itself.
hash_52ca2c5380ff6adc: ^<Pyotr: ^7I have found a way through. A way that does not end in death.
hash_120409ad2d2318dd: ^<Pyotr: ^7There are strange mechanical boxes. They move between worlds.
hash_12d6d290652f1666: ^<Pyotr: ^7I climbed inside one. When I crossed over, I still changed, but not into a fire demon. Something... more.
hash_54916f67d64f6a6f: ^<Pyotr: ^7I found people. Soldiers. Like I had been.
hash_5a2e70303ebfc698: ^<Pyotr: ^7They do not know I am like them, yet still they help me. You do not see such kindness here. I forgot what it felt like to be helped.
hash_68dc4cde9910c032: ^<Pyotr: ^7I try to repay them, provide aid in their battles. It is... the least I can do.
hash_3131b2389271c2db: ^<Pyotr: ^7But then... the Forsaken finds me. He does not let me escape for long. He pulls me back.
hash_23e5f093b2763a84: ^<Pyotr: ^7So I escape again. Doomed to repeat this endless cycle.
hash_d40aef95fad5425: ^<Pyotr: ^7Still. It is nice to see home.
hash_4fe625261d71bbf4: ^<Zykov: ^7My... friend. Today I am not sure if I should call you that. Friendships are built on trust. And I wonder if our trust is broken.
hash_12bc99217d9a2c85: ^<Zykov: ^7You see, just as I speak with you, I have also been in contact with Omega Group.
hash_22d27c153e8e80e: ^<Zykov: ^7Whether or not you are already aware of this, it would be worse for me to pretend it is not so.
hash_18b876d6ffc036f: ^<Zykov: ^7Oh, I am not fooling myself. I know what they are. But all of us face a threat that dwarfs your "cold war." The Forsaken is bigger than East and West. Unchecked, he will end you both.
hash_4853c958c33f3710: ^<Zykov: ^7Now, Omega has a plan to free me from this place. And I am inclined to accept -- not simply to escape, but to stop the Forsaken. And I can only do that if I return home.
hash_49560f7b8b0b0301: ^<Zykov: ^7So if you no longer wish to be my friend, I understand. Or... if you can bring me home before Omega, so much the better. But whichever side frees me matters less than saving our world from the monster that devoured this one.
hash_4ce2366de8057f4f: ^<Zykov: ^7You are still listening. Good. I hope this means our partnership continues, despite my contact with Omega Group.
hash_24f56c0073a7956e: ^<Zykov: ^7And I certainly trust you more than anyone on their side. I know who the "good guys" are. But we are running out of time. Moral purity is not a luxury I can afford.
hash_63663fcbbfe56465: ^<Zykov: ^7Nevertheless, I will make you a deal. If Requiem can bring me home before Omega, I will join your strike team. We will fight shoulder to shoulder against the ultimate evil.
hash_1b3cd426957b37d4: ^<Zykov: ^7We can make this right, my friend. We can stop the Forsaken together. But first, by all that is holy, you have to get me out of here.
hash_74b0e4e6f61aefe4: ^<The Director: ^7We're going to try something a little different today.
hash_3125bae8b378bf91: ^<The Director: ^7In exactly thirty seconds - by my watch - the guard will pull the trigger.
hash_1acd91422cfffe98: ^8Maxis: ^7How dare you - what the fuck is wrong with you?
hash_2ed532f6abcb40c: ^8Maxis: ^7What kind of a monster are you?
hash_5070210b6a1fd051: ^8Maxis: ^7What's going on? What are you doing?
hash_297366b1d5955f81: ^<The Director: ^7Well done, Samantha - you successfully teleported your dog to safety. I can't begin to tell you how proud I am...
hash_170a6e776de93b97: ^8Maxis: ^7She's not fluffy. Her name's Not so.
hash_53475caaec15b22d: ^<The Director: ^7Cute, I suppose. I just thought you'd be pleased to see each other.
hash_63e0be7dbc5828b: ^8Maxis: ^7But I don't suppose you would know how it feels to be loved.
hash_7b65ff6b22811c20: ^8Maxis: ^7Elizabeth?! She's asleep! Why-Why are you... Watching her?!
hash_11f09c955b8173e9: ^<The Director: ^7Not just Grey - I watch everyone.
hash_4507b58e7919b8bf: ^8Maxis: ^7What do you want from me this time? More magic teleporting?
hash_76f1799a58658528: ^<The Director: ^7No. Something much more important. This is a captured Omega agent and I would like to see you kill him - using only the power of your mind.
hash_11a2e1d40c28331e: ^<The Director: ^7Won't or can't? I think the former.
hash_1bf770efea72b264: ^<The Director: ^7Take another look at the monitor. Do you see the figure standing very quietly in the corner of her room? The one who's just raised a pistol to Doctor Grey's head?
hash_5175b73b8605bd3c: ^<The Director: ^7Sorry...? I'm not sure what you mean.
hash_6b66d425629bffb1: ^<The Director: ^7The way I see it, you have a clear choice - Kill the very, very bad person, or let the very, very good person die. It's simple really.
hash_7856164ead410e44: ^<The Director: ^7Please don't make me give you a countdown, because this time I would actually start on five.
hash_41bbadf692abbc33: ^<The Director: ^7You may not realize it yet, but trust me, Samantha...
hash_565b175196d2fbe6: ^<The Director: ^7Today was a very good day.
hash_378f4a006b8bcd5f: ^8Maxis: ^7That's how long I've been here - 62 days.
hash_5c61358649cdfe14: ^8Maxis: ^7Sorry. Saying that's just me taking my mandatory excercise.
hash_48d2041d2b27280b: ^<The Director: ^7What a potty mouth you have...
hash_277583f969ee0e3a: ^8Maxis: ^7Apologies. What I meant to say was...
hash_618a383a4a0c1904: ^<The Director: ^7Can I direct your attention to the monitor? The one on your right.
hash_1a835b24cebed8dc: ^8Maxis: ^7Hello Strike Team. Remember me? It's Maxis. First of all, I want to apologize for my recent actions...
hash_7144a98ad73c9cc5: ^8Maxis: ^7For... leading you astray during your operations in the Ural mountains.
hash_3ba1d5213cd4e3e2: ^8Maxis: ^7I say recent, but in all reality, it was months ago. What can I say... time moves differently at Requiem. Especially for me.
hash_fe36c098057c25b: ^8Maxis: ^7We've all been through a lot, but the Director thought it might be 'appropriate' for me to reach out to you... Directly.
hash_a20ff3cc88c821: ^8Maxis: ^7If I could say anything, it would be to say thank you - for all that you've done.
hash_4e1ae8bb97ae296e: ^8Maxis: ^7After all... You're the ones who are in the field. Risking your lives.
hash_7c83ec60480ee4a7: ^8Maxis: ^7I know how that feels... Believe me.
hash_1f3a5fe83c71b7c4: ^8Maxis: ^7But... I think I'm pretty much done here.
hash_74958498eb3264cd: ^8Maxis: ^7Hopefully, they'll let me leave this place soon.
hash_5dbfe71446dd7503: ^8Maxis: ^7It's taken me some time to understand everything... To understand who I am.
hash_61d5fdece8f7ba0a: ^8Maxis: ^7I hated him for what he did to me, but he was right.
hash_3fb314699b5d406d: ^8Maxis: ^7I know I led you astray, but please...
hash_7bf15ad77b8b0969: ^8Maxis: ^7But, I have to do what I'm going to do...
hash_7869ab3c067b359b: ^8Maxis: ^7But it's... only recently I realized just how powerful I am.
hash_5476f113931ca105: ^8Maxis: ^7I can change the way things are.
hash_30d3096bb48485e7: ^8Maxis: ^7I can open gateways that allow us to move from this place to the next.
hash_1393b647e85998a8: ^8Maxis: ^7One place to another. Like I did in Berlin. Like I did at Outpost 25.
hash_672524adee21f961: ^8Maxis: ^7Maybe, just maybe... I could wish myself into a better world.
hash_5ff6295d64612945: ^9Kravchenko: ^7My report on the Berlin Incident has been well received by my superiors. We are in the clear... for the moment.
hash_71356b398b653912: ^9Kravchenko: ^7There has been a change of plan, Gorev. Peck and I are developing a new solution for the Forsaken.
hash_2dcd302bbc056bc5: ^9Kravchenko: ^7All will become clear soon. Rest assured -- if it is successful -- it will mean salvation for the Soviet Union. Omega Group, all of us, we will be heralded as heroes.
hash_54c628d641e8ecb: ^9Peck: ^7I'll bet. Thanks to my quick thinking.
hash_6b5caa647c69b64b: ^9Gorev: ^7Watch your tongue, Comeback Kid. Before I remove it.
hash_235e646b33c0f692: ^9Kravchenko: ^7While it pains me to admit, were it not for Peck's ingenuity with manufacturing the warhead, I do not know that we could have stopped Valentina and her army.
hash_2d54cab0674f642b: ^9Jager: ^7On that particular topic, perhaps we can discuss the interdimensional-sized elephant in the room? The Forsaken? A solution is necessary. It must be dealt with.
hash_2f5172874db2c358: ^9Gorev: ^7Ah, of course, Doctor Jager you are still coming up to speed. We are going to rebuild Peck's inversion warheads. It is the only way to destroy the creature.
hash_b2628fb5ab7874: ^9Peck: ^7Actually, Gorev, uhm, looks like you're the one still coming up to speed.
hash_5b5afcf8438e737c: ^9Kravchenko: ^7--I assume we are still on schedule, Doctor Peck?
hash_1a47bbaca28d6e52: ^9Peck: ^7That would certainly help. Provided it's not too much of a hassle.
hash_146e46fd54c2ba38: ^9Kravchenko: ^7This is the only thing that matters. Consider it done.
hash_6b47429ffc2d7466: ^9Kravchenko: ^7And the old War Hero? Still planning to honor his side of the bargain?
hash_1ad18cfbeb117756: ^9Peck: ^7We bring him back to our reality, he'll help us stop the Forsaken. He thinks we want to kill it.
hash_10c3386251fd8ae3: ^9Kravchenko: ^7Keep me informed, Peck. Without this "David" of yours, there is no Operatsiya Izbavitel.
hash_47e138e512ee3fd6: ^9Peck: ^7Uh, yes, Colonel. Construction of the machine should be complete in six to eight weeks.
hash_7bc32ac18f5dffa: ^9Kravchenko: ^7Not good enough. We must accelerate development. If Requiem gets word of Operatsiya Izbavitel before we are ready...
hash_3e09ef0b02b1af50: ^9Peck: ^7I know, I know, but considering the scale of this operation, we're lucky to be on track at all.
hash_623a8c2705f7c59f: ^9Peck: ^7The device to free Zykov was challenging enough, but this machine is complex. We're talking a new frontier. Undiscovered science. The sort of thing they write books about, then debate for decades... maybe centuries. We're shifting the paradigm, rewriting the rules...
hash_60ad3ae6adf8449c: ^9Peck: ^7Uhm, you know, David? The, uh... Michelangelo? Renaissance?
hash_1a9f6596a15e1b5b: ^9Peck: ^7...Maybe that one didn't make it to Russia yet.
hash_5eb85c8e5794edf5: ^9Kravchenko: ^7What can I do to expedite, your... "David"? Reallocate resources? Divert personnel to the project?
hash_48c03730cf1adf30: ^9Gorev: ^7Is there a point to your goading? Or are you just here to insult me and my vodka?
hash_520500ee11756b23: ^9Jager: ^7I am here because I am concerned. And I suspect you may be as well.
hash_142bef037e90a300: ^9Jager: ^7Peck and Kravchenko, Kravchenko and Peck. It is not like the Colonel to keep his most trusted man out of the loop.
hash_30336aa3bebbf2c9: ^9Jager: ^7You were his protege. The son he never had.
hash_1918340bdc1713b7: ^9Jager: ^7Kravchenko has made his intentions clear. Operatsiya Izbavitel cannot fail. If it does, the man will do whatever he must to ensure his own survival. His neck may escape the rope. But what about ours?
hash_5a547126010f8bc3: ^9Gorev: ^7Since Berlin the Colonel has become... reckless. The KGB's patience is growing thin. Should this fail, we will all pay the price.
hash_2f73dd837dbadf38: ^9Gorev: ^7I trust you can keep this between us?
hash_56f235b17f562b0b: ^9Jager: ^7Ja, mein Freund. We have much more to discuss.
hash_688b794de09a40e3: ^9Jager: ^7Can one not simply stop by for an unexpected visit, Gorev?
hash_391e7cbd1bfd9cf0: ^9Gorev: ^7I am in no mood to entertain your antics.
hash_1ac280b7a61bbc74: ^9Jager: ^7And I must say, it looks as delicious as the boot it was probably distilled in.
hash_1066208d3977f156: ^9Jager: ^7So... it seems we are both being kept in the dark.
hash_391a1d57175f708: ^9Jager: ^7Like a couple of naughty children. Not allowed to sit at the grown-up table.
hash_2737d12969706492: ^8Weaver: ^7No. Not today. Omega are still several steps ahead of us - and I don't like not knowing what's coming.
hash_76c71be4bdcc6684: ^8Carver: ^7I think we all know what's coming... and it's a threat from the Dark Aether itself.
hash_53e4c4483ea53703: ^8Strauss: ^7The Forsaken. It could well prove to be a bigger threat than Omega.
hash_451b749f61114591: ^8Weaver: ^7Well that's what I'm here to talk about. Desperate times. Desperate measures. We need to reach out to those with... more 'inside' knowledge.
hash_3c8aaa922fc68fe1: ^8Carver: ^7I really hope the next word out of your mouth doesn't begin with Rav...
hash_3a1d6c324211b52f: ^8Weaver: ^7Ravenov. He's no friend to Omega, and I think he could well prove valuable to us.
hash_1179e86ba7de0827: ^8Strauss: ^7There is... another option... Or should I say 'additional' option.
hash_2321a43cba631b95: ^8Carver: ^7Zykov. He may be the only one who truly knows The Forsaken.
hash_715b9019cbca4fc7: ^8Grey: ^7Are we suggesting we somehow... break this 'lost Russian' out of the Dark Aether?
hash_5727ca70a864bb73: ^8Weaver: ^7Poor bastard's been in there longer than anyone... and we need all the allies we can get.
hash_2759d12a36646501: ^8Weaver: ^7I'm trying to think of where to start...
hash_6fdce15d60e2ac1a: ^8Grey: ^7What's on you mind, Weaver? We're all friends here... Good colleagues at the very least.
hash_6b89b445670c645: ^8Weaver: ^7The situation in Berlin could have been a whole lot worse than it was, but - thanks to Agent Maxis - we were able to get the strike team home safely.
hash_570a3a79c83e2317: ^8Strauss: ^7And eliminate that rather nasty threat from the... Nazis.
hash_3d931253f4b2d3f7: ^8Grey: ^7Isn't there something else we should be discussing?
hash_4e5cb349f45c70b9: ^8Strauss: ^7Ah. Carver. Here to gloat? Do a "victory lap"?
hash_2cab0b21cf640b26: ^8Carver: ^7What about exploration? Your research was only possible because my teams protected yours. I'm not the provocateur, I'm the peacemaker.
hash_53dc4ff87ed262bf: ^8Carver: ^7And that's what I'm trying to do right now. Make peace.
hash_6daac529de2aa6c: ^8Carver: ^7The Forsaken is coming. The way I see it, it's going to take your brains and my brawn to stop it.
hash_18aa4f44c16c853a: ^8Carver: ^7A temporary cease-fire. We need to work together if were going to stop this thing.
hash_3215430eec8957c: ^8Strauss: ^7Surely you can pardon an old man for being stuck in his ways.
hash_24df904267037389: ^8Carver: ^7Shit. You're not the only stubborn bastard in this office.
hash_93307518d83e102: ^8Strauss: ^7I do fear, Major, that we are already too late. I have been studying the primordial energy from the vortices. They are appearing more frequently, rapidly accelerating the terraforming process.
hash_7656323c89175e93: ^8Strauss: ^7In one month's time, we will no longer be able to contain their spread. As long as the portals remain open, they will continue to grow.
hash_43827229fbc0e073: ^8Carver: ^7Well. Sounds like we need to find a way to close the portals then.
hash_6e625a9b5e168abb: ^8Strauss: ^7Your outlandish theory has proved true -- and I was one of your most vocal doubters.
hash_6b64839086d1ce6a: ^8Strauss: ^7You were right. Your "Commander-in Chief" presiding over a Dark Aether army. The Forsaken.
hash_6df5321cb7dc6439: ^8Carver: ^7We both know me coming here to gloat would be a waste of time.
hash_e3add8e8a543e2c: ^8Strauss: ^7Ah! So what then? Here to celebrate? Regretfully, I am all out of champagne.
hash_fde5fb8caa38db3: ^8Carver: ^7All right. I get it. You and me? - we won't ever see eye to eye. I'm a man of war. You're a man of science. In WW2, my father fought for the allies, while you fought for the...
hash_7efe54e06a88564e: ^8Strauss: ^7--how dare you. I never fought for anything more than my own research, and, in turn, my whole life has been in the service of men like you, who only want weapons. Violence. Annihilation.
hash_79a6674e24643cdd: ^8Carver: ^7You got this all wrong. I'm trying to prevent annihilation.
hash_1f146f2763e7ce0: ^8Strauss: ^7Because you have the bigger stick? Nothing is learned through eradication.
hash_234d2997d3cfd9c3: ^8Raptor One: ^7Come on in! Especially if its my most favorite nurse!
hash_8913bad6e69bf0f: ^8Carver: ^7You've done more than any commanding officer has a right to expect. You went through a lot.
hash_2cdce5bd19c7db9f: ^8Raptor One: ^7Uh... Permission to speak freely, Sir?
hash_15f7388eab681775: ^8Carver: ^7Well, with all the cussing you've been doing, I assumed speaking freely was already a given.
hash_225ea10867861f13: ^8Carver: ^7Sure. As long as it's from the fresh box, not the bedsheets.
hash_7fe687635a073513: ^8Raptor One: ^7Thing is - Sir - I don't wanna leave.
hash_54dd6f66da1cd9ba: ^8Raptor One: ^7Good. I can't stand those creamy ones. My favorite's butterscotch - and then maybe the caramel.
hash_5e23aaff39319cfe: ^8Carver: ^7Chocolates aside - May I ask why you don't want to go on leave?
hash_464bb914806f00b: ^8Raptor One: ^7I appreciate you visiting me - and the promise of some more medals. But, I spent most of that last op tied up. Much like I am now.
hash_5e440eba2ef2aa9e: ^8Raptor One: ^7If it's all the same to you, I'd rather get airborne again and do what I do best.
hash_47babb01247b0c18: ^8Carver: ^7Hauling our strike team outta trouble whenever they need it?
hash_64b5b15de8e48950: ^8Carver: ^7At ease, Captain. Mind if I take a seat?
hash_464592f8083cbdd4: ^8Raptor One: ^7With a Ribbon rack like that, you can do what ever the hell you want.
hash_4aef9047c94d114f: ^8Raptor One: ^7Shit... You can even have the bed.
hash_6ec6bcd54bec0c7f: ^8Carver: ^7No need... And - while it's not yet official, I think you can expect some of these ribbons yourself.
hash_7305d151c7cf9e90: ^8Raptor One: ^7Well, I appreciate it, Major - Especially seeing as how I just dropped my other ones on the bed. Aww, shit - they're just melting into the damn sheets. What the fuck is Nurse Mary Beth gonna think?
hash_2a367e5f7a4cba2: ^8Carver: ^7Captain. You're on leave for the rest of the month.
hash_78eb3bdf3c9b1574: ^<Ravenov: ^7Even after all this time, you are still not listening. That is not why I have ever done any of this. It has always been about doing the right thing.
hash_506c4a13c31c47d5: ^<Ravenov: ^7A courier will be delivering a parcel to Requiem's dead drop in Madrid. It contains everything I know.
hash_4052cb971ef41875: ^8Weaver: ^7Why don't you come in? We can talk this out.
hash_217387cbc8fac7ab: ^<Ravenov: ^7And end up in that six-by-four in Dreamland? I don't think so.
hash_40b464c1bdd9feb2: ^8Weaver: ^7And in return? What do you get out of all this. Your name cleared? Safe passage to the West?
hash_7f2c5b0d51b9cbf6: ^<Ravenov: ^7Nyet. I want you to release Agent Maxis. I have come to understand you are still holding her in captivity.
hash_36a301982e8e6600: ^8Weaver: ^7You know I can't make that call.
hash_26aadbed1565723c: ^<Ravenov: ^7But, as we both know, there is someone listening in who can. You know who you are.
hash_1ced6d74d298cdda: ^<Ravenov: ^7Still all out of fucks to give, Weaver?
hash_281fff7f6387995f: ^8Weaver: ^7You shouldn't be calling. This line is monitored and recorded. Just talking to you could land my ass in a six-by-four at Dreamland--
hash_6b4edd4237c02d77: ^<Ravenov: ^7--you'll want to hear what I have to say, Weaver. As will your Director, who, if I am not mistaken, is also listening in.
hash_61da8318f0107b26: ^<Ravenov: ^7I've done some thinking, some... soul-searching. I took what you said to heart. The one made of ice.
hash_628dde05fd05cfc2: ^8Weaver: ^7Get to the point. What do you want.
hash_4640b288c9bdc570: ^<Ravenov: ^7Omega. Operatsiya Izbavitel. I know what it is. More importantly... I know where.
hash_4567611ca5dbaea3: ^<Ravenov: ^7There is a test site. Used in the early days of Operatsiya Inversiya. It has been repurposed. That is all I can say for now.
hash_3c0ec3dbfc60b7bd: ^8Weaver: ^7I'm going to need more than that if you want to get back into my good graces.
hash_67e7cd14bcabe2fd: ^8Strauss: ^7Krafft's choice was not unlike my own. His life's work versus potential calamity. His choice speaks for itself, since we are here now to read the story of what he endured and accomplished.
hash_41223741754ab58c: ^8Strauss: ^7I hope I choose as wisely as he did.
hash_7b0f136d67eb4a55: ^8Strauss: ^7It is late. My insomnia has returned for the first time in years. I try counting sheep, but I end up counting sins instead.
hash_581170dfd7239f66: ^8Strauss: ^7Weaver says our conflict with Omega is coming to a head. The tipping point approaches. One final battle.
hash_7600813097b7fb37: ^8Strauss: ^7Once more unto the breach, dear friends, once more...
hash_3505b73261606870: ^8Strauss: ^7Two sides in the mix: Requiem, Omega -- each desiring to destroy the other. One wild card in the deck: the Dark Aether, desiring to destroy us all.
hash_3d790f49feb0fc91: ^8Strauss: ^7I cannot say what outcome East and West will bring, but with the Forsaken, there is no doubt: extinction.
hash_197d9e83f1a184c2: ^8Strauss: ^7There is only one way to stop it -- close the gateways. Sever our connection to the Dark Aether. Forever.
hash_5d12969b680fc153: ^8Strauss: ^7That would mean the end of my research. The end of Aetherium. But if we do not act, it could mean the end of the world.
hash_136ceb6352e7ec3c: ^8Strauss: ^7I recently found myself reviewing old records in Requiem's archive. From the war. I found documentation about a man who faced a similar conundrum. Professor Krafft.
hash_6794b26ea101fbed: ^8Strauss: ^7A Demonologist. Studier of the occult. A man forced to work for a great evil.
hash_6118c1d047e5d42: ^8Weaver: ^7Strike team - I just wanted to reach out with some... updates.
hash_46c069885b64169b: ^8Weaver: ^7First of all... Berlin. Your time as Kravchenko's prisoner. You've shown courage and commitment - even in the face of severe adversity. I couldn't have asked for more.
hash_23a1fe713dc9b690: ^8Weaver: ^7Even though we face an uncertain enemy - or enemies - I think we're approaching the endgame here.
hash_4ec1be59bd92c301: ^8Weaver: ^7Omega is still out there - and truthfully - we don't know what their next play is going to be. All we can be certain of, is that Kravchenko's actions are becoming increasingly desperate.
hash_5df04e04460af506: ^8Weaver: ^7As you know - or I hope you know - Agent Maxis may be our most valuable asset. She's turning out to be something... special... As your rescue in Berlin clearly showed.
hash_4ba3ad966b0026df: ^8Weaver: ^7Her time in the Dark Aether changed her in ways we're only just starting to fully understand.
hash_2cd84b8ae61c2b54: ^8Weaver: ^7She's been undertaking some... Tests... With the Director.
hash_2e208873dd9f2445: ^8Weaver: ^7All I ask is that if we - if I - do let her return to the field, that you'll... support her in whatever the situation we may find ourselves in.
hash_7fe7348b4bd251c9: ^8Strauss: ^7My oh my, it certainly has been a minute since we last spoke. You have been a busy bee -- Operatsiya Inversiya, Operation Excision... not to mention your little "detour" with Omega. Quite the global pedestrian.
hash_1c026f8e4e93d2fa: ^8Strauss: ^7Well, while you were off on "holiday" in Berlin, I've been hard at work on replicating Doctor Zarkova's Aetherium Neutralizer. Admittedly, I haven't had much to go on, as we only recovered half the blueprint.
hash_487b469e0dd73a4b: ^8Strauss: ^7However, as the Dark Aether's terraforming is ongoing and the Phase continues to expand, such a device will prove invaluable for your continued field work.
hash_3a7267261788633c: ^8Strauss: ^7Hopefully it will be available for field testing before too long.
hash_e9a2e3165a272ed: ^8Strauss: ^7Considering the looming threat we now face, we will need everything available in our arsenal to stop it.
hash_67f5d4b8cd8815e4: ^8Grey: ^7Hey Strike Team. How you all doing? Sorry - just realized you can't really tell me - this communication is one way only.
hash_3ac68d30b0dc39e6: ^8Grey: ^7Ever since she came back from the Dark Aether, she's had these... powers.
hash_5553287a12de6b35: ^8Grey: ^7She can move things - I know we can all do that - but I mean she can do it without actually touching them...
hash_6b6bf30eed2b690c: ^8Grey: ^7It's like, if she really, really concentrates - she can just make things happen.
hash_2e6ae919a75fd2f3: ^8Grey: ^7I think we all wish we could do that.
hash_6f5ce45b9032c501: ^8Grey: ^7Come on Notso. Time to go home.
hash_3d10f8ec8c667a6d: ^8Grey: ^7Hey, Girl... What are you getting your nose into now?
hash_22042c700e8eedde: ^8Grey: ^7You probably knew from the start that I wasn't real military.
hash_35e058bc91b299f: ^8Grey: ^7Never did any PT... Never held a gun.
hash_1c9909a4aaee040: ^8Grey: ^7Don't think I'm cut out for it to be honest.
hash_7ef1f07ee05885aa: ^8Grey: ^7Sorry - I'm walking Notso. That's Sam's dog in case you didn't know! You might have thought 'walking notso' meant I was walking in some wierd, funny way.
hash_5558977869063ccb: ^8Grey: ^7Speaking of Sam - Maxis - I've not seen her for a little while, but Weaver said she's doing well.
hash_40895282a083b26c: ^8Grey: ^7She's in Block 8... but I guess that's where they take you when you're...
hash_5fa69f05630bcb6: ^8Carver: ^7Strike team! Damn, is it good to have you back in the field.
hash_a31e885263525cf: ^8Carver: ^7You know, after Berlin, a few Requiem folks were wondering if you'd be up for redeployment. Not your old friend Mac. Never a doubt in my mind.
hash_3b2d68e4aacfa3fc: ^8Carver: ^7We need you out there, now more than ever. Satellite surveillance shows the Outbreak Zones are expanding. Slowly, but - they're growing none the less.
hash_68b4bae913c91b35: ^8Carver: ^7It's those damn terraforming crystals. They're shaking up the whole landscape. The Phase is making it uninhabitable. For us, anyway.
hash_1e0aee1483a99c8a: ^8Carver: ^7Shit. Wouldn't surprise me if one day soon the Oh-Zees just started collapsing.
hash_771e4ddb346fb1d3: ^8Carver: ^7...look. I gotta level with you. Soldier to soldier.
hash_252a728f384f73e0: ^8Carver: ^7Omega. The Forsaken. Something's going down here. General sense around the office is that we're headed towards some sort of conclusion. Act three time. If all goes well, the next operation will be the beginning of the end.
hash_5432bdd8e9fa6bd9: ^8Carver: ^7So let me ask you. What about us?
hash_2b8d35afd74f31be: ^8Carver: ^7The shit we're in right now, this... this interdimensional warfare? We're well beyond "classified" here. You don't just get to walk away from this.
hash_2cf830ca0f78a77: ^8Carver: ^7So once this is over, once the good guys win... where are we going from here?
hash_4e49e3cb3bd22f5a: ^<Pyotr: ^7I can hardly remember before. There is only now. And "Now" is not a time I would wish upon anyone.
hash_3368b671a4bfaa91: ^<Pyotr: ^7This place has changed. It is unsustainable.
hash_486a11954bcfe060: ^<Pyotr: ^7Many bow before one. Those who do not are consumed. The rest of us... we cower in shadow.
hash_3f51fdfe43529597: ^<Pyotr: ^7Some manage to escape, but the crossing between worlds is dangerous.
hash_7b3130facd48580e: ^<Pyotr: ^7They arrive home disfigured. Changed into fiery demons. Horrors devoid of humanity.
hash_2767ac1e38c07d85: ^<Pyotr: ^7I hear they are killed almost instantly, when all they wanted was to escape.
hash_f28c33b3c1d4de4: ^<Pyotr: ^7But they were no longer human. So the good soldiers bring their suffering to an end.
hash_b1bc83d38b849df: ^<Zykov: ^7--I hope you understand now what is at stake, my friend. The Forsaken. It wields a dangerous power.
hash_422151f6fae053ed: ^9Peck: ^7Listen, Zykov -- I need to level with you. This is going to take some time to construct.
hash_2e3bcc719a3b09c0: ^9Peck: ^7Your design... it's a technical feat. I've never seen anything like it. It's... overwhelming. This will take time to wrap my head around.
hash_402967e15609e90e: ^<Zykov: ^7Your transparency is why I know you are the perfect man for the job. You respect the science and difficulty of the task.
hash_3f87c78d721d046f: ^<Zykov: ^7Fools rush in where angels fear to tread. You are wise not to treat this lightly.
hash_702b819571ad58d3: ^9Peck: ^7Yeah, no kidding. Valentina nearly cost us all our jobs.
hash_121fd398aad26d70: ^9Peck: ^7That, and, uh, almost destroying the world.
hash_3cb65facee65124: ^<Zykov: ^7Next time we will not be so lucky. He has seen a demonstration of your capabilities. He will not make the same mistakes again.
hash_72dee1621a402672: ^9Peck: ^7Hey, with any luck, we'll have him making all new ones. Thanks to you.
hash_4f383e626823849a: ^<Zykov: ^7So your commander has signed off on our proposal?
hash_63a649f1a58365bc: ^9Peck: ^7Not just yet. But I'm making progress. We'll have you home before you know it, as agreed.
hash_581201d256f89040: ^<Zykov: ^7And in turn I will honor my part of deal and help you kill the Forsaken.
hash_19248d00f3d66c07: ^<Zykov: ^7You have received my schematics? For the machine.
hash_4626df62f1340afb: ^9Peck: ^7That and the piece you built yourself.
hash_457a91b7c9f67293: ^8Maxis: ^7I don't know... Everything is different now.
hash_756c1b08d792de8: ^<The Director: ^7Oh, I know that better than you...
hash_b5b7e72f8864742: ^<The Director: ^7You're in Block 8! A facility specifically designed to take care of... people like you.
hash_48b1f7c837bb15dc: ^<The Director: ^7You are here to undergo some... 'Specialized tests'.
hash_a61ba09091848c6: ^<The Director: ^7You'll find out. Soon enough. The Dark Aether changed you in many ways.
hash_76aee5f194a4e593: ^<The Director: ^7I just need you to know how much...
hash_4caf7fa98bf49e92: ^<The Director: ^7Really? I think you're going to be very surprised...
hash_6df497c19c3df629: ^<The Director: ^7You will answer our questions. Do you understand?
hash_324e6ad7797195ab: ^<The Director: ^7That's not important. What's important is who you are. What's your name?
hash_39a49060b44faf8a: ^<The Director: ^7Your name is Samantha Maxis. You were born in Berlin - November 5th. Is that correct?
hash_5636498513bdd347: ^<The Director: ^7I was worried you'd be like this. Why can't we just get along? I promise you - what I'm doing is for your own good.
hash_55c67b88b79bf4e1: ^<The Director: ^7Maybe. But I know what you're capable of... I just want to see it for myself.
hash_3484e9a47a69663: ^<The Director: ^7That would force me into the regrettable position of having to use more 'severe methods'.
hash_434e5fee5cc454bd: ^<The Director: ^7No. Not a threat... Just an incentive.
hash_7681a96b4481741a: ^<The Director: ^7No. We've got work to do.
hash_31abaa952190cc00: ^<The Director: ^7I really hope it doesn't come to that.
hash_5e2632cf6f6fb996: ^<The Director: ^7I want you to show me some of your powers. Weaver and Grey both saw you do it - why should I miss out?
hash_4b9a6e769ece6bac: ^<The Director: ^7I want you to move something - using only the power of your mind.
hash_4f3b89567b09b0a9: ^8Maxis: ^7If you'd come down from behind that glass, I'd move something alright.
hash_45e8402a758d74a9: ^8Maxis: ^7They wouldn't want me to be here. You're just trying to manipulate me... Test my emotional responses.
hash_5e86a5b726881412: ^<The Director: ^7Like you did with them? Do you even know how much trouble you caused for your Requiem friends?
hash_744b091103aa915f: ^<The Director: ^7Going behind their backs on your little 'secret squirrel' mission with Ravenov?
hash_5ecb9d22fb7b8224: ^8Maxis: ^7I looked Weaver in the eye when I was taken... to be brought here. He didn't want this.
hash_5359eb9b03988a4a: ^8Maxis: ^7Not in the way you think. We just have history. Shared history. Shared... Trauma.
hash_7fbdd78164116db4: ^<The Director: ^7I do understand. In fact I was very forgiving about the whole thing.
hash_714c9c12d0b92b61: ^<The Director: ^7I mean... Given Weaver's failures and lapses in security, I could easily have had him 'disappeared'.
hash_667ea8346853de0c: ^<The Director: ^7Oh, you heard me come in? You're very perceptive, aren't you?
hash_498c059e01d1e0fa: ^<The Director: ^7What on earth could you possibly do to me?
hash_3b3325d738afe71d: ^<The Director: ^7You really are just a pathetic, sad, little, lost girl...
hash_5c289c0686981d60: ^<The Director: ^7Oh, dear... I suppose we'll have to replace that glass now.
hash_368586abf7054876: ^<The Director: ^7But... at least we're making progress.
hash_6aa0298fb01e023f: ^<The Director: ^7Do you know how long you've been here?
hash_38afdc6ccb0763f6: ^8Maxis: ^7Not counting bathroom breaks and mandatory excercise?
hash_4e671fb978409723: ^8Maxis: ^7What kind of breakthrough do you want? Your only goal seems to be trying to make me angry... but I'm not...
hash_418cbc8c98111a41: ^<The Director: ^7You're probably going to be more disappointed when this session is over.
hash_220662c16bb12314: ^<The Director: ^7You do know that none of them really care for you... Strauss, Carver, Weaver... Even Grey. They've barely inquired as to your current 'situation'.
hash_606d4c3fcef4628: ^<Pyotr: ^7There is a machine I have seen in my crossings. A fiery mechanical dragon.
hash_214eedd2ff06c099: ^<Pyotr: ^7The Soldiers. They provide it with offerings of flesh. They are rewarded handsomely.
hash_6c1213e261cd2842: ^<Pyotr: ^7They do not realize. Every offering is another soul for him to consume.
hash_33e648093f571cab: ^<Pyotr: ^7They have made him more powerful than I thought... possible.
hash_3f688910972596c: ^<Pyotr: ^7I cannot blame them. They do what they believe is right. They are following blindly.
hash_6b3d9f78f209c7ad: ^<Pyotr: ^7I was once very much like them.
hash_60707729e6ead4a1: ^<Pyotr: ^7I have seen many things in my travels.
hash_718aa11a6f40d330: ^<Pyotr: ^7For all its horror... there is beauty in this deep, dark, Aether.
hash_21eadbdd76a55d53: ^<Pyotr: ^7The crystals. They take our memories. They make us forget who we were.
hash_7ad0735062264b2a: ^<Pyotr: ^7But our memories do not fade. They are taken from us, and form something new. Something... magical.
hash_4083193710df7d74: ^<Pyotr: ^7I have seen many in my time here. So many memories. So many stories to tell. Memories of a Russian Scientist. Of an American spy.
hash_6bd98d8369a86467: ^<Pyotr: ^7There is one orb. It is different. Special. It is like me. It can cross between worlds.
hash_2838f1b30f73821e: ^<Pyotr: ^7It is filled with the laughter of a child.
hash_64324f777cb3f979: ^<Pyotr: ^7I may never learn who the child is or what happened to them, but their memories... are powerful.
hash_5563b2661783e91b: ^<The Director: ^7Hello, Sam. How are you today?
hash_7887c806bcc74502: ^<The Director: ^7Sam, I would never give up on you. You don't know how much power you really possess... What your gift truly is.
hash_179071baa6f2913f: ^8Maxis: ^7And you want to take it from me?
hash_3278415bf918ea9c: ^<The Director: ^7No... I want to help you learn how to use those gifts - for the good of us all.
hash_642b9e003a010b9e: ^<The Director: ^7The Forsaken is almost upon us - and... only you can stop it.
hash_288172969440a444: ^8Maxis: ^7I am not scared. I have overcome much worse things.
hash_6ce40901ebda167f: ^<The Director: ^7I don't mean scared of being here. I mean... Are you scared of yourself?
hash_111b4a38cb86d530: ^8Maxis: ^7I want to believe that. I have to believe that.
hash_10124cf31a290703: ^<The Director: ^7You don't need to prove it to me. I know.
hash_44e8e7cf94a3d062: ^8Maxis: ^7Why can't you just let me go? Why can't you just put me out of my misery?
hash_1560d23def8d655a: ^8Maxis: ^7And I - we - will forever feel responsible for his death.
hash_1fa39fe7e7c4cafd: ^8Maxis: ^7I gave the intel to Weaver... the intel he acted upon.
hash_440cf6dd7577bcb4: ^8Maxis: ^7That's what we're all supposed to do, right? - Act on the available intel?
hash_26daf79fce1cf4a6: ^8Maxis: ^7Unfortunately... his actions resulted in collateral damage that neither of us will ever be able to forgive ourselves for.
hash_df77aa7482eb0cb: ^8Maxis: ^7But I still have a terrible feeling that the events of that day may yet come back to haunt us.
hash_28f740b56881bd2b: ^8Maxis: ^7I've lived through it - Even when I saw no hope for a new dawn.
hash_5ebcda8e62a70fec: ^8Maxis: ^7Even in my dreams I saw darkness.
hash_13afa340158ba737: ^8Maxis: ^7I will not - cannot - allow it to consume us all.
hash_7b3b8f91340d7334: ^9Peck: ^7Yeah, Central? Codename Whiskers, requesting immediate transfer to Argus.
hash_5ba3d529af9396d1: ^9Peck: ^7What? "Code In?" You know who this. Don't be ridiculous.
hash_dcfe7055a65276a: ^9Peck: ^7"Lovely night, isn't it? Nothing like the Big Apple in wintertime."
hash_2a631310ab7c4897: ^9Peck: ^7Yeah, great. Just transfer me, fuckhead. He'll want to hear this.
hash_11c13fc377479b15: ^9Peck: ^7Yeah... yeah, it's Peck. Listen, I don't have much time. But I do have information. I know what Omega is planning.
hash_358bf95cf2beb0ce: ^9Peck: ^7What do I want? I want a clean slate. My burn notice destroyed. My record expunged. Let bygones be bygones.
hash_88f8738afa7218b: ^9Peck: ^7No? What if I told you I can deliver you Zykov on a silver platter.
hash_213b2b50b588688c: ^9Peck: ^7Yeah, that got your attention. Tuesday. 10am. Our old dead drop. I'll give you everything I have on Operatsiya Izbavitel.
hash_40dc30d39d79a348: ^9Kravchenko: ^7Thank you for meeting with me on such short notice.
hash_36983f243c3d57c6: ^9Jager: ^7Unfortunately, sometimes "the myth" is larger than "the man".
hash_5f02f02ecaefb7dd: ^9Jager: ^7They were just stories, Colonel. Stories to scare children.
hash_2e43aaa08f50d569: ^9Kravchenko: ^7That will be all, Doctor. Have a good night.
hash_75ba8e87ecca65b9: ^9Jager: ^7Some doors are closed for a reason, Colonel. Do not open this one.
hash_50ced7eb0bcfc743: ^9Jager: ^7It is my pleasure. Why the late night call? Trouble sleeping?
hash_4369c3cceec285f6: ^9Kravchenko: ^7There is a... "delicate" topic I wish to discuss.
hash_6672015b40f462ef: ^9Kravchenko: ^7In 72 hours, Zykov will be in our custody. Soon after, we will face the enemy. The Forsaken.
hash_2d8e7686bb06a04c: ^9Kravchenko: ^7I had hoped you could offer some insight about what to expect... considering your family lineage.
hash_3b1c7e206478cf57: ^9Jager: ^7Forgive me, Colonel, I am not sure what you mean.
hash_3ebdd729443c60a: ^9Kravchenko: ^7Come now. I have read your file. You are related to Oberfuhrer Wolfram Von List. The fabled leader of the SS unit Die Wahrheit.
hash_6879557ed0b41b33: ^9Kravchenko: ^7He faced similar entities, yes? What was its name? Ah, yes, Kor--
hash_5ff004d6a85eb35a: ^9Jager: ^7--tread carefully, Colonel. There are certain names best left not said aloud.
hash_7e4a776fd1fb55ab: ^9Jager: ^7While it is true my Great Uncle pursued certain... obsessions, I am afraid I was privy to little that would be helpful for our situation.
hash_69e71a11a5bee10b: ^9Gorev: ^7Gorev to Peck. Hello, my American friend. I trust you find Mother Russia more hospitable than the jungles of Vietnam?
hash_413facec6ec20515: ^9Peck: ^7Hospitable? I've gone from sweating my ass off to freezing my nuts off, so--
hash_52113dd23fe63c99: ^9Gorev: ^7It was rhetorical question. I do not really care about your comfort. Only that you do not squander the second chance we have very generously given you.
hash_380df461a7218b8b: ^9Peck: ^7I...yes. Of course. Believe me, I've got a lot to work with here.
hash_660158257a0a1907: ^9Gorev: ^7Just keep Kravchenko informed of your progress. You may be top scientist, but it is you under microscope now. Fail him again and you will be mining Aetherium crystals while Dr. Valentina takes your place. I think she would very much enjoy this.
hash_b224252a70e00d1: ^9Peck: ^7With all due respect, Valentina can't even begin to understand the Dark Aether like I do.
hash_749862b108ee4e65: ^9Gorev: ^7See, that is point. No more secrets. No more hoarding information so you are only one with answers. Share what you know. Get everyone "up to speed," as you like to say. Is your best move if you want to keep other eye.
hash_2f4175d2125defa3: ^9Gorev: ^7Oh, I know you will. Because if there is one thing you Americans love, it is a comeback story. This is your chance to make your friend Gorev proud. And I know you do want to make me proud.
hash_67095600118e1f30: ^9Gorev: ^7Hello, Peck. Remember how you allowed spy to infiltrate your ranks at Outpost 25? Remember how this informant compromised our valuable research lead over Americans?
hash_7dc71f93b5156ca2: ^9Peck: ^7Look, I know I screwed up. But the mole's dead now, right? I mean, I'm the sole survivor from that whole Vietnam fiasco.
hash_5940fb78321989e2: ^9Gorev: ^7"Fiasco." Such a colorful word. Almost sounds like fun. You know what is not fun? That we still have massive fucking intelligence leak -- thanks to your not-dead mole, whom Kravchenko wants taken alive.
hash_6e98881f91a074ac: ^9Peck: ^7Alive, huh? He...must have plans for the poor schmuck.
hash_44ef412148e2fa74: ^9Gorev: ^7You will be schmuck if we do not figure out who it is. So put big brain to work. And contact me immediately if you identify the son of bitch. Am I clear?
hash_582d25af99c49b95: ^9Gorev: ^7Peck? Gorev here. Bad news, little man: my scouts confirm that Requiem is now conducting operations in the Ural Mountains breach zone.
hash_50216e4e62094737: ^9Gorev: ^7They are desperate. But we cannot risk them finding out about your current project.
hash_782e3ff9546384e1: ^9Peck: ^7Are you saying I should lay low somewhere?
hash_377b62c459bb7849: ^9Gorev: ^7Heh. So brave. No, Peck, Operatsiya Inversiya is to remain your priority. The Colonel already mentioned it to Kremlin. Do not make him look bad.
hash_207596a6736075cc: ^9Gorev: ^7Just have your people keep their eyes open. Report any sightings of Requiem, but do not engage. Leave that to Spetsnaz. We live for this... shit.
hash_55f77c1236c3389f: ^8Carver: ^7Good evening, Agent Maxis. I'm Major Carver. I hope you're recovering from your ordeal.
hash_7dd50a3447366334: ^8Carver: ^7In recent months, we've seen a lot of things we never thought possible. So - if any details do come back to you, I trust you will let us know.
hash_6bfa3551eae98598: ^8Maxis: ^7Of course. Now, if you don't mind I would like to get some sleep.
hash_6af378fd2378403f: ^8Maxis: ^7'Major'. Would that make you Requiem's highest ranking military representative?
hash_378be5c7e6ece945: ^8Carver: ^7Please. Call me Mac. My friends do. Now... I'm going to get down to brass tacks. We're fighting a war that we both know we're losing. I was hoping your experiences could shed some light on just how far the enemy has gotten ahead of us.
hash_1c72cdc8aea952f9: ^8Maxis: ^7Which enemy? Are you talking about Omega?... Or the others?
hash_1a14f2497f7958e3: ^8Carver: ^7When you say 'others', I'm assuming you mean hostile elements from within the Dark Aether itself? Are they... Mobilizing? Are there forces strategizing an assault on our world? What kind of technology do they possess? Is their some kind of hierarchy we should be aware of?
hash_2a30eae928785b53: ^8Maxis: ^7Well, 'Mac', to answer your questions in order - Yes. Yes. Yes. I'm not sure. Probably... But I'd be lying if I said I understood it. The whole experience of being trapped there was... Confusing.
hash_4f9d59ec146760e9: ^8Carver: ^7With all due respect, Agent Maxis... As a former agent of the BND, there have doubtless been times in your career - your life - where lying and misleading those around you was very much essential?
hash_5fb45627b2a62ebd: ^8Maxis: ^7Do you think I'm lying to you, Major Carver?
hash_7f7a1d119b6416c7: ^8Carver: ^7No, but I am concerned about the content of some transmissions you sent while you were in the Dark Aether. Some of them seem to imply that you yourself might have caused the outbreak at Outpost 25.
hash_643cbdef0c9f8597: ^8Maxis: ^7I don't know how that would be possible, do you?
hash_66493d259636a524: ^8Strauss: ^7Well, isn't this nice? I thought you might appreciate hearing a familiar voice... We have a lot in common, after all.
hash_21818bf7450b0ddd: ^8Strauss: ^7Requiem are very interested in the... gaps in your memory regarding the events at outpost 25. Particularly its destruction and the question of your role in it.
hash_16ad9a340026efad: ^8Maxis: ^7I was angry and confused, but that doesn't mean I could somehow unleash all the forces of the Dark Aether upon Omega.
hash_14367f16082361ff: ^8Strauss: ^7Well, I was thinking your anger was perhaps directed more at Peck. I would understand the desire for revenge.
hash_38206cdeae8a4d43: ^8Maxis: ^7You really think I had the power to do that, Strauss?
hash_636b36a0bffb2e79: ^8Strauss: ^7I'm more concerned about the possibility of you doing it again.
hash_295cadce5b2dc4a9: ^8Maxis: ^7Don't worry. I'm not a danger to you - or anyone else.
hash_4acf907909913d6f: ^8Maxis: ^7Don't you have other things to do, Strauss?
hash_53cb9ce6df49e08c: ^8Maxis: ^7I'm not sure that we do. We're both Germans, but I think the similarity ends there.
hash_6b10e03f4ac930c6: ^8Strauss: ^7Oh dear, I'm sorry. Are you... Ashamed of your nationality for some reason?
hash_50964603541b0f12: ^8Maxis: ^7Not ashamed. Not at all. But our nationality isn't what defines us.
hash_55f80de84d45c122: ^8Strauss: ^7My reputation precedes me! I'm flattered. Humbled even.
hash_35ad2865a83b725e: ^8Maxis: ^7I'm not sure you've ever been humbled, Strauss. In fact, I'm not even sure you're that much different from Peck.
hash_2bc0526c90d0ec9c: ^8Strauss: ^7My... Such anger. You don't like him do you? I can't say that I'm surprised. I mean... He did treat you very... badly.
hash_5882e1aa4cfd2c34: ^8Maxis: ^7I don't like repeating myself, but again I have to ask - What do you want?
hash_75aaa9186d8c7152: ^8Grey: ^7Hi Sam. I'm Doctor Elizabeth Grey. I was wondering if you felt well enough for a bit of a chat?
hash_61325493597e3d99: ^8Grey: ^7The only thing we've actually been detect is the change to your eyes. I've never seen anything like it... They're almost 'iridescent'. Do things look different to you?
hash_227dde7b3d59cee2: ^8Maxis: ^7I see things differently, if that's what you mean. Sometimes the light hurts my eyes. Especially if I'm tired.
hash_15f647ecf43c3dc: ^8Maxis: ^7Would you mind... switching the lights off on your way out?
hash_348cd3f5cbbb6e88: ^8Grey: ^7I don't really like being called Liz - that's was my Mum's name. I prefer Elizabeth, if that's okay? Wait. I just realized - Do you prefer Samantha?
hash_238086651067d7c3: ^8Maxis: ^7Samantha. Sam. Maxis. Doesn't really matter to me. What do you want, Doctor Grey?
hash_1b03ab804805b506: ^8Grey: ^7I just wanted to ask you some questions. Truth is - we're all a little bit surprised how well you're doing after your time in... well, you know.
hash_14bcc754bd0b4f29: ^8Maxis: ^7You don't really know how well I'm doing or how long I was there - do you?
hash_4ca973c4bbff9aac: ^8Grey: ^7That was one of the things I wanted to talk about. We do know that time moves differently there... Slower or faster? Not sure - suppose it's all relative, really!
hash_362fa9ff6b6ec7ef: ^8Maxis: ^7I was there a long time. A very long time. So long I thought I'd never get out.
hash_56ef9eca26f9ea: ^8Grey: ^7I'm sorry. I really am, but that's what's so unusual. Normally when people come back - they're more damaged. Physically and emotionally.
hash_52c96deaf2e26da5: ^8Maxis: ^7What makes you think I'm not damaged?
hash_25b08140aa876b89: ^8Weaver: ^7That's not fair Sam. That was a different situation. We both did all we could.
hash_671d563982b92d90: ^8Maxis: ^7But not enough. He's still dead isn't he?
hash_75f9c1adf0c5e163: ^8Weaver: ^7I can see you're agitated, so I'm going to let you get some rest. I hope you feel better soon.
hash_4bd575edc096a943: ^8Maxis: ^7Why? Are you worried I'll destroy everything like you think I did at Outpost 25?!
hash_18e85422bd4f7b7e: ^8Weaver: ^7My colleagues tell me you've not exactly been cooperative, or forthcoming. Instead you've been evasive... Obtuse even.
hash_36e599ce5d7d1248: ^8Weaver: ^7This isn't a joke Sam. I'm worried about you. We all are.
hash_769f560e563223b9: ^8Maxis: ^7After what I've been through - Do you honestly think I'm joking?!
hash_2a35e3a51f1fc14b: ^8Maxis: ^7I thought I'd died and gone to hell. I thought everything and everyone I ever knew was gone forever.
hash_dd0fd68dedd7554: ^8Weaver: ^7You've been to Hell before though, Sam. We both have. I was never going to leave you there to die.
hash_1e9d7aafc52663c8: ^8Maxis: ^7Well, it's good to be part of a team. Right?
hash_1abe53d7233b4601: ^8Maxis: ^7If I'm honest, I've felt like a bit of a lab rat lately. I've been poked, prodded, questioned, even... Interrogated?
hash_11c65f7273879b4e: ^8Maxis: ^7It's almost like they don't trust... me.
hash_68bdcdd87c332507: ^8Maxis: ^7I'm starting to understand how they feel. I'm not sure if I can trust them anymore -- even Weaver.
hash_2370c36fc64b4d2b: ^8Maxis: ^7So - After an extended debriefing with Requiem Senior staff - They don't want to clear me for field ops -
hash_76c20ec05019e172: ^8Maxis: ^7Carver. Strauss. Grey... Weaver. They needed a unanimous vote to authorize my return to active duty.
hash_57700fb91677b215: ^8Maxis: ^7Three out of four isn't bad. But it's not enough.
hash_59365d48c0709fec: ^8Maxis: ^7Anyway - Ravenov. He helped you, right? He helped me.
hash_e2925fa73553737: ^8Maxis: ^7He has conviction - and the courage to stand up for his beliefs. He's doing what's right. He's a good man.
hash_36b086614ed29f3e: ^8Maxis: ^7I hope you've come to trust him like I have. I think he could be key to overturning Omega.
hash_6cb6434fc4f1be71: ^8Maxis: ^7Because there has to be a key to making all this stop.
hash_75d6df1218882b6a: ^8Maxis: ^7I don't know how much they really tell you about the Dark Aether, but... I've seen it. I've felt it.
hash_49315d781e2164e3: ^8Maxis: ^7No matter how big this Cold War is between East and West - Requiem and Omega - there's an even bigger one threatening to boil over.
hash_29d5fb5b68b43ec4: ^8Maxis: ^7We're interested in them - eager to know how we can exploit their world for our advantage...
hash_7f31200c1774ebcd: ^8Maxis: ^7But believe me - they're just as interested in us.
hash_5fcedbccfa99676d: ^8Maxis: ^7What do you think of Liz? Sorry - I mean Elizabeth... Grey. Doctor.
hash_5e7f4c5af0aac2e4: ^8Maxis: ^7I like her. Even though I don't think she's actually... a medical doctor?
hash_7ddbae77a6199c03: ^8Maxis: ^7How are you feeling, by the way? Are you seeing any 'signs'? I'm not the only one who's been exposed to the Dark Aether here.
hash_1f1c5504833e10a: ^8Maxis: ^7I'm the same person now as the one that you dealt with, but I think that I've changed.
hash_1c0d223adac73069: ^8Maxis: ^7I try not to show it, but... you can probably see it in my eyes.
hash_6fa88ebe803d7550: ^8Maxis: ^7I can see it in yours too.
hash_21376a10ecbe2d1c: ^8Maxis: ^7Sometimes, it's hard to remember how all this started. Do you feel the same?
hash_7492b876f258c805: ^8Maxis: ^7We're all soldiers. We're all fighting our wars - For our countries, for our brothers, for our sisters.
hash_4241b13ebdabef22: ^8Maxis: ^7When you're faced with a seemingly insurmountable threat, it's easy to forget how it all began, or to imagine how it all ends.
hash_1885729f65b75c9b: ^8Maxis: ^7The Dark Aether threatens to consume us all - That much I'm sure of - and that's why I fight.
hash_33af7dab4795bfa8: ^8Maxis: ^7It holds a power over us, and I think I'm afraid that it could one day consume me.
hash_740ec114d5e2061: ^8Maxis: ^7I've seen it, I've felt it, I've questioned my role.
hash_7e48f7ac9daa75ae: ^8Maxis: ^7Did Weaver tell you that I was the one who caused the outbreak at Outpost 25?
hash_50eed0cf13c0ace7: ^8Maxis: ^7Even if he didn't say it out loud...
hash_48b3a10fbc0b7a7f: ^8Maxis: ^7No matter what happens, I hope all of you will find the strength in your hearts to do what is right.
hash_46ae006a961a21a6: ^8Maxis: ^7Whenever you are faced with a great darkness, you must do all you can to meet it with... light.
hash_253b1dbfe7b6a8e0: ^8Maxis: ^7He knew he could no longer stand by as Omega's evil reigned.
hash_3533db08b78a925a: ^8Maxis: ^7I hope I can do the same.
hash_370ed087ddf6bfba: ^9Kravchenko: ^7Kravchenko. 21st of April, 1983. Three weeks since I accepted command of Spetsgruppa Omega. And I am beginning to wonder if Comrade Andropov was out of his mind when he created this spook show.
hash_43aa822256dc8823: ^9Kravchenko: ^7My first order of business was a thorough review of Omega Group activities since their formation in '75. What a fucking joke. The study of "psychotronic phenomena"? What does that even mean?
hash_8bfa32a412f0d3c: ^9Kravchenko: ^7Biocommunication, bioenergetics, bioinformation... Words invented by paper-pushers to make ghost stories sound real. I read hundreds of their bullshit reports and found nothing useful. So I reassigned the authors to dig biolatrines.
hash_49aa64420ac1392d: ^9Kravchenko: ^7But if...IF Andropov was not out of his mind. IF he saw some genuine operational value in any of this nonsense...
hash_749ebf38711539a6: ^9Kravchenko: ^7I will give this one more month. And then I will pull the plug.
hash_793a7b82553d2bb1: ^9Kravchenko: ^715th of July, 1983. Comrade Valentina, I am recording this meeting for my records.
hash_448d7547c66da332: ^9Valentina: ^7Of course, Colonel. I take it you have viewed the Projekt Endstation footage?
hash_36bda9e63098aae7: ^9Kravchenko: ^7Da. Where did you find this film?
hash_1ac07ef33d3d52d4: ^9Valentina: ^7Gathering dust in a restricted portion of Lubyanka sub-basement records storage. Someone went to great lengths to bury the incident back in '45. But times have changed since then.
hash_3f0cf055775bc6f5: ^9Kravchenko: ^7Indeed. That cowboy actor and his Strategic Defense Initiative have upset the stalemate between us and the West. I asked for something to tip the scales back in our favor. You think this is it?
hash_207d9129681fb06e: ^9Valentina: ^7There is only one way to find out. Allow me to reactivate the Endstation cyclotron. If I can harness their access to another dimension, we can give the Motherland a tactical advantage the Americans can only dream of.
hash_754630da810a1c60: ^9Valentina: ^7Then bury the bunker in concrete and declare the place off-limits.
hash_1ba8236ed65c3c8b: ^9Valentina: ^7And maybe leave flowers every year to remember my sacrifice.
hash_21d286ad9c665bb8: ^9Kravchenko: ^7I don't care about sacrifice. Only results. I will authorize your mission, but you had better bring back something I can use.
hash_695d5b6205e21616: ^9Kravchenko: ^7Shut up, you little worm. You are lucky to be alive.
