hash_2af4a35a79dd14ec: ^9Kravchenko: ^7Silence. This is not a dialogue. You are here to receive your orders. There is a plane standing by to take you to the Ural Mountains Outbreak Zone.
hash_10db06aebd4d45dd: ^9Kravchenko: ^7You will oversee a special operation there involving a particularly rich deposit of Aetherium crystals. My people will brief you once you are airborne.
hash_5c9f44a267e4decd: ^9Peck: ^7You won't regret this, sir! And, um, please let Gorev know I'm off the hook? I'm worried he still wants to kill me.
hash_37e8ed18cfd40953: ^9Kravchenko: ^7Gorev will be there with you. Shadowing your every step. Because you are not "off the hook," Dr. Peck. Do not fail me...ever again.
hash_7f223e0c352dd997: ^9Kravchenko: ^7Gorev. Before you depart for the Urals, I need a word with you.
hash_4107e3130a6d9ea1: ^9Kravchenko: ^7No. It is the same matter that has vexed me ever since Requiem's arrival at Endstation. Whoever leaked Omega intelligence to them remains unidentified. If they did not die at Outpost 25, the traitor may still be among us.
hash_7b71f0142f5eb8: ^9Gorev: ^7I am working on it night and day, sir. My apologies that it has taken this long.
hash_55ad67b278680adb: ^9Kravchenko: ^7We could have found out the informant's name back in Vietnam, but that idiot American tossed the only person who knew into the Dark Aether. What kind of genius throws away his trump card?
hash_37a3cc7cdb8bd74e: ^9Gorev: ^7Peck may be book-smart, but he has no common sense... and even less self-control. But I swear to you, Colonel, the informant will be exposed.
hash_48d8d5e8faca9c39: ^9Gorev: ^7The only question is if I will be able to bring them in alive. If I find myself left with no options...
hash_a0d60638f44f294: ^9Kravchenko: ^7Do what you must, Gorev. They deserve to die slowly. As long as the leak is plugged, I will be satisfied.
hash_34c702d6581d9ab9: ^9Peck: ^7William Peck, personal notes. Arrived in the Ural Mountains Outbreak Zone three days ago. It was a little hard to believe the briefing I was given on the flight here, but now that I see it for myself...
hash_79a253c66a73207c: ^9Peck: ^7To paraphrase Archimedes, "holy shit." This is even better than I hoped for. The breach opening right on top of an installation like this may have given me the key to making an Inversion Warhead actually work.
hash_2810a50bad54757f: ^9Peck: ^7I'm a fuckin genius. I already knew of the catalyzing effect Aetherium has on Plutonium. That was how I got my portal chamber to work at Outpost 25. But the readings I'm getting from the crystals here...! We've never seen Aetherium this pure "in the wild," so to speak.
hash_3b0fe2e594552432: ^9Peck: ^7You up there! Be careful! That's not something you want to bang too hard, understand?
hash_39bb5c7c2425dd1d: ^9Peck: ^7Yeah. They understand. These boys look scared out of their wits. Just wait till they hear the next item on my "shopping list." We're going to need some special helpers to make this work -- and rounding them up will not be easy.
hash_5f2a6c9901059557: ^9Valentina: ^7I just returned from the Kremlin where I presented the list of proposed targets for Operatsiya Inversiya to the General Secretary and select members of the Committee for State Security. The results were...mixed.
hash_54d8db251feef456: ^9Valentina: ^7I should be pleased that the overall plan was so well received. Perhaps they realize that without bold action the Soviet Union could collapse within a decade.
hash_43c36188986a49e9: ^9Valentina: ^7And Inversiya is nothing if not bold. It would be a deathblow to the West. Which may account for the committee's preference of two particular targets.
hash_11368897b669aae8: ^9Valentina: ^7But I pushed hard for Berlin. It would have afforded me further opportunities to complete my preparations there.
hash_2f248b34ac37af2b: ^9Valentina: ^7The Colonel did question my fixation on Berlin, but I just told him I hate the Germans. That is always enough of an excuse for veterans of the Great Patriotic War like Kravchenko.
hash_7ed8387640dac4db: ^9Peck: ^7William Peck, supplemental notes. Well, it took a week and cost the lives of some brave young men, but we finally did it: we caught four of those floaty blue bastards alive.
hash_58cc64fd7e9f45e: ^9Peck: ^7Okay, sure, by "we" I mean the highly trained operators in Omega Group. I'm not exactly the field ops type. But they could never have locked down those lightning bugs without the gear I built for them. I mean, have you ever tried to cage something that can teleport?
hash_5caa5bc39c37b8e5: ^9Peck: ^7One big help in this whole process is how attracted the blue guys are to the crystals -- the big ones. The atmosphere converters. And the purer the crystal, the more irresistible. I think that was the first tip-off that I could co-opt the way they metabolize Aetherium for my own purposes.
hash_5030a629e540ddf8: ^9Peck: ^7Yeah, yeah, Sparky, I know it hurts, but you gotta take one for the team. We all serve a greater good now. And I promise if Operatsiya Inversiya stays on schedule, you won't be suffering for long.
hash_748d703dd1ce8455: ^8Strauss: ^7The Aetherium harvesting unit. To the layman, it's not terribly impressive. Just a metal box with a canister in it, quietly sitting there, sucking in airborne Aetherium particles.
hash_46879da9327d0244: ^8Strauss: ^7But there is a reason my science teams risk their lives to place these units across the Zone. With Aetherium concentrations greater in the Ural Mountains than anywhere else on Earth, these harvesting units are absolutely vital in our race against the Soviets to harness the power of the Dark Aether.
hash_6f7ede01019b3537: ^8Strauss: ^7Once filled, each canister must be collected for rocket-transport to international waters. We considered other modes of travel, but rockets really are the quickest, cleanest way to get the samples out of the Outbreak Zone.
hash_518fcdb04106d966: ^8Strauss: ^7Which is not to say retrieving these canisters is easy. They are heavy, cumbersome things, and once disengaged from the harvesting unit there is a limited amount of time to get them to the rocket before the samples degrade.
hash_36f76c1a68943691: ^8Strauss: ^7They also draw hostiles like flies to honey, I have lost more than a few people on collection duty. I have therefore requested that Field Ops strike teams support all future canister retrieval efforts.
hash_4a62b631565b7af5: ^8Grey: ^7This is Dr. Elizabeth Grey with a few thoughts on the new Specimen Analyzer stations. We're using them to run field tests on undead anatomy -- specifically, genetic mutations and structural changes in the cerebral cortex.
hash_28de5e9f14177dcc: ^8Grey: ^7It's a rather grisly affair, severing some poor, infected bloke's head and putting it in a jar for a proper soft tissue mapping and DNA sequencing. But if we can identify the root stimuli and catalysts for all these physical transformations, we'll be one step closer to preventing them.
hash_92d9a665aeb3727: ^8Grey: ^7Unfortunately, those heads aren't quite deceased, and they seem to call out to other infected in the area. I say this because the creatures always come running whenever we perform a scan.
hash_2a83233e2a178da6: ^8Grey: ^7Not quite sure if they're trying to rescue their fellow dead-head, or if it's more like sharks sensing an injured fish, but I'm working on a way to insulate the unit so the sample's distress won't draw unwanted attention.
hash_32234795816248c1: ^8Grey: ^7Until then, my Unnatural Sciences teams may require some rather robust protection to operate the Dark Aether Specimen Analyzer.
hash_3b7d910dedfdd897: ^8Carver: ^7Our strike team has taken down a lot of different hostiles -- some bigger and badder than others. Every encounter is a risk to life and limb. But as far as my Containment and Security division is concerned, we learn the most from their engagements with apex-level threats. The Dark Aether's "high-value targets" for lack of a better term.
hash_1231d8eae40c065e: ^8Carver: ^7So we've come up with a way to guarantee they'll be tangling with an HVT. It's an energy cannon platform parked in geosynchronous orbit over the Ural Mountains. When an uplink station is activated, the satellite fires a dimensional disruptor beam that literally pulls an HVT out of the Dark Aether into the AO.
hash_7105f8b082ebe09d: ^8Carver: ^7Strauss gave me a bit of grief when I suggested we call them HVTs. He still sees this enemy as a disorganized mob. But I see a hierarchy at work, and the top dogs are calling the shots.
hash_70b4ab4ed19ffbc4: ^8Carver: ^7Of course, I may be reading too much into it. But even if these apex threats are as brain-dead as their foot soldiers, the more of them we kill the better.
hash_5bf62b1959cd0da8: ^8Strauss: ^7Energy Research voice memo to Requiem strike team from Dr. Oskar Strauss. Subject: the proper care and feeding of Essence Conversion Modules.
hash_7dbda62fe65bcb89: ^8Strauss: ^7First, the modules are currently in orbit. You must call them down with the launch control station we've already placed in the Outbreak Zone. Trust me, it's simple enough that even someone like you can use it.
hash_4541d8e1987c3dba: ^8Strauss: ^7Once they land, the modules will absorb the "essence" of any infected you kill nearby. All you have to do is, well... what you do best.
hash_7534e2bff7cb170b: ^8Strauss: ^7When they have reached full charge, that is when things get interesting. The unit's internal lab exposes the essence to refined Aetherium crystals.
hash_3d9bd0747c5398fc: ^8Strauss: ^7This establishes a connection with the objects in the Dark Aether dimension, through a process called quantum entanglement.
hash_40a6c1fd19d80bad: ^8Strauss: ^7In layman's terms, the essence you collect is transformed into a Dark Aether object. It's our way of examining the contents of our parallel reality without requiring you to go there. You're welcome. Now get to work.
hash_40cd204565b02c0e: ^8Grey: ^7The recon rover. Ugh. This is a tough one for me. I mean, yes, I recognize the absolute need to send monkeys into the Dark Aether. It's the only way to record that dimension's effects on their physiology. And it's certainly a lot less risky than sending my people, but...*sigh* I really do need to stop naming those monkeys.
hash_20ccc82e03ad68cf: ^8Grey: ^7Anyhow, here's how it works: we leave a Dark Aether Recon Rover parked in an area where we've recorded instability in the dimensional membrane.
hash_64d640b01656714: ^8Grey: ^7Our strike team activates the rover, and then do their best to keep the nasties off until it can successfully enter a rift and start sending back telemetry.
hash_63db976c4d1759d: ^8Grey: ^7The data we're getting is remarkable. I'm starting to understand how Aetherium transmutes living organisms on a cellular level. We've even recorded the specific moment when the subject starts metabolizing Aetherium to continue functioning post-mortem.
hash_1866ecaa6d3654da: ^8Grey: ^7It's just... difficult reviewing the data. They scream once they cross over. A lot. And then they go quiet. And then they start to laugh...
hash_565e39b520b7b252: ^8Carver: ^7We've identified certain Aetherium crystal structures in the Outbreak Zone that the labcoats are calling "power nodes." They're the biggest crystals out there -- almost beautiful in their own way. But if what the experts are telling me is true, they're scary as hell.
hash_5b01c849f117557b: ^8Carver: ^7My people have determined these power nodes are here to fundamentally alter the environment. It's a process they call "terraforming." Basically, they're slowly transforming the air and the ground around them to make it more hospitable to the creatures crossing over from the Dark Aether.
hash_345feae5f274b4a8: ^8Carver: ^7They do this by continually releasing Aetherium in its gaseous form. And we know that the only thing keeping those monsters inside the outbreak Zones is their proximity to an Aetherium source. They wander too far away and they drop dead.
hash_10f62fec86607c61: ^8Carver: ^7We've recorded all of this on our instruments, but you don't need any equipment to know how powerful one of those crystals is. All you have to do is get up close to a power node and it feels like...I don't know...like the 'shrooms are kickin' in. Yeah, I said it. I saw some shit in 'Nam. But nothing that messed with your head as bad as this.
hash_3dcca45dd767fa9e: ^8Carver: ^7So I've made it a priority for our strike team to blow them up whenever they find one. No fucking way we're gonna just let these things turn Earth into their favorite vacation spot.
hash_6adc419326c01e42: ^8Weaver: ^7Strike team, I want to thank you on behalf of everyone here for what you accomplished in Vietnam. The intel you recovered from Omega Group is already paying off in new technology and weapons.
hash_2b8b1efe7da5d79b: ^8Weaver: ^7This is especially important as we launch operations in the Ural Mountains. The AO you've entered is richer in Aetherium than anywhere else on the planet.
hash_86cb3e7600b7790: ^8Weaver: ^7But Omega is already hard at work there. Never forget we are in a race against time to harness the Dark Aether before they do.
hash_338c73cfdfd48401: ^8Weaver: ^7The winner of this Aetherium arms race may well be decided by your actions here. So... we can't fuck this up. Weaver out.
hash_61496be71928d595: ^8Weaver: ^7Just want to be clear on what's expected from you. Every department at Requiem has a stake in this.
hash_7f1934c7dd72ea4: ^8Weaver: ^7Energy Research. Unnatural Sciences. Security and Containment. They all have special equipment in the field that we need you to test.
hash_4f6935593b4a19ef: ^8Weaver: ^7Strauss, Grey and Carver will give you the details at the appropriate time, and I expect you to follow their instructions to the letter.
hash_65ae9c3dc407a516: ^8Weaver: ^7Remember: these experiments and operations aren't busy-work. They're important. They're how we eventually win.
hash_33fe0838b98cd2ec: ^8Weaver: ^7Some of you have asked -- repeatedly -- about Agent Maxis. I get it. You risked your life to save her, then weeks went by with no word on her condition. I get it.
hash_5e43c821389c3b9d: ^8Weaver: ^7Well, I'm finally authorized to let you know she's recovering. At least, physically.
hash_40478560562b9c5e: ^8Weaver: ^7She's been under observation in an isolation ward, getting the best care the Agency can provide, but... she went through things in the Dark Aether that would have broken most people. It's a miracle she survived.
hash_21c5c3d760b9ead7: ^8Weaver: ^7She's not infected, she's on the mend, and...everything you went through to bring her back? Absolutely worth it.
hash_4126f7abc43a7a38: ^<Stranger: ^7Hello? Are you receiving? Is anybody out there? Testing... testing...
hash_7099b0b70f156a69: ^<Stranger: ^7My readings indicate contact is established. I can only hope it is you on the other end -- my comrade in arms. My friend.
hash_4847fe7fb40a27b2: ^<Stranger: ^7I hope my voice is not a disappointment. I do not know what you imagined I might sound like, but I am no one special. Just a man who wants to help.
hash_139838087b55a52b: ^<Stranger: ^7Yes, as you can tell from my accent, I am Russian. I did not tell you this at first because of the suspicion it would have provoked. Such is the age you grew up in. Such is this "Cold War."
hash_292296055cffab5c: ^<Stranger: ^7But there was a time when my people and yours fought side by side against the greatest evil our world ever produced. Now we face something even worse. Perhaps that can bring us all back together.
hash_2daf9ce9db9784dd: ^<Stranger: ^7Pizdets -- the signal is starting to fade. I will work on this problem and contact you later. Do not give up on me. I will not give up on you.
hash_1ea23c713bc90397: ^<Stranger: ^7Hello, it is me again. Your friend on the other side. Are you enjoying the beautiful Ural Mountains? No...? Believe me, I understand. It is hard to love a place that is always trying to kill you.
hash_3fe052e42a38390e: ^<Stranger: ^7By now you have probably met some new enemies. The electric men that float in mid-air. The armored monsters that leap and throw fire. I do my best to steer clear of them here, but avoiding conflict is not a luxury you can afford.
hash_7948bd7607cbb0f5: ^<Stranger: ^7I have managed to kill a few of the floaters, but it is never easy. The cowards jump away when injured, and they can strike from afar.
hash_5b68739299f72a54: ^<Stranger: ^7The armored ones, on the other hand... They jump at you when provoked. They were once Soviet fighters who came here looking for crystals and paid with their lives.
hash_2a13fdeb4ff3d6e3: ^<Stranger: ^7They are vicious and hard to put down. Hit them with everything you have. Such beasts must not be allowed to walk the Earth.
hash_32c055edf3b585f9: ^<Requiem Soldier: ^7And if anyone finds this... *wheeze*...get some payback for us would ya?
hash_6a570993fa4404c1: ^<Requiem Soldier: ^7We are under attack! Can't hold out...send reinforcements right away!
hash_54aa098a067d9325: ^<Requiem Soldier: ^7Damned hostiles hunted us down! Picked us off. Careful -- they work as...a team of hunters.
hash_72e895adfae7702d: ^<Requiem Soldier: ^7A whole pack of them...*cough*... ambushed us. Not gonna...make it out alive.
hash_5f9b4047b35e9fb1: ^<Requiem Soldier: ^7An enemy horde...tracked us...tricked us. Make 'em pay, Requiem... *screams* *more screams*
hash_5176c96c1d59bd79: ^<Requiem Soldier: ^7Bastards are smarter than we thought! Closing in...we're not gonna make it to exfil.
hash_27a7b05a74f08e55: ^<Requiem Soldier: ^7We really need backup...if we don't make it, you fucking avenge us and kill them!
hash_48d303fc2eb23ddd: ^<Requiem Soldier: ^7I'm injured *pain grunt* mission's gone to shit... Someone's gotta stop 'em from killing.
hash_e3fa3358c074f99: ^<Requiem Soldier: ^7And then they got my sergeant... boxed us in... *grunt* Get them back for us.
hash_1b4883cf9125a8ab: ^<Requiem Soldier: ^7Warning you: they hunt as a pack...got the drop on us...here they come again!

hash_2a155c727059c5e5: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Reagan: ^7^Fmaxima_med^My God. How many Greenlight nukes did he detonate?
hash_3ad3b6855c0ef177: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Reagan: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Does anyone know the bombs were ours?
hash_2932bb78e205be1f: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Black: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Materials related to Operation Greenlight were anonymously released an hour ago, presumably by Perseus. Calls are beginning to come in from across the globe.
hash_77c0ae3c8762e3d9: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Black: ^7^Fmaxima_med^You and Vice President Bush are to be moved to secure locations immediately.
hash_357ecbb561770093: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Reagan: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I want any business related to this thing erased forever. Everything. Can you make that happen?
hash_6768a66bd77d50e2: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Woods: ^7^Fmaxima_med^You knew the nuke was from Greenlight and didn't tell us! What else are you hiding? Maybe I can knock the truth out of you.
hash_17b42a8a287ab0c3: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Hudson: ^7^Fmaxima_med^You might want to rethink that, Woods.
hash_48440b3adf1ee9e3: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^This little pissing match isn't gonna help us catch Perseus.
hash_3ec067ace24f4f34: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Mason: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Why didn't you tell us it was an American nuke?
hash_5767f86eb01ff7df: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Woods: ^7^Fmaxima_med^He needed us to clean up his mess. The bastard's been lying to us all along.
hash_765d3ff6b73ac6f8: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Hudson: ^7^Fmaxima_med^It's not a lie. It's an omission of fact.
hash_1b82f39c9726a2b: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Mason: ^7^Fmaxima_med^That's what you do best, isn't it, Hudson? Manipulate people... tell them your own version of the truth.
hash_70b21a8b00925013: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Hudson: ^7^Fmaxima_med^There is no truth, only who you choose to believe. Adler knows all about that. Don't you, Russ?
hash_7ca7baeb089ab354: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Operation Greenlight. What is it? Tell us everything.
hash_4d38ec230248b0fd: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Hudson: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Back in '58 the arms race was in full swing.
hash_5379b4b74dc38620: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Hudson: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Eisenhower was convinced that if the Reds moved on Europe, we couldn't respond quick enough.
hash_4e93a45ebec8ea6f: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Hudson: ^7^Fmaxima_med^So he authorized Operation Greenlight: a top secret program that placed nuclear bombs in every major European city. The ultimate countermeasure to a Soviet invasion.
hash_657eff491580470a: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Hudson: ^7^Fmaxima_med^In '74 the bombs were upgraded to high yield neutron bombs, capable of terminating personnel without damaging infrastructure.
hash_62582267860be04d: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Woods: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Thousands dying in a flash and you're talking about fucking infrastructure.
hash_4c66a92a268b68fe: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Mason: ^7^Fmaxima_med^How's that for civilized? We kill the people but preserve the buildings.
hash_126c819001e66efb: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Hudson: ^7^Fmaxima_med^We're trying to preserve our way of life.
hash_27442d213854952c: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^How long have you known about the missing nuke?
hash_f63715e3e24a39a: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Hudson: ^7^Fmaxima_med^One of the Greenlight nukes went offline eight weeks ago. We suspected it was Perseus but couldn't confirm it until we saw the photos you brought back from East Berlin.
hash_27fadf050e79c13d: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^So, there's an American-made nuke in the wild and once Perseus detonates it... the United States becomes global enemy number one.
hash_3675696640a3ad1c: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Hudson: ^7^Fmaxima_med^We wouldn't have this problem if you'd done your job and killed Perseus in Vietnam.
hash_78889e88e693c803: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Careful, Hudson. Next time I might not stop Woods.
hash_3ffbecfc3811ba87: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Hudson: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Perseus. The CIA's analysts consider him to be the single largest threat to the Free World.
hash_79bfd74b4d1c8a7c: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Reagan: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Protecting our very way of life from a great evil.
hash_7804f0876fae8bcb: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Perseus: ^7^Fmaxima_med^The United States and its allies slowly consume that which is dear to us.
hash_11016f454713f7eb: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Hudson: ^7^Fmaxima_med^We are hours away from Perseus detonating nuclear bombs in every major European city.
hash_632c72a561f5928f: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Some of us will cross the line, to make sure the line's still there in the morning.
hash_29a8999cc1c61310: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^No one's gonna brand us heroes or villains.
hash_3e9bd8f9d0befae7: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^As for me... I've been chasing this ghost for thirteen years.
hash_3e7d08acc869953f: With no strong leads to go on, the team planned to revisit a thirteen year old Vietnam mission to uncover any overlooked clues.
hash_558efc2863ec8865: The encrypted Perseus intel that Bell recovered in Vietnam contains a present day name worth investigating.
hash_64b8af500a1ead54: After the disaster in Cuba, Russell Adler decides there is only one option left on the table.
hash_6008c9206fde9fcd: After tracking the movements of one of the sleeper agents, the team discovers a trail to Cuba.
hash_b9e3f6644956447: After subjecting Bell to a dangerous interrogation, Russell Adler reveals the truth about Bell's past.
hash_447bb87b07547b5b: Having learned what Perseus wanted at Yamantau, Russell Adler planned to take Bell into the Lubyanka Building to acquire the identities of the sleeper agents.
hash_64116a84a818cf28: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Black: ^7^Fmaxima_med^How long until we have a lead on Perseus?
hash_283ebbc5938949a0: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Hudson: ^7^Fmaxima_med^They're about to get started. Adler's in West Berlin. He should be at the safehouse soon.
hash_3a4406575b460a8a: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Hudson: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Ha. I'm not the one you should be asking, Black.
hash_6731889e47ac327b: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Hudson: ^7^Fmaxima_med^It's a strong group. He chased down Sims, Azoulay, even pulled some strings to get Helen Park from MI6. We'll get them Mason and Woods soon.
hash_2781210712969710: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Hudson: ^7^Fmaxima_med^She and Adler have that business from before. Of course he wants her there.
hash_61134231c89c232e: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Hudson: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Bell? Don't get me started. That's the one we need to keep our eyes on.
hash_5b0fb9edb65d0226: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Hudson: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Well, to hear it from Adler, it's working. Bell remembered finding that encrypted intel in Vietnam and is almost finished decoding it.
hash_274f4856ed4adc14: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Hudson: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Some names apparently. Possible leads. Park is trying to connect the dots.
hash_2c16989fb1cd84be: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Black: ^7^Fmaxima_med^We don't have much time. Does the team know about our mishap in Berlin yet?
hash_592ec694ac4f6872: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Hudson: ^7^Fmaxima_med^No. But if it's connected to one of those names from Bell, they'll find out soon enough.
hash_ad1b0e487c57c88: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Black: ^7^Fmaxima_med^You won't let that happen, Hudson. Don't say anything more than necessary.
hash_256e34fde33d0c00: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Hudson: ^7^Fmaxima_med^That's never been a problem for me.
hash_628c20de56043740: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Black: ^7^Fmaxima_med^We've finished analyzing that mainframe that Mason and Woods brought from Yamantau.
hash_51055fc7c3c32e: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Black: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Perseus was looking for the names of sleeper agents Dragovich used in '68.
hash_52d1d5913c807dc2: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Hudson: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Give us those names. We'll get Adler's team to track them down.
hash_7dce957bf248d082: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Black: ^7^Fmaxima_med^There's only one place you're going to find that information now. The Lubyanka building.
hash_71651b4584fe76e: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Hudson: ^7^Fmaxima_med^What, KGB Headquarters? Why didn't Perseus get them there himself?
hash_12b5c0882b882291: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Black: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I don't know. Maybe he's operating without authorization.
hash_68104187e3918ac5: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Hudson: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I'll let Adler know. But we're gonna do this the right way, or we're not gonna do it at all.
hash_3e4c8268717797c2: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Black: ^7^Fmaxima_med^They caused a hell of a mess in Moscow. Was it worth it?
hash_47800bd23a5665ae: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Hudson: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Adler managed to get the list of sleeper agent names, despite himself. He's got balls, I'll give him that.
hash_3bfa7c4e89431cfc: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Hudson: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Seemingly. But I think that team is getting too comfortable. They're acting like they know who they're dealing with.
hash_6fc01985315c6dfa: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Hudson: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Turns out one of those sleeper agents is tied to Operation Greenlight. Theodore Hastings. He's a nuclear engineer based out of Salt Lake City.
hash_4feb0dcfc014d280: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Black: ^7^Fmaxima_med^And you believe Hastings is the one he'll activate?
hash_318f10a56ebaccf8: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Hudson: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Exactly. Total surveillance is already underway. It's only a matter of time before he leads us straight to Perseus.
hash_70c5d7e1d7823179: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Hudson: ^7^Fmaxima_med^You go in with the intel you have, not the intel you want. We paid the fucking piper down there.
hash_8528179b23e1f43: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Hudson: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I don't know whose fault it is. I just know that Perseus doesn't have a single fucking nuke, he's got dozens.
hash_2455abfd59e7ff3: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Black: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Millions of people are going to die, and the United States will take the blame. You need to find out where he's planning to broadcast the activation signal.
hash_147442307f3f3ded: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Hudson: ^7^Fmaxima_med^How are we gonna pull that out of our ass?
hash_389a8688ca04eec7: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Hudson: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Bell? This goddamn science project was a failure!
hash_4a17a114d3d0208f: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Black: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Don't count Adler out yet. The man has a deep bag of tricks.
hash_5253871e0c8d5a73: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Perseus: ^7^Fmaxima_med^We will watch the empire of the United States collapse under its own weight.
hash_1cb2b600952640be: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Perseus: ^7^Fmaxima_med^A world with two superpowers will become a world with one.
hash_2c0d7e113fc9454: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Perseus: ^7^Fmaxima_med^And if the leaders of this new world order squander the opportunity we have provided them... then they too will be replaced.
hash_2bce831ca166ac6: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Over here! We've got a live one!
hash_7cf1232539be58a4: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Over here! We've got a live one.
hash_6abdfd5b943341f7: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I've got to admit I'm surprised. I didn't think they'd recover so fast.
hash_5cb4f4bd3e34dd7a: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^We tried everything. Normal forms of interrogation weren't working.
hash_5b0e1de790beabfe: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Park: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Breaking a subject's will and erasing their mind is a difficult and painful process.
hash_67a6ce725b43f3f0: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Park: ^7^Fmaxima_med^The CIA's mind control program has had a great deal of success with implanted memories.
hash_786ebb8fff0f0bf9: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^You want me to tell them about my time in Vietnam?
hash_11cf2ec0694592b9: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Park: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Lastly, you'll need a command phrase to trigger the implanted memories.
hash_c22718c86b0d5f6: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^You had to reach the Soviet bunker.
hash_c28d6f3be30e740: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Park: ^7^Fmaxima_med^It appears the subject's programming is beginning to take hold.
hash_29394cca2df49920: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^We've known each other for years. Fought together, bled together. Been through the hell of Vietnam together.
hash_38cfb0f695eed751: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Park: ^7^Fmaxima_med^And now the training's complete. We just need to give the subject a name.
hash_35153d61f0ac6805: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Perseus: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Once we control the Greenlight arsenal, we will detonate them all from the safety of Solovetsky.
hash_c55ced045d20144: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Bell, come on, we've got a job to do.
hash_435c79c50d00ca8c: The Berlin-based Russian mobster, Anton Volkov, was linked to Perseus. It's kill or capture.
hash_7a87087090e0b818: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Volkov heads the Russian mob that moved into East Berlin once the wall went up in '61.
hash_2fe59fed03e03397: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Lazar: ^7^Fmaxima_med^This guy has connections to cartels throughout Europe and the Americas.
hash_312442b1eda5ffae: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Neutralizing him will not only hurt Perseus, but the global syndicate.
hash_40f35dc162d8088c: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Park: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Franz Kraus. According to MI6, he's one of Volkov's information couriers. He has a drop with Volkov scheduled for tomorrow night.
hash_2c6a90ae86f5782: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^We'll infiltrate East Berlin via the U-Bahn. A ghost station on the other side of the wall has the access point we need. From there we'll watch Kraus as he enters the city. Once Volkov shows his face it's kill or capture.
hash_7a3da42c21eee19d: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Black: ^7^Fmaxima_med^They did it, Mr. President. They stopped the nukes.
hash_a3157bbc9f69124: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Black: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Nothing yet. We're seeing signs of confusion. It's possible this was all a rogue operation. Perseus may not have been following orders from Moscow.
hash_f3781a1628a9953: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Reagan: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Maybe we have something in common after all.
hash_65dbf1400d1a4eb0: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Hudson: ^7^Fmaxima_med^1943. Detailed information from the Manhattan Project was stolen from Los Alamos by the Russian spy known as Perseus.
hash_245971010795d63: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Hudson: ^7^Fmaxima_med^1968. The Vietnam War. Viet Cong soldiers orchestrated by Perseus attempted to steal an American-made nuclear bomb from a U.S. firebase.
hash_76e0a7a96ad6bf4e: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Hudson: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Five days ago while on a mission, we acquired intel that Perseus is in play once again and planning an attack on the West.
hash_134758398e083e19: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Hudson: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Perseus. The CIA's analysts consider him to be the single largest threat to the Free World.
hash_1a91b9644b8e9106: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Haig: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Mr. Hudson, we're all aware of Perseus. We're also aware he's more myth than fact. I mean, personally I think he's nothing more than the Russian bogeyman.
hash_7b3e93eef4defff: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Hudson: ^7^Fmaxima_med^General Haig, allow me to introduce the man best suited to respond to that: CIA Clandestine Special Officer Russell Adler. He's one of the few people to even come close to capturing Perseus.
hash_4da5aa90e9c421ab: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Baker: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Mr. Adler, why should we take this "Perseus" threat seriously?
hash_5ec7ff1e4b085180: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Woods: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Yeah, but then a lot of innocent people are gonna die.
hash_5cb5bcaec3c54ec5: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Sir, every time Perseus has come into play it's shifted the balance of the Cold War. After thirteen years of silence, if he's active, something big is gonna happen... something that will affect the Free World.
hash_30998e509712733f: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Haig: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Mr. President, this is Jason Hudson and Russell Adler-
hash_55d1e0ffd65d0d47: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Reagan: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I know their names. Who do you think approved their last mission?
hash_247a2c141306234f: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^We can, sir. I've already submitted the requisition for my team.
hash_1f5927f4e90a149a: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Haig: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Sir, their requests are highly irregular, most likely illegal. If the press gets a hold-
hash_7533e47f816af86d: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Mason: ^7^Fmaxima_med^What the hell are you talking about?
hash_1b73386b6d935685: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Woods: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Every mission we go on is illegal.
hash_ef45c17de232bee: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Haig: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Sergeant Woods, plausible deniability is the backbone of our work.
hash_377161351bd07b8a: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Reagan: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Al, we're talking about preventing an attack on the free men and women of the world. Give Mr. Adler whatever he wants.
hash_15bc51343e9a93: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Reagan: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Gentlemen, you've been given an important task: protecting our very way of life from a great evil. There is no higher duty, there is no higher honor. And while few people will know of your struggles, rest assured the entire Free World will benefit.
hash_5fd4e3202141c03a: In 1968, the CIA orders Russell Adler's SOG team to secure a valuable asset hidden in a Da Nang firebase.
hash_116216d16954af6: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Alright Bell, we're going back to Vietnam. First time Perseus pinged our radar.
hash_4057ffcb24e728ed: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^It was late January, '68. We were a joint CIA SOG taskforce, embedded within the 3rd Marine Regiment near Da Nang. SOG was there to sniff out Soviet activity. Word had it Russian operatives were active in the region.
hash_3d2c1f3999211bab: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Park: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Perseus had no known presence in Vietnam.
hash_7f05d3efbce2167: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^That changed at Da Nang. Somehow Perseus knew about Operation Fracture Jaw.
hash_51355eabf3ac44e5: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Sims: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Fracture Jaw? That one sure went sideways.
hash_2903418cb8a6c938: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Park: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Good, we want those memories. No detail's too small, a face, a name. We're looking for anything that can lead us to Perseus.
hash_2e7ca283c8e54751: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Sims: ^7^Fmaxima_med^This feels like looking for a needle in a haystack....
hash_1bfce6d75f3a6f5a: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Remember... we had a job to do.
hash_f042a7129a53754: Bell searches for a mysterious bunker deep in the jungles of Vietnam.
hash_79965442553cdb5b: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Park: ^7^Fmaxima_med^The CIA's mind control program has had a great deal of success with implanted memories.
hash_6a6104c7156b717a: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Park: ^7^Fmaxima_med^You'll have to establish trust- by building up a shared history with the subject.
hash_248d2b39b260c4e4: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Park: ^7^Fmaxima_med^It appears the subject's programming is beginning to take hold.
hash_2f96cedf8b2fef5a: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Been through the hell of Vietnam together.
hash_7bbb39e72f2f08ac: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Think, Bell. Perseus. Do you remember coming face-to-face with Perseus in Vietnam?
hash_216f857696e79e45: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I need you to relax and focus, Bell.
hash_2fe4be0a4ae7b838: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Your helicopter crashed. You made your way through the jungle, alone. You found a bunker. Do you remember the bunker, Bell?
hash_6cbc9e83c036f5cb: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^We need to know what's inside that bunker.
hash_20eb83c70e6c4042: The team heads to Cuba in order to commandeer the stolen Greenlight nuke from Perseus.
hash_f1932524892a466: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Hastings left Salt Lake City- we tracked his movements all the way to Cuba. We have to assume Perseus moved the nuke there.
hash_7382a5b40f74961f: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Hudson: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Langley believes Castro could help Perseus smuggle it into the US. In exchange for a peek at the hardware, of course.
hash_784b20ccbe2b7d50: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Hudson: ^7^Fmaxima_med^The last read we have on Hastings came from thirty miles south of Havana. We suspect Perseus is using an abandoned compound there to hold the nuke. They're working under the radar so expect moderate security.
hash_1592822a8d3e9151: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Lazar: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I say we smash and grab. Parachute in. Grab the nuke. Sky-hook out.
hash_a8c14b622740acf: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Park: ^7^Fmaxima_med^And what if the nuke isn't there?
hash_24b610f741bd36c1: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Hudson: ^7^Fmaxima_med^It's there. The only reason Perseus needs Hastings in Cuba is to prepare it for arming and detonation.
hash_5d0468d321ce587e: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^There you have it. Hudson will arrange our exfil while we're en route. If everyone's ready, let's move out.
hash_436505aeb8e306f6: Woods and Bell infiltrate a secret military facility in the Soviet Republic of Ukraine.
hash_4fcecc001f484de1: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Hudson: ^7^Fmaxima_med^The information from Volkov confirms our worst fears; Perseus smuggled a nuclear device through East Berlin.
hash_53ea61121a7df548: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^We can't be certain of that yet.
hash_199086b99edb1da7: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Hudson: ^7^Fmaxima_med^He has it. I'm sure of it.
hash_39f7540f6c301a81: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Park: ^7^Fmaxima_med^We found encrypted geocoordinates with Volkov's nuclear intel: an unpopulated region within the Soviet republic of Ukraine.
hash_725fabb6f80e167c: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I want to know everything that's going on inside this building.
hash_76d9ed9fab393d79: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^We'll need the others for this one. Mason and Woods will join us from Kiev.
hash_1f2c5a0507fbf643: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Mason and I will be standing by for an extract. Park will handle comms.
hash_535ab65a05c3aba5: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^We have no idea how large or prepared their forces will be, so use discretion if you have to engage.
hash_5e68eeedb6dee998: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^It's time we took a peek behind the Iron Curtain.
hash_659595b9460cfe6f: Lying about the whereabouts of Perseus, Bell leads the team to the Duga radar array in the Soviet Republic of Ukraine.
hash_712ef80baff2c7f5: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Hudson: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Five years ago NATO intelligence detected a powerful signal of unknown origin.
hash_214d9358df60ec26: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Hudson: ^7^Fmaxima_med^The new signal created radio disruptions worldwide.
hash_251b3d71188c2971: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Sims: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Not to mention all kinds of conspiracy theories.
hash_7fcd03d490a10ad0: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Hudson: ^7^Fmaxima_med^NATO quickly tracked it to this facility in the Soviet republic of Ukraine. The Duga radar array.
hash_3cc1ed04e77b52ff: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Sims: ^7^Fmaxima_med^It's an over-the-horizon radar system. Big improvement over their old missile defense tech.
hash_5cb2cdb8022a7cac: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Sims: ^7^Fmaxima_med^It uses a lot of juice. Could be used to broadcast any kind of long-range signal they want.
hash_1dcab435e7598225: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Like detonation codes to every Greenlight nuke in Europe.
hash_52fd3a33daae4463: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Sims: ^7^Fmaxima_med^About 60 miles north of Kiev, between the cities of Pripyat and Chernobyl. It's nothing but thick forest for miles around.
hash_53832e64ad83ee38: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Sims: ^7^Fmaxima_med^We'll have to drop you in a little further out. No recon, no heavy support- just a light infiltration squad.
hash_75b59092eaf90d8a: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Woods: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Shouldn't be a problem. Just point the way.
hash_3532683e99fd8d12: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Bell came through for us in the nick of time.
hash_62b2c6b2501dc77c: Dimitri Belikov {- KGB Head of Security}
hash_2b270772da74472a: Russell Adler has devised a risky plan to acquire the sleeper agent identities from the Lubyanka Building.
hash_55d104ff234e8597: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^The Lubyanka Building... KGB Headquarters in Moscow.
hash_fa6004691708e44: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^The sleeper agent records are stored in the archives one hundred feet below ground in a nuclear defense command bunker.
hash_349851ad456dba26: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Sims: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Your only way in or out is through this high security elevator.
hash_4928a0c3076403a6: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^We'll need proper credentials. That's where our asset, Belikov, comes into play.
hash_593a2ab90f5bce3: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Belikov has been our source inside the KGB for nearly a decade. He'll get us in. He came through for us in Yamantau, and he'll do it again.
hash_2cf07fecf10edc47: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Sims: ^7^Fmaxima_med^This shit is crazy, even by his standards. You sure he's on board?
hash_fca4597c64d7a9d: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^An immediate nuclear threat warrants every risk at this point. I'm sure he wouldn't disagree. Sims, get Belikov on the line.
hash_7317209a7a19ca3f: After telling the truth about the whereabouts of Perseus, Bell leads the team to the Solovetsky Islands off the coast of northern Russia.
hash_198ada650d99896: Perseus is plundering an abandoned Yamantau base in search of information Nikita Dragovich left behind.
hash_6f2658c48e14e02f: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^We need to know what Perseus is planning for that nuke. Park, anything else in that printout Bell and Woods pulled from the base?
hash_d88a511a94b1d47: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Park: ^7^Fmaxima_med^There's mention of an excavation taking place in the Ural Mountains. Yamantau. Our insider within the KGB confirmed an active operation.
hash_4567800109a21e7b: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Woods: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Yamantau... I thought Hudson and Weaver buried that place years ago.
hash_6ada6a0757009168: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Park: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Perseus wants to salvage the old mainframe.
hash_5144153294bfbd46: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Woods: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Dragovich and Steiner must have left some good shit behind.
hash_4735bb5c1631a3a6: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Hudson: ^7^Fmaxima_med^You're too close to this Mason. We can afford zero fuck-ups.
hash_147f4bac04434b1b: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Mason: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Bullshit. You know there's no one better for the job.
hash_46f03e54f651b102: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^It's my call. I want Mason and Woods on this. Find that mainframe before Perseus does.
hash_2ee1ad997c9d5f7: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Hudson: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I'll contact our KGB insider, Belikov. He'll offer logistical support. Hell, Belikov may want to fly the chopper himself.
hash_3eb09dba9ec31198: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Whatever Perseus wants at Yamantau... I want it more.
hash_36dd535e782bcfc7: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Sims: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Alright. I'll let Mason and Woods know that we're ready. They'll be handling this one.
hash_6a0ad4b6e61c7e14: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Sims: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Our source tells us that Aldrich is about to move south across Colorado and into northern New Mexico. That's where we'll intercept his convoy.
hash_151c0dc26585cf99: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Sims: ^7^Fmaxima_med^We can't let a former CIA operative run a Perseus spy factory. Let's put this asshole six feet under.
hash_6e80142c964dff40: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Sims: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Okay. Woods and Mason are going to take point on this.
hash_47f885cf189418e3: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Sims: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Apparently, Rudnick is lying low in a remote Soviet base in the mountains of Uzbekistan.
hash_699a71efc63d9a06: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Sims: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Not remote enough. We're going to land our boys nearby and pay him a little visit.
hash_124ef8283caa7e79: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Sims: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Let's cut this Perseus sucker down to size.
hash_5d8dc865d7039532: {Near the Border of Colorado and} New Mexico
hash_422d8025794702ca: The team pursues a rogue CIA officer, Robert Aldrich, who is helping Perseus set up a spy network within the United States.
hash_fc80ffc928f1ab7: Soviet Major Vadim Rudnik is helping Perseus plant agents within European governments. The team has to take Rudnik out.
hash_2cfa8ae7b63d5902: The President has authorized retaliatory hits on two Iranian terrorists: Qasim Javadi and Arash Kadivar.
hash_21228ed4aca830d6: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Reagan: ^7^Fmaxima_med^We must realize that no arsenal or no weapon in the arsenals of the world is so formidable as the will and moral courage of free men and women.
hash_2f90915126ad0409: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Reagan: ^7^Fmaxima_med^It is a weapon our adversaries in today's world do not have.
hash_58fe3d27fb803508: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Reagan: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Let that be understood by those who practice terrorism and prey upon their neighbors.
hash_514724fbd549c35e: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^News Anchor: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Some U.S. intelligence analysts believe America is already in a state of war with the Soviet Union.
hash_634f15a5726eacd: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^News Anchor: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Are Soviet spies living among us?
hash_7580595e2561a5dd: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^News Anchor: ^7^Fmaxima_med^52 American citizens have been taken hostage at the American Embassy in Tehran.

1955 - Enlisted US Army. 
1957 - Qualified for Green Berets. 
Service included Jungle ODA and Urban ODA with MOS in anti-aircraft systems. 
1959 - Recruited CIA Special Activities Division. 
[Redacted Paragraph]
1967 - Assigned MACV-SOG unit in Vietnam, investigating covert Russian activity. 
Post-Vietnam he disappears from CIA records, but anecdotal evidence is consistent with him continuing to lead and participate in clandestine operations, including the raid on Rebirth Island on February 23rd, 1968.

Rivas grew up in a small village near El Empalme, in the Nicaraguan region of Le\xc3\xb3n.  She spent much of her childhood accompanying her migrant worker parents, as they followed work from farm to farm, and plantation to plantation.
While smaller jobs came and went, the most dependable employer in the region was the Menendez cartel.
As one of the older children, she was often assigned to look after the other workers kids while their parents worked the fields \xe2\x80\x93 occasionally watching over the young Josefina Menendez, whenever her Father Jose Luiz toured the cartels operations.
While they provided regular, lucrative employment, the cartel\xe2\x80\x99s wars with their rivals exacted a hard toll on the locals who were often caught in the crossfire.  
As she got older, she witnessed untold grief and suffering as her peers lost parents, grandparents, and siblings to the ongoing gang power struggles \xe2\x80\x93 and realized that as long as the cartels were making money, the mounting death toll would be considered an acceptable cost of doing business \xe2\x80\x93 and that the authorities who were in their pay, would continue to turn a blind eye.
After barely escaping a particularly bloody massacre, she left her home and joined up with a growing group of partisan fighters dedicated to disrupting cartel operations to drive them out of her country.

1970 \xe2\x80\x93 Enrolls in Westpoint with Service-Connected nomination.
1974 \xe2\x80\x93 Graduates top-of-class from Westpoint with Bachelors degree in Mechanical Engineering. 
1979 \xe2\x80\x93 Following first deployment, receives stellar OER and record ROP scores. Subsequently accepted into 1st Ranger Battalion.
[Redacted Paragraph]
1980 \xe2\x80\x93 Holds Manzariyeh Air Base in Tehran during Operation Eagle Claw.
1981 \xe2\x80\x93 Recruited by CIA Special Activities Division Special Operations Group (SAD/SOG) based on exemplary service record and peer recommendations.
1982 \xe2\x80\x93 Selected as inaugural member of CIA SAD/SOG [redacted] task force, focused on future warfare and counterinsurgency.
PEER ASSESSMENT:
With a disabled veteran father and two brothers KIA in Vietnam, Stryker\xe2\x80\x99s destiny was always on the battlefield. Even early in his career, his commanding officers noted his singular devotion to military life. While peers filled their downtime with football and drinking, Stryker was often found obsessively maintaining his equipment or reading his battered copy of Clausewitz. Later squad mates would call him \xe2\x80\x9ca cold sunuvabitch\xe2\x80\x9d and \xe2\x80\x9ca goddamn savant\xe2\x80\x9d in the same breath, marveling over both his willingness to test cutting-edge military tech in active combat zones, and his aptitude to survive such encounters.
Pairing his exemplary service record with his deep theoretical understanding of warfare and the soldier\xe2\x80\x99s place in it, Stryker was declared a prime candidate for the groundbreaking CIA [redacted] task force. Agency leaders have described him as the future of American warfare, and many consider him the first true American super soldier.
hash_1ac991a5122130ba: Trained in Jungle Warfare and anti-narco operations, Vargas joined the M-19 guerrilla group to fight against a government he considered corrupt and the cartels he believed to be pulling their strings.
hash_f82c2acd7a2b062:
1943 \xe2\x80\x93 Weaver\xe2\x80\x99s mother flees Soviet Union with her children, settles in USA.
1954 \xe2\x80\x93 Enlists in US Army. Outstanding performance in Ranger school and Russian language skills earn him quick recruitment by CIA Special Activities Division Special Operations Group (SAD/SOG).
1963 \xe2\x80\x93 Captured during mission to Baikonur cosmodrome in Kazakh SSR. Loses left eye to Soviet Colonel Lev Kravchenko. Returns to field ops within weeks, as effective as ever.
PEER ASSESSMENT:
Weaver is liked and respected by his fellow CIA operators. His longest professional partnership is with Clandestine Service Officer Jason Hudson, whom he has accompanied on multiple missions and assisted on interrogations and PsyOps. His Russian heritage, once a source of distrust in the Agency, is now seen as a key asset in special operations against the USSR.
Weaver also enjoys a close working relationship with Special Officers Frank Woods and Alex Mason. Woods, who generally treats colleagues with contempt and derision, displays a grudging respect for Weaver, who can be every bit as hardnosed and lethal in the field as Woods himself.
Agency leaders at Langley voiced concerns regarding Weaver\xe2\x80\x99s return to active duty so soon after his traumatic experience at Baikonur. But Hudson cleared Weaver without reservation, advising the Director of Central Intelligence that Weaver is \xe2\x80\x9cuniquely crucial and indispensable\xe2\x80\x9d to ongoing operations against rogue elements of the KGB.
hash_5aa4b3da50ca0e60:
New York born Terrell Wolf and his family moved to Louisiana when he was 10, to live with his paternal grandparents after his father was injured in a work accident.
There, he spent many happy years learning to hunt in the surrounding bayous with his older brother.
In 1971 his brother joined the army and went to fight in Vietnam.
On Terrell\xe2\x80\x99s 16th birthday, the family received devastating news \xe2\x80\x93 his brother\xe2\x80\x99s unit had been ambushed while on patrol.  All were listed as being killed in action.
Terrell swore that he was going to join up in his brother\xe2\x80\x99s memory, as soon as he was old enough to do so.  Secretly, he harbored thoughts of revenge, against an imagined enemy that he never had a chance of tracking down.
On his 18th birthday, 7 months after hostilities ended in Vietnam, Terrell enlisted.
Now an elite Delta Force Sniper, he draws on his years of hunting in the bayous to stalk more dangerous prey, as a jungle warfare specialist.
SERVICE RECORD:
1975 \xe2\x80\x93 Enlists US Army
1977 \xe2\x80\x93 Passes Q Course, earning his Green Beret.  Becomes a member of US Army\xe2\x80\x99s 1st Special Forces Group.
1979 \xe2\x80\x93 Reenlists.
1980 \xe2\x80\x93 Passes Delta Force selection.
hash_27f5cef8a65f9010:
SERVICE RECORD:
1948 \xe2\x80\x93 Enlisted USMC.
1950 \xe2\x80\x93 Selected for the 1st Provisional Marine Brigade \xe2\x80\x93 deployed at the start of the Korean War.  Saw action in the Battle of Masan, the Battle of the Pusan Perimeter, and the 1st & 2nd Battles of the Naktong Bulge.
1950-1953 \xe2\x80\x93 Folded into the USMC 1st Marine Division \xe2\x80\x93 Battle of Bunker Hill, Battle for Outpost Vegas.
1958 \xe2\x80\x93 Recruited into the CIA \xe2\x80\x93 Special Activities Division.
1961 \xe2\x80\x93 [Redacted Paragraph]
1963 \xe2\x80\x93 [Redacted Paragraph]
1965 \xe2\x80\x93 Attached to Special Operations Group, charged with conducting unconventional warfare operations against hostile forces in Vietnam.  
[Redacted Paragraph]
1968 - Woods presumed KIA, following encounter with Spetsnaz Colonel Lev Kravchenko in Sekong, Laos.
1972 \xe2\x80\x93 Repatriated and debriefed following his escape from a POW camp in Da Nang.  Woods reports that he spent 6 months as a prisoner at the H\xe1\xbb\x8fa L\xc3\xb2 prison, before his transfer to Da Nang.

PEER ASSESSMENT:
Loner.  Fiercely self-reliant, likely as result of his teenaged years spent on the streets of his native Philadelphia, Sergeant Woods exhibits a hostile attitude towards authority. However, his exemplary and extensive service record speaks for itself.
His tendency to self-isolate and his distrust of command may represent an interesting opportunity.  Continue surveillance operations.
hash_5b421f7f4cb697a7:
1973 \xe2\x80\x93 Graduates University of Oslo, BSc. Political Science
1974 \xe2\x80\x93 Enlists Forsvaret \xe2\x80\x93 Norwegian Armed Forces.  Assigned NJHQ \xe2\x80\x93 Norwegian Joint Headquarters
1978 \xe2\x80\x93 Recruited to Norwegian Intelligence Service (NIS)
PEER ASSESSMENT:
Described in her annual assessments as a \xe2\x80\x98True patriot\xe2\x80\x99, \xe2\x80\x98Determined\xe2\x80\x99 and \xe2\x80\x98Utterly focused\xe2\x80\x99.   Helvig is a model field agent.
Wraith is unique in our experience.  Of those who have joined our cause, she is the only one to have actively sought us out and offered her services.
Her political background, along with her experiences at NJHQ made her understand that when the Cold War turns hot, Scandinavia\xe2\x80\x99s geography would make it a battlefront.  One that would not survive the warring giants on either side.
While handling intercepts at NJHQ for the CIA in 1981, she learnt of us.  Did her own research.  Came to us and offered her loyalty.
She is a true patriot. One who sees the lies of her leaders for what they are.  She is an excellent asset.
hash_56f4d77cdb0722e7:
Service: DGSE (Directorate-General for External Security)
1974 \xe2\x80\x93 Enlists Arm\xc3\xa9e de Terre \xe2\x80\x93 joins 6e\xc2\xa0R\xc3\xa9giment du G\xc3\xa9nie.
1978 \xe2\x80\x93 Recruited by the SDECE (Service de Documentation Ext\xc3\xa9rieure et de Contre-Espionnage). While she appears to have been assigned to the Technical Directorate, training records suggest an active role within the Action Division of the Directorate of Operations.
1979 \xe2\x80\x93 Took part in Operation Caban, helping secure the Bangui M\xe2\x80\x99Poko International Airport in the CAR, before the arrival of 300 French Commandos as part of Operation Barracuda.
1981 \xe2\x80\x93 SDECE renamed DGSE.
PEER ASSESSMENT
Senegalese born daughter of a successful rally driver, Zeyna has been around vehicles and garages longer than she can remember.  She has joked that if you cut her, she bleeds gasoline. 
While her natural driving skills made her an obvious choice for training as a mobility operator, her secondary specialization in heavy weaponry plays to her aggressive attitude. 
Colleagues describe her as an unnecessary risk taker, but also as being exactly who you want to see heading up the charge when you are in a tight spot and help is on the way.

hash_8484c0620f28597: ^1Perseus: ^7They sleep soundly at night, knowing they put on a good parade - but they lack the will to do what must be done.
hash_5ecf47e270578949: ^5Hudson: ^7Our technology gives us an edge. We'll flush Perseus out and put him down.
hash_2fb2a0c8a04399e9: ^1Perseus: ^7The Superpowers will fall, victims of their own greed and corruption. We will rebuild Greater Russia from the ashes.
hash_4e04da2752d33b53: ^5Hudson: ^7We're hunting a monster. Forget the standard Rules of Engagement - if we're gonna stop him - we're gonna have to get our hands dirty.
hash_493c0062da328595: ^5NATO Commander: ^7Stand down - this concludes the exercise.
hash_2259bc1211126a17: ^5Hudson: ^7For decades, we've fought to keep communist aggression in check. After 2 years in the shadows, chatter is Persesus is about to make another move. We don't know where or when - but we know it'll be big.

^5Technician: ^7Commencing Exercise - Injecting radar signals.
hash_a45d8531465079b: ^1Perseus: ^7Our Motherland is lead by cowards and weaklings. In time, the Americans and their NATO puppets will bring the Soviet Union to its knees. We will break the stalemate, then burn them both to the ground.
hash_18820f3ec8c9abfb: ^5Hudson: ^7The Soviets claim Perseus is a rogue element; a threat to us all. Stay vigilant - they never tell the whole truth.
hash_67c74b4ec3d79922: ^1Maxis: ^7That is why you needed to see the tape.
hash_76746adf19ec56e7: ^1Maxis: ^7Stay with me Weaver. The next part was shot one week later...
hash_1961e444d7cf35aa: ^1Maxis: ^7Until two weeks ago. Now it's happening again.
hash_b4e67d3a311906: ^1Maxis: ^7Have you heard of the Omega group?
hash_1fc58dceedf8d859: ^1Weaver: ^7You have to turn yourself in. The CIA can protect you. I can protect you.
hash_3439dbedeb538499: ^1Maxis: ^7The Omega Group have plans for the outbreak zones. I have to stay in the field.
hash_6d75238bb1a9c6f3: ^1Maxis: ^7I'm sorry... this is the only way.
hash_3ab9ae8794852a5c: ^1Weaver: ^7We've lost two teams since you went dark.
hash_3a037525e2e4674d: ^1Weaver: ^7Old war footage is the last thing on my mind right now.
hash_58feeb282b0bf198: ^1Weaver: ^7How did you get hold of this?
hash_66a6a4641ca1c5af: ^1Maxis: ^7A friend in the KGB... A late friend.
hash_18c044f299ddf1ec: ^5Wolf: ^7Rescue mission was a cluster, we got skunked hard.
hash_1642020dd29d628b: ^5Wolf: ^7Adler had been there - sons of bitches worked him real good.
hash_24f690853f44f68e: ^5Wolf: ^7The Nova 6 threat, man it was BS - a distraction to draw him... Us in.
hash_381bfc6df9fe7345: ^5Wolf: ^7We chased every lead - showed them the same courtesy they showed Adler.
hash_90c37bc07f1904a: ^5Hudson: ^7Pack your bags - bring our boy home.
hash_16d93164f2bdbfcc: ^1Stitch: ^7They rescued Adler faster than predicted - no matter - our work with him is done.
hash_74806c33fa90cda2: ^1Stitch: ^7Not yet. Their satellites are interfering with our broadcast.
hash_83a6995a551429b: ^1Stitch: ^7The Verdansk test subjects are in place, but we're not getting through.
hash_41c7d91e276fca85: ^1Wraith: ^7They still don't know what we're doing.
hash_6dbce1d8ed09a7e7: ^1Knight: ^7We have the advantage - we should press it.
hash_3d05f03911f783: ^1Wraith: ^7Our man in South Africa is standing by.
hash_79876fef8b812177: ^1Stitch: ^7... Agreed. All the pieces are in play. Make the call.
hash_6b5a27e7bdf99136: ^1Wraith: ^7Jackal brought down the Satellites - The Verdansk tests are looking good.
hash_18e5f1fe96aea99d: ^1Wraith: ^7That clears the way for you. The job is go.
hash_3c4758542a733590: ^1Wraith: ^7I've made the drop. All the materials you need are there.
hash_1b5ffbea29791b77: ^1Wraith: ^7Better pack warm - You're headed to Teufelsberg.
hash_3785e2ddb1880591: ^5Hudson: ^7Go find Mason. He knows what has to be done.
hash_feb872823b70b3c: ^5Hudson: ^7Salah said that the satellites data recorder was destroyed on reentry.
hash_1167f9e17982d03a: ^5Hudson: ^7Forensics disagree. Soot patterns were consistent with it surviving to impact.
hash_7198e265eecc2481: ^5Woods: ^7Adler made damn sure he was first there.
hash_2da7d35a0516f5d0: ^5Hudson: ^7Perseus were on site - Could they have taken it?
hash_161d1f020a86e4ee: ^5Hudson: ^7After what happened at Echelon, we have to assume he's compromised.
hash_77a6d24d2aee5e4: ^5Hudson: ^7Adler's been off grid working on something in Verdansk - We have no idea what he's been doing...
hash_58f1e153f3bdb216: ^5Butcher: ^7Relax gents, we're on the same side.
hash_2ec4917a485b4a33: ^5Butcher: ^7I'm Captain Butcher of the SOE. Well, retired Captain Butcher these days.
hash_5758fd51bbc8ad0c: ^5Butcher: ^7I was in charge of SOE during the war. Ever heard of Vanguard?
hash_17faea5b706b92d9: ^5Butcher: ^7I created Vanguard. And all the others too.
hash_72091d7bd0d73502: ^5Butcher: ^7It was a simpler time then. But the work is never done.
hash_485bfed5414a285f: ^5Butcher: ^7Our victory wasn't earned 'til we snuffed out every last spark.
hash_48e2311e784217f8: ^5Butcher: ^7After Berlin we hunted down the rats that scurried into hiding all over the world.
hash_57ba15b595e06b4b: ^5Adler: ^7We've got company. Keep your eyes peeled.
hash_3e2fb9f5513b30d0: ^5Mason: ^7Hope they're all still burning in hell.
hash_446c9f032750d2e7: ^5Butcher: ^7I heard you a mile off - no offense. If I'd meant you any harm - you'd already be dead.
hash_24f38340e204300a: ^5Hudson: ^7How about we start with "Who the fuck are you, and what the fuck are you doing here?"
hash_3bf3734e5d1a9f92:

hash_187ed5ac741c3684: ^5Adler: ^7Spare me your horse shit. Where the fuck is Perseus?
hash_2474e877f16994e0: ^1Stitch: ^7A great man with great vision. He was not the first Perseus, just as I will not be the last.
hash_746b49105b952b10: ^5Adler: ^7You're coming with me. There's blood on your hands.
hash_57546dd2b45167e6: ^5Adler: ^7Fuck you - I wasn't in my right mind - you saw to that.
hash_5ae9dd313951c84: ^1Stitch: ^7You Westerners - So squeamish - look at where we are... This was the Eastern Front. The blood of millions of my people soaked deep into this soil. Men and Women who paid the ultimate price for what had to be done.
hash_66f3c16d2df6f45c: ^5Adler: ^7You're a fucking monster - I should kill you for what you've done - for what you did to me.
hash_c2c4cf3b2ab801e: ^1Stitch: ^7My life no longer matters - do what you will - finish what you started on Rebirth Island. My broadcast was complete - I have changed the World, Adler - in ways you can't even imagine.
hash_742d44c99755e136: ^5Adler: ^7It's over. Your sick experiment is done.
hash_30c72af8c30074d0: ^1Stitch: ^7I figured. It was worth a try.
hash_7ba45803c3b5a081: ^1Stitch: ^7My work was finished before your little act of rebellion. This changes nothing.
hash_19ae99af63edbadb: ^1Stitch: ^7You never understood. Perseus was never one man. It's an ideal. Bigger than any of us.
hash_bd1df95679ca9a9: ^1Stitch: ^7Adler has some pieces of the puzzle...
hash_1bb11da6780f96f9: ^5Adler: ^7No shit. But if we don't stop him, civilians are going to die.
hash_33b5d9fe730711af: ^5Adler: ^7What the hell... He's manufacturing Nova 6 again...
hash_2ea717dc9e8ff98: ^1Stitch: ^7... But doesn't know he's a piece himself.
hash_2dd102578b0c1e7: ^1Stitch: ^7He won't live long enough to work that out. I won't show him the 'mercy' he showed me.
hash_105dbf90b2d1b57e: ^1Stitch: ^7I was in charge of the production of Nova 6 on Rebirth Island.
hash_1b5b0b24317f4c7c: ^1Stitch: ^7I was loyal -- my star ascendant, until the Americans found us.
hash_19233955426e2e55: ^5Adler: ^7Tell your boss - this is for Weaver.
hash_4fc8e3d548683b31: ^1Stitch: ^7For letting Rebirth fall, Kravchenko sent me to the gulag... where I found my true calling.
hash_554c782fefb18e18: ^5Rivas: ^7Camp's a few clicks East. They knew we were coming.
hash_62e2315f1dd0e5: ^5Wolf: ^7Fuck - We can't abort or Adler's as good as dead.
hash_4bc4722a4849b7cf: ^5Woods: ^7He's one tough son of a bitch but everyone's got a breaking point. Time's wasting kids.
hash_4d509d8dfd535f5a: ^5Rivas: ^7Need immediate reinforcement - Falling back to LZ.
hash_594971c3700ea9e3: ^1Naga: ^7Stitch - The rats are here - Adler's secure and headed to you in Verdansk.
hash_17ff15691db0b8a1: ^1Stitch: ^7Good - make them believe we care about the Nova 6 supply lines.
hash_2347eb57bd6a7e14: ^5Rivas: ^7I have you visual - LZ is hot - light 'em up!
hash_74d80ba7af942057: ^5Woods: ^7It's go time - Get on the gun - don't get killed!
hash_18d378b9566df6c5: ^1Wraith: ^7Wraith to Stitch - Come in - Channel is secure.
hash_1942e151d7416de2: ^1Stitch: ^7Moscow will blame the Americans for Yamantau, and our work with Adler is almost done - we can proceed.
hash_649a00da9e92dddb: ^1Stitch: ^7What Dragovitch only managed with a single subject, we shall do to entire nations...
hash_7bb29223fda597d0: ^1Stitch: ^7What we do in Verdansk will pave the way for the rise of Greater Russia.
hash_1c94857a1301dfdc: ^1Jackal: ^7Do what you're told and you get to live - You understand?
hash_68fd3d8b0e6d2d3b: ^5Salah: ^7What the hell was that? We're supposed to be a unit.
hash_20a916bae5f0caa4: ^5Adler: ^7With Perseus standard operating procedure goes out the window, son.
hash_611d974e3bd4b715: ^5Salah: ^7Well, did we get the data recorder?
hash_2ba21f8b42f0e86: ^5Adler: ^7No - must have been destroyed on re-entry.
hash_44791b8b080436c3: ^5Adler: ^7You don't get the war we're fighting, do you? Stitch is capable of anything.
hash_5a190e31f1db00ed: ^1Jackal: ^7I knew you were a smart one.
hash_669f8f644a032f86: ^1Stitch: ^7My friend has made your... Predicament clear?
hash_50e9afc12f62ec4: ^1Stitch: ^7I have a problem - you fix it, you don't end up like your colleagues.
hash_59aa580761731e05: ^1Stitch: ^7The Jumpseat constellation is broadcasting on frequencies I need cleared.
hash_26a766cb216eaaf8: ^1Stitch: ^7Ground-fall will occur at the coordinates you have in front of you.
hash_861db553d4ef36a: ^1Kitsune: ^7Told you it would be easy. Headed home.
hash_677f2052593fe73d: ^1Stitch: ^7Get it done. Re-enforcements are already inbound.
hash_62acbb58663bb291: ^<NATO Base Guard: ^7Mayday Mayday - Echelon Station has fallen. Assailants unknown. Repea-
hash_4f5ec376d38c3c1: ^1Fuze: ^7This has CIA written all over it.
hash_250ed09099dc6e8f: ^5Hudson: ^7Tough son of a bitch won't talk. Let's start the real work.
hash_1e03dd0c43b62147: ^5Adler: ^7Stitch's operation in Verdansk has to be destroyed!
hash_5bdcdec6b0d4cf74: ^5Adler: ^7Get me out of this fucking chair!
hash_58673d1315085579: ^5Mason: ^7First we're gonna fix you. Trust me. This is going to hurt.
hash_302c4000608ef334: ^5Hudson: ^7Got reports of multiple explosions in Verdansk. Sounds like our boy did a number on the place.
hash_48327bd603826717: ^5Hudson: ^7Get him up - We need to go.
hash_57fe8b08aa4913ea: ^5Mason: ^7It wasn't you. We're going to finish what you started.
hash_2fbd70adf56d177c: ^5Mason: ^7It's no use - We're running out of time.
hash_6981f65a0b1dad95: ^5Hudson: ^7You've been off grid since Algeria. What were you doing in Verdansk?
hash_1f9f2102c7344bf5: ^1Fuze: ^7You always find me the best toys.
hash_75883500cc84d987: ^1Perseus Soldier: ^7Stadium Search Team - we've found more devices.
hash_4770e36d692e63d0: ^1Fuze: ^7Kill it - signal could set this off.
hash_3a573413490043b1: ^1Fuze: ^7Of course... Seismic charge. Primary rigged to blow secondaries in the borehole. Sophisticated. Very nasty.
